Its portfolio spans property and casualty agency management (EbixASP), P&C policy administration and broker systems (EbixEvolution, PlacingHub, Sunrise Exchange, iClose), life insurance and annuity distribution connectivity (EbixExchange), health insurance and employee benefits administration, health content, risk and compliance (RiskEnvision, WCExchange), and — through the EbixCash arm — travel, payments and forex services. Its core P&C plumbing is ACORD-native rather than API-native: TEAM-UP moves policy, claims and direct-bill commission download to agency management systems as ACORD-standard AL3 files, its Translation Services practice converts carrier-proprietary formats into ACORD AL3 and ACORD XML using Java/XML/XSLT, EbixASP maintains a continuously updated ACORD forms library with bi-directional exchange against ACORD applications, and the EbixASP Real-Time Interface synchronizes carrier credentials and service transactions with IVANS. Ebix markets API-driven quote-to-bind workflows and, since October 2025, a plug-and-play connector platform built with 1SilverBullet that exposes quoting, eApp, enrollment, underwriting checks, payments and policy servicing as modular APIs with "a standardized connector fabric with pre-built mappings and a developer portal" — but no public self-serve developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification could be confirmed as of 2026-07-25. Every probed developer path on ebix.com (/developers, /api, /developer, /partners, /integrations) returns the site's single-page-app homepage shell rather than a developer surface; developer.ebix.com and docs.ebix.com do not resolve; api.ebix.com answers with a JSON 404 and no documented routes; and the live EbixCash API Hub at api.ebixcash.com serves an OpenAPI document that returns HTTP 401 "Missing Authorization header". The one agent-facing discovery document Ebix does publish is a real llms.txt at www.ebix.com/llms.txt, which indexes the solution, service and corporate pages but names no API, portal or specification; every /.well-known/ probe across www.ebix.com, api.ebix.com, api.ebixcash.com and ebixasp.com missed, no first-party SDK exists in any public package registry, and no trust center, security.txt or vulnerability-disclosure program was found. Ebix's integration surface is therefore customer- and partner-gated, sold and documented under contract, which is the norm for United States insurance infrastructure where no federal regulator and no open-insurance mandate exists. Ebix filed Chapter 11 in December 2023, sold its North American life and annuity assets to Zinnia, and exited bankruptcy on 30 August 2024 consolidated with Eraaya Lifespaces.

providers.name: Apero
providers.description: Apero Health is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed healthcare technology company that provides an integrated practice-management and revenue-cycle-management (RCM) platform for medical practices. Its cloud software unifies scheduling, clinical visit notes, insurance eligibility verification and claims billing, patient billing and payments, e-prescriptions, and financial reporting, and claims to reduce billing time by up to 80% while helping practices scale operations. Apero exposes a fully-featured REST API, webhooks, and CSV import that connect healthcare and finance workflows, and integrates with payers (Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield) and platforms including Stripe, QuickBooks Online, Google, and Snowflake.

providers.name: Softheon
providers.description: Softheon is a healthcare technology company that provides SaaS software for health plans, brokers, and government agencies to run shopping and enrollment, billing and payments, member renewals, reporting and analytics, and compliance across the ACA marketplace, ICHRA, dental, and Medicare Advantage markets. Its all-in-one platform automates health-insurance administration end to end and is increasingly layering in agentic AI to streamline operations at scale. Founded around 2000 and headquartered in Stony Brook, New York, Softheon operates a developer portal (developer.softheon.com) and a compliance trust center, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: taktile
providers.description: Taktile is an agentic decision platform for financial institutions that combines AI speed with human oversight to automate and optimize high-stakes decisions across banking and insurance. Its Decision Engine, AI Agent Manager, Case Manager, and Context Layer power onboarding and KYC, credit underwriting, AML and fraud investigation, claims processing, and insurance underwriting. Teams design, test, deploy, and monitor decision flows and AI agents through a no-code studio backed by real-time APIs (the Taktile API and Flow API), with enterprise-grade infrastructure, data integrations, and governance controls.

providers.name: CeresAI
providers.description: CeresAI (formerly Ceres Imaging) is an aerial and satellite agricultural intelligence platform that converts high-resolution spectral imagery and machine learning into field-level insights on crop health, water stress, yield, and financial risk. The company serves growers, agribusinesses, lenders, and crop-insurance providers across more than 40 crop types on four continents, drawing on billions of plant-level data points to support yield protection, sustainability scorecards, portfolio risk analysis, and insurance claims. CeresAI operates a customer application and a login-gated developer documentation portal at dev.ceres.ai; pricing is consultation-based rather than self-serve. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Satellogic
providers.description: Satellogic is an Argentine-founded, U.S.-listed (NASDAQ: SATL) vertically integrated Earth observation company that designs, builds, and operates its own NewSat constellation to deliver sub-meter, high-frequency multispectral and hyperspectral satellite imagery. Its commercial platform Aleph unifies archive search, tasking, analysis, and delivery into a single web and API experience, available in both the legacy Aleph V1 (Tasking, Archive, Analysis, Delivery APIs) and the unified Aleph V2 Orders API. Satellogic also markets Aleph Observer for persistent daily monitoring of designated sites, Constellation-as-a-Service for priority and large-scale tasking, and Space Systems for customers who wish to purchase and operate their own Mark V class satellites. Imagery is delivered via API, FTP, and a reseller network, with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials authentication against auth.platform.satellogic.com and product APIs under api.satellogic.com.

providers.name: Empathy
providers.description: Empathy is a support platform that helps organizations guide people through loss, leave, and legacy moments, combining AI with human care to serve individuals navigating grief, estate planning, and major life transitions. Its products include LifeVault digital estate planning, Loss Support for beneficiaries handling claims and grief, Leave Support for employees during difficult life events, and Client Connect for advisors. Empathy sells to life insurance companies, banks and wealth managers, employers, health plans, and benefit consultants, covering 50M+ individuals. Backed by General Catalyst and Index Ventures. As of this profile Empathy publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Metromile
providers.description: Metromile is a pay-per-mile auto insurance platform powered by telematics and data science. Customers attach the Pulse OBD device to their vehicle to track mileage; premiums consist of a base monthly rate plus a per-mile charge, rewarding low-mileage drivers with significant savings. Beyond consumer insurance, Metromile Enterprise offers a cloud-based REST API platform for property and casualty insurers covering touchless claims automation, accident reconstruction (Replay), fraud detection (Detect), digital FNOL reporting (Report), and back-office workflow automation (Streamline). Metromile was acquired by Lemonade in July 2022.

providers.name: Shift Technology
providers.description: Shift Technology is a Paris-founded InsurTech company delivering AI-native decisioning and automation for the global insurance industry. Its purpose-built AI agents automate core insurance workflows — claims coverage and liability, fraud and risk detection, subrogation, injury evaluation, payment integrity, and process orchestration — for property & casualty and health insurers. Shift serves 120+ insurers across 30+ countries, including 100% of the top five U.S. P&C carriers, and has analyzed more than four billion policies, claims, and documents covering 350M+ policyholders. The company also operates the Insurance Data Network (IDN). Shift is a General Catalyst portfolio company; it markets an enterprise, contact-sales product and does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.

providers.name: Afori
providers.description: Afori is a Barcelona- and Germany-based insurtech building an AI software platform designed specifically for insurance brokers (Versicherungsmakler). Its first product is an AI Sidebar that lives inside Microsoft Outlook and broker management systems (Maklerverwaltungsprogramme), turning unstructured emails and documents into structured, review-ready cases with tasks and reminders, context-aware email drafts, and prefilled claim notifications. Specialized AI agents (KI-Helfer) automate insurance-specific back-office work while keeping every action documented and auditable. The platform is EU-hosted, GDPR (DSGVO) compliant, ISO 27001:2022 certified, and built within the European regulatory framework (IDD, EU AI Act). Founded in 2025 by former wefox leaders Fabian Wesemann (CEO) and Sergi Banos (CTO), Afori raised a EUR 4M round led by General Catalyst. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched from Afori's public web surface; the company currently publishes no developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Hopper
providers.description: Hopper is a travel marketplace and fintech, best known for consumer flight, hotel, car, and homes booking with fintech ancillaries such as Price Freeze, Cancel for Any Reason, and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason. Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) is the B2B arm that exposes Hopper's e-commerce (Stays, Cars, Packages), fintech ancillaries, loyalty portals, and HTS Assist agentic AI to banks, airlines, and travel providers including Capital One, Air Canada, Virgin Australia, Tripadvisor, Frontier, Wizz Air, and Porter.

providers.name: Nomi Health
providers.description: Nomi Health is a Utah-based direct healthcare and healthcare fintech company founded in 2019 that operates a payments, claims and analytics platform for self-funded employers, health plans, brokers and providers. Its stack spans real-time provider payments and claims adjudication (Healthcare Financial Services), directly contracted provider networks (Direct Network / Open Network), benefits-data analytics through Artemis by Nomi Health, and direct patient care services. Nomi Health operates authenticated web portals for providers, members and employers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Pasito
providers.description: Pasito is an AI-native workspace for employee benefits that helps benefits consultants, insurance carriers, and employers simplify every part of the benefits journey — from proposal and quoting through enrollment to year-round employee engagement — using agentic AI workflows. The platform turns unstructured plan documents and census data into a structured data layer that powers a conversational AI benefits assistant, automated proposal/RFP intake, benefits guides and microsites, decision support, and communications. Pasito reports supporting over 6.6 million employees, managing $106B in premiums, and serving 3,600+ employers, integrating with 950+ TPA systems and 260+ HRIS platforms. Backed by Google, Y Combinator, and Core Innovation Capital, the company is building a public-facing API but does not yet publish a developer portal, documentation, or API reference.

providers.name: claimsforce
providers.description: claimsforce GmbH is a Hamburg-based insurtech building AI-powered software for property and casualty claims management and underwriting. Its platform helps insurers, loss-adjusting and expert organizations, and independent adjusters digitize the end-to-end claims process - automating report and calculation generation, enabling video-based remote case assessment, optimizing adjuster disposition and route planning to cut travel time, and surfacing real-time analytics for claims handling and risk management. Named customers include Zurich Gruppe Deutschland, HanseMerkur, Concordia, Crawford, Sedgwick and Die Regulierer. The product is a private, login-only SaaS with no public API or developer portal as of July 2026. The company is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (TUV Rheinland) and backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: FintechOS
providers.description: FintechOS is an AI-powered financial product operations platform that enables banks, lenders, and insurers to configure, price, launch, and manage financial products with reduced dependency on legacy core systems. The platform combines unified product operations, agentic workflow orchestration, and governed AI to streamline origination, servicing, underwriting, and compliance across banking and insurance. It exposes a low-code development environment with Server SDK and Client SDK layers and REST APIs, documented at docs.fintechos.com, with a gated developer community and an academy for onboarding. Founded in Romania with headquarters in the United Kingdom, FintechOS is a portfolio company of Earlybird and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: muffintech
providers.description: muffintech is a Berlin-based InsurTech building generative AI purpose-trained for the insurance industry. Its conversational assistant, muffinGPT, is pre-trained on 30,000+ insurance conversations and passed the German 34D broker certification exam, supporting insurers, brokers, and broker pools across sales enablement, lead generation and direct sales, and after-sales service (contract inquiries, claims reporting, cross-selling). The platform is modular and customizable, with a privacy-first architecture hosted on Microsoft Azure in Frankfurt, Germany, and is ISO 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant. muffintech raised EUR 3.5M in 2025 to scale its AI-driven insurance solutions. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; muffintech does not currently publish a public developer API surface (no docs, OpenAPI, or SDKs found as of this enrichment pass).

providers.name: Northwestern Mutual
providers.description: Northwestern Mutual is a Milwaukee-based Fortune 500 mutual insurance and financial services company founded in 1857, providing life insurance, disability income insurance, long-term care insurance, annuities, investment products, brokerage and wealth management services to individuals, families and businesses through a nationwide network of financial advisors. The company operates a large internal API estate — domain and experience APIs behind an API gateway, with GraphQL used to harmonize them — but publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable contract; its public engineering presence is an open source GitHub organization and a Bugcrowd-managed responsible disclosure program.

providers.name: Prudential plc
providers.description: Prudential plc is a life and health insurance and asset management group incorporated in England and Wales and listed on the London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York exchanges, with its principal operating office in Hong Kong and roots in London going back to 1848. Its home market for this profile is the United Kingdom, but its book is almost entirely Asian and African: life protection, health and medical, savings and retirement, takaful, pensions and Hong Kong Mandatory Provident Funds, plus asset management under the Eastspring brand, across Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Taiwan, India, mainland China, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and a dozen African markets including Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Zambia. It is no longer a UK retail insurer at all - the UK and Europe business was demerged as M&G plc in 2019 and the US business as Jackson Financial in 2021 - so the familiar UK "Pru" brands at pru.co.uk belong to M&G, not to this company. Its API posture is that there is no public API posture. Prudential plc publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger document and no partner integration surface of any kind: developer, developers, docs, api, apis, partners, portal and sandbox subdomains of prudentialplc.com all fail to resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer, /partners and /integrations on the corporate site all return HTTP 404. The group's stated technology strategy is inward-facing - AI, automation, cloud and a global AI Lab running over a hundred internal use cases - and its distribution is built on tied agency forces and exclusive bancassurance partnerships with banks such as Standard Chartered, CIMB, MSB, SeABank, Bank Syariah Indonesia and UOB, which are commercial and contractual relationships rather than published API programmes. The Pulse by Prudential health and wealth app onboards health-tech and wealth-tech partners (Babylon, Tictrac, Halodoc, Smarter Health, Prive Technologies, OVO, Google Cloud) but every announcement describes the arrangement in commercial terms and none exposes a developer programme, SDK or public API. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference was found anywhere in Prudential plc's public estate. Recorded honestly as a large carrier with a fully partner-gated, non-public integration surface. One genuine machine-readable surface does exist, and it is not an API: six of the group's market operating companies - Prudential Hong Kong, Prudential Singapore, Prudential Indonesia, Prudential Vietnam, Pru Life UK in the Philippines and Prudential BSN Takaful in Malaysia - publish real first-party llms.txt documents for grounding large language models, with Prudential Vietnam declaring a per-user-agent bot access policy for gptbot, claudebot, google-extended, perplexitybot and six other crawlers. The corporate domain publishes none. Underneath that, the group runs a visibly centralised security posture: TLS 1.3 and HSTS on every market host, and one shared PowerDMARC/PowerSPF tenant with a common aggregate-report mailbox across all seven domains, at p=reject on the corporate domain and p=quarantine in the markets, with no CAA record anywhere.

providers.name: Rainwalk Technology
providers.description: Rainwalk Technology is a white-label, embedded pet insurance provider founded in 2018 and based in Columbia, South Carolina. Rainwalk lets partners such as shelters, breeders, veterinary practices, and consumer platforms launch and distribute accident-and-illness pet insurance directly at the point of sale through its APIs and hosted quoting/enrollment flows, keeping partners in control of the customer experience. Coverage includes accidents, illnesses, diagnostics, surgery, and medications, with hassle-free reimbursements and free virtual vet consultations. The company operates a partner/embedded API surface (api.rainwalk.io) plus hosted quoting, insured, and agent portals, and is backed by Techstars Ventures, ManchesterStory, Insurtech Gateway, Bridge Capital, and Seaplane Ventures. Rainwalk was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched via the pipeline.

providers.name: Roper Technologies
providers.description: Roper Technologies is a diversified technology holding company (NASDAQ: ROP) that acquires, manages, and develops niche market-leading software and technology-enabled businesses. Over three-quarters of revenue comes from software products across three segments: Application Software (legal, healthcare, government, education, and insurance vertical SaaS), Network Software (construction, transportation, and insurance network platforms), and Technology Enabled Products (medical devices, industrial, and RF identification). Key subsidiaries include Aderant (legal software), Clinisys (laboratory informatics), Deltek (project-based business ERP), Frontline Education (K-12 HR software), Vertafore (insurance technology), IntelliTrans (supply chain visibility), ConstructConnect (construction information), DAT Solutions (freight matching), and iPipeline (life insurance SaaS).

providers.name: Acheel
providers.description: Acheel is a French digital insurance company — a néo-assureur that carries its own insurance licence rather than broking someone else's. Founded in 2020 by Ralph Ruimy and Francky Défossé, it received its ACPR agrément and launched in 2021, and now reports more than 800,000 policyholders. ACHEEL SA (879 605 350 RCS Paris) underwrites; ACHEEL FRANCE (ORIAS 21003575) distributes. The range spans nine lines — habitation, auto, santé, animaux, PNO (propriétaire non occupant), emprunteur, scolaire, protection juridique and RC pro — sold 100% digitally, with a quote in about two minutes and subscription in five. Roughly 70% of revenue comes from B2B2C distribution: partner brokers are served under the Charlee brand (charlee.fr, broker portal "Acheel Omega" at back.charlee.fr) and partners embed a per-tenant white-label customer area served from *.widget.acheel.com. Acheel's own partner FAQ stated it makes its APIs available to partners ("nous mettons à votre disposition nos APIs afin de vous faire bénéficier de notre Tech et de nos produits"), but no developer portal, API reference, base URL or machine-readable specification is published anywhere on its public surface; API access travels with a brokerage partnership. Acheel is a certified B Corp.

providers.name: Bestow
providers.description: Bestow is a Dallas, Texas life insurance technology company building a unified SaaS platform for life insurance carriers, agents, and embedded partners. Founded in 2016, Bestow provides end-to-end and modular solutions across new business and policy administration, including a digital Application Suite for quote, illustration, and application journeys; an Underwriting engine and workbench with instant, fully automated decisioning powered by machine learning on actuarial data; an Agent Portal and sales management tooling; an Admin Portal and Customer Portal for self-service; TPA (Third-Party Administrator) services; a Performance IQ analytics surface; and a Data Optimization Suite for modeling, integrations, and activation. Bestow's Protect API and associated SDK power embedded life insurance — letting fintechs, banks, financial institutions, P&C carriers, mortgage platforms, and benefits providers offer instant term life, final expense, and IUL coverage inside their own apps and websites, with Bestow handling underwriting, payment, billing, policy delivery, and ongoing administration behind the scenes. Integrations span ACORD life and annuities data standards, Adyen for payments, Cloudflare for identity and security, and data vendors including Bevel, Clareto, EIS, ExamOne, and Human API ReFlex Select. There is no publicly accessible developer portal or API reference — partner documentation, sandbox access, and Protect API onboarding are gated behind a partner login at docs.bestow.com and arranged through Bestow's sales and partnerships team.

providers.name: Federato
providers.description: Federato is an AI-native insurance technology platform built for the full policy lifecycle, from submission through policyholder management. Its RiskOps-style tooling spans underwriting workflow, automated submission triage, portfolio and appetite alignment, rate/price/quote, a configurable forms engine, federated data infrastructure, and producer, partner, and policyholder portals. Federato serves insurance carriers, managing general agents (MGAs), MGA aggregators, and mutual insurers. The company is backed by Emergence Capital and announced a $100M Series D led by Goldman Sachs. No public API or open developer reference was found during enrichment; the developer documentation portal (Archbee) is magic-link protected, and the GitHub organization holds only forks of third-party infrastructure tools.

providers.name: Gaia
providers.description: Gaia (Gaia Family) is a value-based family-building company that makes fertility treatment financially accessible. Founded by Nader AlSalim after his own multi-year IVF journey, Gaia replaces unpredictable cycle-by-cycle IVF billing with fixed-price, all-inclusive plans and monthly payments, backed by a protection model that offers more tries — or money back — if treatment does not succeed. It partners with 180+ fertility clinics across the US and UK, covering IVF, egg freezing, embryo transfer, hormone and lab testing, and fertility navigation, and also offers fertility benefits to employers. This profile is a company lead (no public API surface) maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Matic
providers.description: Matic is a digital insurance marketplace and independent insurance agency that lets consumers compare and buy home, auto, pet, umbrella, jewelry and other personal-lines insurance from a network of 60+ A-rated carriers in one place. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Matic is best known for its embedded-insurance model: it integrates insurance shopping into the digital experiences of mortgage lenders, servicers, banks and other financial-services partners so borrowers and account holders can obtain coverage at the point of need. Matic is a licensed agency operating in all 50 states and is backed by investors including Anthemis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; this enrichment pass confirms Matic operates as a consumer-facing insurance marketplace with a partner/embedded-insurance business but no publicly documented developer API surface.

providers.name: Progressive Insurance
providers.description: One of the largest auto insurance providers in the United States offering personal auto, motorcycle, boat, RV, home, renters, and commercial insurance. Progressive is known for its direct-to-consumer model (1-800-PROGRESSIVE and progressive.com), its independent-agent channel, the comparative rate quoting experience, and the Snapshot usage-based insurance program that prices premiums against telematics-captured driving behaviour from a plug-in OBD-II dongle or the Snapshot mobile app. Progressive also runs the ForAgents agent portal and a public Developer Portal at developer.progressive.com that hosts embedded-quoting APIs for partners — including the Embedded Direct auto quoting API, the Commercial Auto Quoting product, and the Certificate of Insurance API — alongside private B2B integrations with comparative-rater carriers, agency-management systems, and telematics providers.

providers.name: Root Insurance
providers.description: Root is a U.S. app-first auto insurer that prices policies primarily on real driving behavior captured by smartphone telematics. The Root mobile app handles enrollment, telematics scoring, policy management, claims, and optional roadside assistance, with renters insurance as an add-on line. Root has reorganized its tech stack around APIs to power embedded auto insurance with partners such as Carvana and Hyundai Capital America; partner APIs are gated and not publicly documented. Note: Root Insurance (joinroot.com) is distinct from the unrelated Root Platform (rootplatform.com) insurtech in South Africa / UK.

providers.name: Sofia
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican digital health insurance company that modernizes traditional medical coverage for enterprises, individuals, and families. Its plans combine zero-deductible major and minor medical care, preventive care with an assigned primary-care physician, and unlimited no-cost video consultations, all managed through a mobile app and an HR administrative portal. Sofía operates its own integrated medical network (SofíaMed) of hospitals and specialists, offers add-ons such as maternity, mental health, dental, and international coverage, and reimburses claims in an average of five business days. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Sofía positions insurance as a digital-first, member-centric health experience rather than a paper policy.

providers.name: EZLynx
providers.description: EZLynx is an insurance agency platform combining real-time comparative rating, an agency management system (AMS), and CRM for independent property and casualty (P&C) insurance agencies. Part of Applied Systems since 2021, EZLynx offers enterprise API solutions that let agencies push and pull data, create and update applicants, contacts, prospects, and opportunities, create policy headers, retrieve policy and quote-result data, and drive high-volume automated quoting through the EZLynx Rating Engine and Quoting Automation Services (QAS). An event-driven layer emits webhooks in XML or JSON for platform changes. API access is partner and enterprise-gated (contact sales, OAuth 2.0), not a public self-serve developer program, so the API surface below is honestly modeled from EZLynx's public product and integration material rather than a published open reference.

providers.name: hyperexponential
providers.description: hyperexponential (hx) is a London-based insurtech that builds the #1 pricing and underwriting decision platform for commercial property & casualty (P&C) insurance. Its platform - spanning the Hyperoperator agentic assistant, a no-code Workflow Builder, Calculation Engines, and Portfolio Intelligence - lets actuaries and underwriters build, deploy, and iterate pricing models and underwriting workflows without heavy engineering. Carriers use hx to automate submission triage, risk assessment, renewals, portfolio monitoring, and regulatory compliance, with top global carriers running $75bn+ in annual commercial P&C premium on the platform. hyperexponential is backed by a16z and Battery Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and compliance surface; hx does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI, so this repo is enriched from identity, trust-center, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Akur8
providers.description: Akur8 is a cloud-based actuarial AI platform for P&C and life insurers, covering pricing (Data, Risk, Demand, Rate, Rate Repo, Optim, Discover), reserving, and production deployment of rating models. There is no self-serve public developer API or public API reference published on akur8.com; the platform is sold and onboarded as enterprise SaaS through a sales-led, typically two-week free pilot. The one confirmed API capability is Akur8 Deploy - once a pricing model built in Akur8 Rate is finalized, Deploy auto-generates a private, tenant-specific real-time REST rating/scoring endpoint that a customer's own policy admin or quoting system calls at quote time to return a price in milliseconds. Access to that generated endpoint is provisioned per customer within a paid contract, not published for anonymous developer signup; rating tables can also be exported in CSV, JSON, PMML, and POJO formats for offline integration.

providers.name: Cape Analytics
providers.description: Cape Analytics (now part of Moody's) is a geospatial property intelligence provider that applies computer vision and machine learning to high-resolution aerial and satellite imagery, property records, and other novel data sources to produce inspection-quality condition and characteristic data for over 100 million residential and commercial structures across the United States and Canada. Its insights — roof condition and material, swimming pools, solar panels, accessory structures, tree overhang, wildfire and wind exposure, distance to hazards, and a proprietary Liquidity Score — are delivered to insurance underwriters, lenders, and real estate investors in under two seconds via API, batch/bulk files, an Automated Property Condition Report (aPCR), and a customer web portal, as well as through third-party platforms such as Guidewire and Duck Creek. Cape does not publish a public, self-service developer portal or open API specification; API access is provisioned to customers and partners through a gated onboarding flow.

providers.name: Chubb
providers.description: Chubb Limited is the world's largest publicly traded property and casualty (P&C) insurance company, serving consumers, small businesses, and multinational corporations across 54 countries and territories. Chubb offers commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance, and life insurance. The company manages more than $200B in global assets, paid $21B in claims (2023), and offers more than 200 insurance products and services. Key personal lines include homeowners, auto, valuables (jewelry, arts, wine), boat and yacht, pet (through a Healthy Paws partnership), and travel insurance. Commercial lines include small business, accident and health, commercial package, cyber, management liability, marine, professional liability, workers' compensation, and industry-specialty programs (construction, financial institutions, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing, real estate, technology, climate). Chubb Studio is the company's embedded insurance technology platform offering APIs and SDKs for partners to integrate Chubb insurance products into their own digital experiences.

providers.name: Ethos
providers.description: Ethos is a US digital life insurance company headquartered in San Francisco, founded in 2016, offering term life, whole life, and indexed universal life policies through an online, mostly no-medical-exam application flow. Ethos operates as a technology-driven insurance agency, distributing policies underwritten by carriers such as Ameritas, Banner Life (Legal & General America), Protective, and TruStage. Coverage is available in 49 states and Washington, D.C., with term policies offered for 10, 15, 20, 30, and 40 year durations and face amounts ranging from $15,000 to $3 million. The company has raised over $400 million from investors including Goldman Sachs, SoftBank, GV, Sequoia, and Accel, and is widely cited as one of the leading insurtech companies modernizing the life insurance buying experience. Ethos exposes a Partnership API that lets approved business partners embed quoting, identity validation, instant underwriting, application capture, billing, and signed policy issuance directly into their own products. The Partnership API uses bearer-token authentication tied to a partner API key and per-applicant session, and consolidates steps such as identity validation and quoting into combined endpoints to enable instant decisioning. There is no public, self-serve OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer signup; access requires a partnership agreement with Ethos. Ethos's only material open-source footprint is the ethos-design-system React component library on GitHub.

providers.name: Grow Therapy
providers.description: Grow Therapy is a mental-health platform that connects individuals with licensed therapists and prescribers, offering virtual and in-person talk therapy plus medication management in one insurance-integrated experience. The company operates a two-sided marketplace: a client-facing product for finding, booking, and paying for care (with insurance verification and an average session cost around $21 for covered clients) and a provider portal that gives clinicians scheduling, billing, telehealth, and practice-management tooling. Grow also partners with employers, physicians, and payors on B2B mental-health access. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; Grow Therapy publishes a public Statuspage but does not expose a public developer API, so this profile captures its company identity, operational transparency, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Newfront
providers.description: Newfront is a modern business insurance brokerage and technology company headquartered in San Francisco. It combines a traditional insurance brokerage (commercial business insurance, employee benefits, retirement services, and risk management) with a software platform that gives clients transparent data and analytics to understand and lower their total cost of risk. Formed from the merger of Newfront and ABD Insurance, the company serves technology, venture-backed, and enterprise clients across property and casualty, health and benefits, and personal lines. Backed by Index Ventures, Susa Ventures, and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass Newfront exposes a client-facing web application (app.newfront.com) but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: ERGO NEXT Insurance
providers.description: ERGO NEXT Insurance (formerly NEXT Insurance) is a Palo Alto, California technology-first Property & Casualty insurer focused on the specific needs of U.S. small and medium-sized business owners. Founded in 2016, the company offers fully digital commercial coverage including General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Business Owner's Policy (BOP), Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Tools & Equipment, Employment Practices Liability, Product Liability, and Liquor Liability — serving more than 750,000 customers across 1,300+ professions. In March 2025 Munich Re signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of NEXT Insurance at a valuation of $2.6 billion; ERGO Group AG (Munich Re's primary insurance arm) closed the full acquisition on July 1, 2025 and on January 15, 2026 the company rebranded as ERGO NEXT Insurance, becoming Munich Re/ERGO's foothold in the U.S. SMB market. ERGO NEXT's partner-facing surface is NEXT Connect, an embedded insurance platform that lets payroll, point-of-sale, accounting, e-commerce, payments, banking, and fintech platforms quote and bind small-business coverage from within their own product through low-code components and API calls. NEXT Connect aggregates 15+ carriers (including ERGO NEXT itself, Travelers, Liberty Mutual, Chubb, CNA, The Hartford) and is documented in the wild through embedded-payroll partners such as Check, Gusto Embedded, Intuit QuickBooks, Square, LegalZoom, and Amazon Business Prime, but ERGO NEXT does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve SDKs — partner onboarding is gated through a partnerships team. The company also offers a pay-as-you-go Workers' Comp product that integrates with partner payroll runs so premium is calculated against actual per-cycle W-2 wages.

providers.name: Prescience Inc
providers.description: Prescience, Inc. is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) health benefits platform for employers, building "healthcare for the age of abundant intelligence." It uses machine-learning underwriting to design custom, largely self-insured health plans that aim to cut employer healthcare spend 20-50% versus traditional PEO and insurer plans, pairing $0-deductible coverage, included GLP-1 medications, wearables, and a 24/7 AI Care Companion for members. The company sells to employers, private-equity portfolios, and providers, and publicly attests to SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance. As of this profile it exposes a marketing and member/employer web application only - no public API, developer portal, SDKs, MCP server, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Kita Bisa
providers.description: Kitabisa is Indonesia's largest donation-based crowdfunding and mutual-aid platform, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Jakarta. It lets individuals, nonprofits, and corporations raise and give funds transparently for medical causes, disaster relief, education, and community development, and operates a dedicated Islamic-philanthropy surface for zakat, wakaf, and qurban. The group has grown beyond crowdfunding into digital fundraising services for NGOs (ngo.kitabisa.com), a CSR and social-marketing practice for corporate partners (csr.kitabisa.com), a cooperative, and the SalingJaga mutual-protection and insurance product. Kitabisa publishes no public API or developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition on any Kitabisa surface, and partner integrations are arranged through business channels. It does run a substantial first-party open source estate of 75 public Go, TypeScript, and GitHub Actions repositories, plus a public responsible-disclosure program backed by an RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: TIFIN
providers.description: TIFIN is a Boulder, Colorado based fintech company founded in 2018 by Dr. Vinay Nair that builds AI-driven wealth technology for financial advisors, RIAs, broker-dealers, asset managers and insurance firms. Its platforms span TIFIN.AI (an agentic operating system consolidating the group's AI businesses for wealth and asset management workflows), TIFIN Wealth (investment proposal, risk-capacity and client-personalization tooling that integrates with Fidelity, BNY Pershing, Black Diamond, Salesforce, Wealthbox, Redtail, Orion and iRebal), TIFIN AMP/AG for asset-manager distribution intelligence, TIFIN Give for charitable giving accounts, TIFIN @Work for workplace financial wellness, and Magnifi, an AI investing assistant. TIFIN incubated 55ip (sold to J.P. Morgan) and Paralel, and announced a joint venture, TIFIN.AI, with J.P. Morgan Asset Management. The company states its AI capabilities are available as APIs that plug into existing wealthtech stacks, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract; access is gated behind a "Get access" request form.

providers.name: Corgi
providers.description: Corgi is an AI-native, full-stack business insurance platform for startups, offering modular coverage (Commercial General Liability, Directors & Officers, Tech Errors & Omissions, Cyber, EPLI, and fiduciary) quoted in minutes. Founded in 2024 and based in San Francisco, Corgi is a licensed insurance carrier rather than a broker, underwriting and issuing policies directly with pricing tailored to a startup's stage (pre-seed, Series A, growth). Backed by Kindred Ventures and TCV, the company was reported as an AI insurance unicorn in 2026. This API Evangelist profile was seeded from Kindred Ventures' portfolio; Corgi does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: LeaseLock
providers.description: LeaseLock is an insurtech platform for rental housing that replaces the traditional cash security deposit with lease insurance. Its Zero Deposit program embeds coverage into the lease through a signed addendum, removing thousands of dollars of move-in cost for residents while protecting owners and operators against unpaid rent and damage. LeaseLock Shield applies AI to ledger data, market trends and lease profiles to underwrite risk, and LeaseLock Central gives property teams a portal for claims, support tickets and training. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Dallas, Texas, the company says it integrates with all major property management systems, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference or client SDKs — integration is arranged as a managed engagement. Its public engineering output is two open-source PostgreSQL extensions, pgasync and pgflow.

providers.name: Lemonaide
providers.description: Lemonaide is a Bangkok-headquartered B2B used-car and insurtech platform operating across Southeast Asia, positioning itself as a technology and services layer that reduces asymmetric information in the automotive market. The company sells software to used-car dealerships and insurers, including a Dealer Management System, a Dealer CRM with microtargeting, and a Digital Escrow settlement product, alongside operated services such as after-sales BPO, warranty third-party administration, 24-hour digital roadside assistance, vehicle inspection, and repair-workshop audit assessment. Lemonaide states that more than 2,000 dealers use its platform and names Carro, Carsome, and Toyota Sure among its partners. It is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Lemonaide publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Zensurance
providers.description: Zensurance is a Toronto-based digital commercial insurance brokerage founded in 2016 that sells small-business and freelancer coverage online across every Canadian province, placing risk with Canadian carriers rather than underwriting it. Its book is commercial property and casualty — general and commercial general liability, professional liability and errors and omissions, cyber liability, directors and officers, commercial property, commercial auto, builder's risk, and a long tail of trade- and profession-specific packages — sold through a quote-to-bind web flow marketed as an instant online price with licensed broker support and claims advocacy behind it. It sits in the thin digital-broker layer beneath Canada's Big-Few carrier oligopoly, in a market with no open-insurance mandate — OSFI supervises federally-regulated insurers prudentially while FSRA, the AMF, and the other provincial regulators own market conduct, and Consumer-Driven Banking excludes insurance outright. Its API posture reflects that. Zensurance publishes no public, self-serve developer portal, no reference documentation, and no downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI definition. The company's partnership page advertises "seamless API integrations and co-branded white-label tools" for distribution partners, but the only route to that surface is a partnership application form — the integration is partner-gated and privately negotiated. A first-party host at api.zensurance.com answers on the public internet (HTTP 200, returning a bare version string, with a /health endpoint) but it is the undocumented backend for Zensurance's own quoting and policy application, not a published product API. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS, or agency-management-system integration claim appears anywhere on the company's public web properties. The one machine-addressable surface the company does publish for automated consumers is an llms.txt at www.zensurance.com/llms.txt — a 178KB marketing index of its pages, blog posts, and FAQs (which inadvertently lists its zenstage.wpengine.com staging host rather than the production domain). It describes insurance products for AI assistants; it documents no API.

providers.name: BetterView Marketplace
providers.description: Betterview is a market-leading Property Intelligence platform that delivers actionable insights to property & casualty insurance underwriters, agents, and insureds to increase efficiency and profitability. Its API lets carriers order and retrieve property profiles enriched with the Roof Spotlight Index (RSI), peril risks, flags, and third-party Partner Connect data, subscribe properties to PropertyPulse monitoring, and query PropertyNow pre-processed datasets by address or coordinates. Betterview integrates with core insurance systems including Guidewire (a Marketplace accelerator for PolicyCenter 10), Duck Creek, and Socotra, and supports SSO, Secure FTP, ImageRight drop, an embeddable geospatial iframe UI, and an External Data Warehouse (EDW) SQL connection.

providers.name: Oscar
providers.description: Oscar Health (NYSE: OSCR) is a technology-driven health insurance company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City. It offers individual and family health plans, small-business and ICHRA employer benefits, and Medicare Advantage in a growing set of U.S. states, pairing coverage with a consumer mobile app, 24/7 virtual urgent care, telemedicine, primary care, and concierge Care Teams. Oscar's +Oscar division licenses its full-stack technology platform (Campaign Builder and other tools) to other payers and providers. The company is NCQA-accredited across Health Plan, Utilization Management, Credentialing, Provider Network, and Health Equity programs. Oscar is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As a CMS-regulated payer it is subject to the Interoperability and Patient Access rule, though it does not currently publish an open, self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Berry Street
providers.description: Berry Street is a telehealth platform that connects patients with board-certified, registered dietitians for virtual, insurance-covered nutrition therapy. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

providers.name: Bruce
providers.description: Bruce is a curated professional intro network for licensed real estate, mortgage, title & escrow, and insurance professionals, built by Tanda Technologies, Inc. and founded by Jesse Chor. Rather than a directory, review site, or CRM, Bruce verifies each member's license and role, then lets them log intros and build a portable, verifiable track record. The Bruce Card is each member's living profile — stats, deals, intros, and market rank — that replaces the resume and the "trust me" claim with a sharable credential. Bruce also runs an AI-hosted editorial publication at blog.bruce.bot that profiles verified members in interview-style stories. Backed by Initialized Capital; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

providers.name: Insurify
providers.description: Insurify is an insurance comparison marketplace licensed in all 50 U.S. states with real-time API integrations into 120+ carriers (500+ across the carrier network), covering auto, home, renters, pet, commercial auto, life, motorcycle, and travel. Consumers get side-by-side quotes in roughly two minutes and can buy online or through licensed agents. Insurify's Evia AI agent (Expert Virtual Insurance Agent) is a voice-and-chat agent that handles end-to-end shopping conversations with bind-ready quotes and renewal-cycle re-shopping. In February 2026 Insurify launched the insurance industry's first ChatGPT app via OpenAI's app library.

providers.name: Pawp
providers.description: Pawp is a veterinary telemedicine membership service that gives pet owners 24/7 access to licensed veterinary professionals via text, video, and phone. For a flat annual membership, members get unlimited on-demand consultations with vets, nurses, and technicians who each carry a minimum of five years of clinical experience, along with personalized care plans and follow-up guidance for both emergencies and routine questions. Pawp operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Mutual of Omaha
providers.description: Mutual of Omaha is a Fortune 500 mutual insurance and financial services company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, providing life, disability, dental, vision, critical illness, accident and long-term care insurance, Medicare supplement and Medicare Advantage plans, annuities, retirement services, mortgage lending and investment products to individuals, employers and groups across the United States. Its Workplace Solutions unit runs an API integration program for group and voluntary benefits — Plan Setup, Evidence of Insurability and Enrollment — but those APIs are delivered through benefits administration platform partners such as ADP Workforce Now, bswift, Employee Navigator and PlanSource rather than through a public developer portal, and no machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: Nirvana Tech
providers.description: Nirvana Insurance (Nirvana Tech, Inc.) is a technology-driven commercial trucking insurance provider that pairs A-rated fleet insurance coverage with an AI-powered active safety platform. Nirvana ingests telematics and connected-vehicle data from motor carriers to price risk more accurately, help fleets save up to 20% on premiums, and reduce accidents through real-time safety alerts, driver coaching, and predictive risk scoring. The company serves fleets and independent insurance agents through a digital quoting and policy-management agent portal, and is backed by General Catalyst. Nirvana raised a Series D round to expand its data-driven insurance and safety products across the trucking industry. As of this profile Nirvana operates a marketing site plus an agent sign-in portal and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Grandhood
providers.description: Grandhood is a Danish digital pension provider that lets companies set up and run a modern workplace (company) pension scheme entirely online, without the traditional adviser meetings and paperwork. Employers register with MitID, invite employees, and activate a plan; employees enroll, get built-in digital pension counselling, choose an investment profile, consolidate scattered pension savings, and see real-time savings, returns, and insurance coverage in the Grandhood mobile app. Pensions bundle both long-term savings and present-day insurance protection. Pricing is a simple fixed monthly amount per employee (65-95 DKK/month) plus investment costs, with no deposit-percentage fees and free pension advice. The underlying pension administration is backed by Velliv, Denmark's third-largest pension company. Grandhood is based in Copenhagen (Esplanaden 14B, 1263 København K; CVR 44147750) and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. Grandhood publishes consumer web and mobile-app products; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Insuretech Connect
providers.description: InsureTech Connect (ITC) is the world's largest insurance innovation event series, produced by Clarion Events. Its flagship, ITC Vegas, brings together 9,000+ insurance carriers, insurtech startups, brokers, reinsurers, and investors for three days of content, networking, and dealmaking, with regional editions in Europe and Asia. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qed-investors and added to the API Evangelist network. ITC is an events and media brand; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or event webhooks, so this entry carries company identity and probed domain-security signals only.

providers.name: UNest
providers.description: UNest is a Los Angeles-based fintech app that helps parents and families save and invest for their children's futures through UTMA/UGMA custodial investment accounts, with brand rewards contributions, gifting, financial literacy content, and term life insurance offered through Ladder. UNest Advisers, LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser, with brokerage through UNest Securities, LLC (FINRA/SIPC) and clearing through Apex Clearing. The company is a consumer mobile-app business and publishes no public developer API, though its site ships a real llms.txt. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Acturis
providers.description: Acturis is a United Kingdom insurance software company founded in 2000 by David McDonald and Theo Duchen, operating the UK's leading multi-tenant SaaS platform for general insurance brokers, insurers and MGAs. The Acturis system covers commercial and personal lines broking, e-trade and digital distribution, policy administration, claims, document management, premium finance and accounting, and it builds and runs eight of the top ten UK insurer extranets. Acturis Group extends the platform into Germany, France and Canada (through the acquisitions of Power Broker and Brovada) and reports over 100,000 users across more than 40 countries. Its API posture is partner-gated and honestly not developer-facing: acturis.com markets an "API-enabled platform" and "API capabilities" but publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or Swagger definition, and no self-serve onboarding. developer.acturis.com, developers.acturis.com, docs.acturis.com and api.acturis.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer and /integrations all return 404. Real integration happens through commercial agreements — insurer extranet and e-trade connections, the Polaris imarket digital-trading standards Acturis has traded on since 2005, and named bilateral work such as the Aviva claims Broker API launched in December 2024, which brokers enable through an Aviva Claims Service Manager or an Acturis Account Manager rather than through any public signup.

providers.name: Concirrus
providers.description: Concirrus Ltd is a London-headquartered insurtech founded in 2012 that builds AI-driven underwriting software for the specialty and commercial insurance market — marine (hull, cargo, P&I), aviation, construction, property, and political violence and terrorism. Its platform (Quest, Marine One, the Underwriting Workbench, Exposure Management, Loss Run Intelligence, and an "Enterprise Model" universal submission-ingestion layer) ingests broker submissions, structures the risk data, scores behavioural risk, and returns rating and exposure decisions to carriers, MGAs and brokers — much of it aimed at the Lloyd's and London subscription market. Concirrus is a vendor to insurers rather than an insurer itself, so it touches quote and rating rather than bind, issue or FNOL. Its API posture is partner-gated: marketing describes "a modular, API first platform" and "seamless integration with London Market platforms", but as of 2026-07-25 there is no public developer portal, no published API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, no Postman collection, and no public GraphQL or webhook catalog. Every developer and docs hostname probed (developer./developers./docs./api. on both concirrus.com and concirrus.ai) does not resolve, and every on-site developer path returns 404. Integration is obtained through a commercial engagement or the partner ecosystem programme, not self-serve signup. No ACORD, AL3, NGDS or ACORD XML reference appears anywhere on the public site. Concirrus does publish a real compliance posture: in August 2025 it announced ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management), ISO/IEC 27001 (information security) and SOC 2 certification, claiming to be the first insurtech to hold all three — though no trust center or downloadable report accompanies the announcement.

providers.name: Luko
providers.description: Luko is an online home, travel, and auto insurance provider founded in France in 2016 and now operating as Luko by Allianz Direct after its acquisition by the Allianz group. It sells rental, owner-occupied, non-occupant-owner (PNO), student, and co-housing home policies from around EUR 5 per month, plus travel and Eurofil-partnered auto cover, with sub-two-minute online subscription, instant attestations, digital claims declaration through a customer account portal, and 24/7 emergency support. Originally a VC-backed insurtech (Accel, Speedinvest), Luko today runs as a consumer insurance brand with no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface; this profile captures its verifiable security and identity footprint.

providers.name: Ottonova
providers.description: Ottonova is a Munich-based digital private health insurance provider (private Krankenversicherung) founded in 2015, positioned as "the insurance for the mobile age." It sells private full health insurance and supplementary dental and hospital coverage to consumers in Germany, delivering onboarding, claims, a concierge medical service and digital health records through its mobile app rather than through a public developer API. Ottonova is backed by venture investors including Earlybird and HV Capital and operates in the insurtech sector. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio-lead stub and has been through one enrichment pass: probing confirmed a consumer web presence with a published RFC 9116 security.txt but no public API surface (no developer portal, OpenAPI, OAuth/OpenID metadata, or API catalog).

providers.name: AllCare
providers.description: AllCare is a Philippines-based digital employee-benefits and healthcare membership platform for freelancers and small-to-medium enterprises. It aggregates worker benefits that individuals and small teams would otherwise struggle to access, bundling HMO coverage, group life insurance, 24/7 teleconsultation, dental and optical care, mental-health counseling, annual physical exams, and productivity perks into flat-rate membership packages. Its SME Benefits Package is sold on an annual per-employee basis (minimum five employees) and is managed through a web dashboard for enrollment, member management, and benefit utilization. AllCare is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare/insurtech company profile.

providers.name: First American Financial
providers.description: First American Financial is a leading provider of title insurance, settlement services, and risk solutions for real estate transactions, as well as related products and services. First American operates a developer portal exposing APIs for office lookup, order management, document exchange, messaging, and webhook notifications.

providers.name: Nova Benefits
providers.description: Nova Benefits is an India-based employee health and benefits platform that provides group health insurance, super top-up plans, and COVID-19 cover alongside wellness services such as telehealth consultations, mental-wellness support, fitness programs, maternity benefits, and annual health, dental and vision checkups. It gives HR teams an employer dashboard for administering benefits and managing claims, and gives employees web and mobile (iOS/Android) apps to view coverage, book consultations, and file and track claims. The company reports serving 500+ companies covering 200,000+ employees, is ISO 27001:2022 certified and SOC 2 Type II compliant, and operates as an IRDAI-regulated insurance broker. Nova Benefits publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Safely
providers.description: Safely (SafelyStay, Inc.) is an InsurTech company providing short-term rental insurance, guest screening, and travel insurance for vacation rental property managers and their guests. The Safely Protection Policy offers up to $1,000,000 in short-term rental insurance covering guest-caused accidental and intentional damage, theft, pet damage, and bodily injury liability, while its guest screening verifies guests before check-in. Safely connects to property management systems through turnkey partner integrations (Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, OwnerRez, Track, Streamline, Escapia, Lodgify, and more) rather than a public developer API. A Techstars-backed company added to the API Evangelist network; this profile was enriched by the pipeline, which found no public API surface.

providers.name: Sofía
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican health insurance company (aseguradora) offering medical coverage for individuals, families, and businesses, delivered primarily through a mobile app with plans that carry no deductibles. Regulated in Mexico by the CNSF, Secretaría de Salud, and CONDUSEF, and backed by Index Ventures. This is a consumer/enterprise insurance provider surfaced as a portfolio-company lead; a live probe of the public surface found no developer program, API, or /.well-known/ discovery documents, so this profile remains identity-only pending any future API exposure.

providers.name: Amperos Health
providers.description: Amperos Health (Amperos) is an AI-native insurance revenue recovery platform for healthcare providers. It uses agentic AI together with experienced revenue cycle management (RCM) specialists to run the full insurance collections process, from claim submission through denial resolution to payment. The platform automates first-touch routine tasks, works complex denials with specialist oversight, and adapts configurable workflows to each organization's procedures across specialties including orthopedics, cardiology, behavioral health, DME/HME, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, dermatology, urology, dental, and oncology. Amperos reports outcomes such as higher claim recovery, reduced accounts receivable backlogs, and lower cost to collect for the healthcare providers it serves. The company is backed by Uncork Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company. Amperos currently exposes a marketing and demo-request surface rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties and security posture.

providers.name: Goose Insurance
providers.description: Goose Insurance Services Inc. is a Vancouver, British Columbia based digital insurance distributor — an app-first licensed agency and MGA rather than a carrier — that sells travel medical, Visitors to Canada, term life, whole life, final expense, critical illness, accidental death and dismemberment, hospital cash, kids and renters coverage through the Goose mobile "insurance super app". Founded in 2017 and licensed in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec (AMF firm registration 603913), New Brunswick and Nova Scotia, Goose underwrites nothing itself: every policy is placed with a partner carrier including AIG Canada, iA Financial Group, TuGo, IMG, MSH, American-Amicable, Teachers Life, Lloyd's of London and Sutton National. Its home market is Canada, with a US launch in 2020, and it sits in the thin digital-broker layer beneath the Big-Few Canadian oligopoly alongside Zensurance and APOLLO. Goose's API posture is closed: as of the 2026-07-25 review there is no public developer portal, no self-serve API documentation, no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger, and no published ACORD, AL3 or agency-management-system integration. The only host that answers on the api. subdomain is a private Heroku-backed mobile-app backend that returns 404 at every probed path, and the only partner surfaces the company publishes are a marketing affiliate/referral program and a carrier-relationships page — quote, bind, issue and FNOL are all consumer-facing inside the app only.

providers.name: Selective Insurance Group
providers.description: Selective Insurance Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: SIGI) is a Branchville, New Jersey holding company whose insurance subsidiaries underwrite standard commercial lines, standard personal lines, and excess and surplus lines property and casualty insurance, plus flood insurance written through the National Flood Insurance Program's Write Your Own program. Coverage is distributed exclusively through independent insurance agents and brokers across the Eastern and Midwestern United States. Selective operates customer and agent self-service portals (MySelective, and the agent portal at customer1.selectiveinsurance.com) and supports policy, billing and claims download into agency management systems, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract as of this profile.

providers.name: Finkargo
providers.description: Finkargo is a Latin American foreign-trade commerce platform that helps importers overcome the operational and financial barriers to growing their import businesses. Its product suite spans Paga (alternative supplier financing with revolving USD credit lines and 30-150 day terms), Analiza (market-intelligence dashboards that turn trade data into strategic decisions), Verifica (global supplier verification for product quality and legitimacy), and Protege (warehouse-to-warehouse cargo insurance). Operating across Colombia and Mexico and backed by QED Investors, Finkargo digitizes the full import-operations lifecycle from evaluating suppliers and planning imports to financing, transport, and arrival. Finkargo does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures the company's public product, legal, and security surfaces.

providers.name: Lockton
providers.description: Lockton Companies is the world's largest privately held, independent insurance brokerage, founded by Jack Lockton in 1966 and headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, United States. Lockton is a broker and intermediary rather than a risk carrier: it places commercial property and casualty, specialty and financial lines, employee benefits and people solutions, private client coverage, and — through Lockton Re — treaty and facultative reinsurance, for tens of thousands of clients across a global network of associates and offices reaching more than 140 locations. Its API posture is honestly characterized as partner-gated with no public API surface. As of July 2026 Lockton publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or Swagger definition, no GraphQL endpoint, no Postman workspace, and no webhook or event catalog. The hostnames developer.lockton.com, developers.lockton.com, docs.lockton.com and api.lockton.com do not resolve in DNS, and a crawl of the 6,953 URLs in global.lockton.com/sitemap.xml surfaces no developer, API, ACORD, IVANS, OpenAPI or Swagger path. Client-facing technology is delivered through authenticated regional Lockton Client Portals and the proprietary Lockton SAGE intelligence and analytics ecosystem, which is presented on the website behind a contact form with no self-serve access, no documented data feed and no published integration surface. This is the expected posture for a US broker-intermediary: the United States has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate, so data exchange between carriers, brokers and agency management systems runs on ACORD standards in an EDI and forms idiom rather than a public API idiom. Lockton's most substantive standards signal is governance rather than implementation — in July 2026 Nidhi Howell, Chief Business Technology Officer of Lockton Re, was appointed to the ACORD Solutions Group Board of Directors representing the reinsurance broking channel — but no ACORD AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS or IVANS agency-download implementation is documented on any public Lockton property.

providers.name: Papernest
providers.description: Papernest is a French technology company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Paris, that provides a digital platform for managing, switching, and cancelling household subscriptions — energy, telecom and internet, mobile plans, and home insurance — through a single interface. Built around the moment people move home, the service is free to end users and monetized through commissions from supplier partners across France, Spain, Italy, and the UK, having helped more than 3 million customers. Papernest does not publish a public developer API; it runs a private B2B partner integration program and maintains an official GitHub organization of archived open-source utilities.

providers.name: Rula
providers.description: Rula is a telehealth mental health platform that connects patients with licensed therapists and psychiatric providers who accept their insurance. Operating as an in-network behavioral health marketplace across all 50 states, Rula matches individuals with more than 23,000 licensed clinicians for individual, couples, family, child, and teen therapy as well as psychiatric medication management, covering 90+ conditions including anxiety, depression, ADHD, PTSD, OCD, and addiction. Rula is in-network with 120+ insurance plans nationwide (Aetna, Cigna, Optum, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross, Kaiser), with patients paying an average of about $15 per session with insurance. Rula publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or partner API surface as of this profile; care is delivered through its patient and provider web applications.

providers.name: Wallet Studio
providers.description: Wallet Studio, built by Miss Moneypenny Technologies GmbH, is a no-code SaaS platform for creating, deploying, and managing Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes. Aimed primarily at insurance carriers, it turns policy administration, claims, and CRM systems into wallet-based customer engagement channels reaching the four billion people who already carry a digital wallet, without replacing existing backend infrastructure. The platform offers visual pass editors with one-click publishing, prebuilt insurance templates, integrated automation, a REST API and webhooks for connecting to third-party systems, and authenticated links to portals and value-added services. Hosting is GDPR-compliant and the company describes the platform as certified for enterprise security standards. Backed by Earlybird, the company raised roughly EUR 7 million in 2025. There is no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI specification; the REST API is provisioned per customer.

providers.name: Intact Financial
providers.description: Intact Financial Corporation is the largest provider of property and casualty insurance in Canada, headquartered in Toronto and trading on the TSX as IFC. It underwrites personal auto, personal property, and commercial P&C lines through the Intact Insurance, belairdirect, BrokerLink, Intact Prestige, Intact Public Entities, and On Side Restoration brands in Canada, through Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions in the United States, and through Intact Insurance UK, EU, IE and 123.ie internationally following the 2021 acquisition of RSA. Distribution runs through a network of more than 6,000 independent broker offices plus direct-to-consumer channels. Its API posture is partner-gated and closed. There is no public, self-serve developer portal, no published API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI artifact on any Intact domain probed. developer/developers/docs/api subdomains on intactfc.com and intact.ca do not resolve; /developers, /api, /developer and /partners return 404. The only integration surfaces are login walls — the Intact Portal for brokers at portal.intactinsurance.com (brokers.intact.ca redirects there) and the customer Client Centre behind IBM Security WebSEAL at apps.intactinsurance.com. Broker connectivity in Canada is mediated by CSIO, the industry standards body whose EDI, XML, eDocs and JSON API standards are the Canadian analogue of ACORD. Intact Insurance is listed in the CSIO member directory but appears on none of CSIO's certified-member lists (eDocs, CL Data, Compliance/Z-code, API Security Standards, JSON API Standards) and is recorded as "Not Yet Rated" on both the personal and commercial tracks of CSIO's 2026 Standards Certification Ratings. No ACORD reference was found anywhere on the company's public web properties.

providers.name: InventoryQuant
providers.description: InventoryQuant automates inventory and contents documentation for the insurance claims industry. Public adjusters, restoration firms, and insurance claim handlers record video or audio walkthroughs of a loss, and the platform transcribes each spoken line item, detects and describes the contents, matches replacement pricing from major retailers, and generates a submission-ready report in XactContents or PDF format. It supports smart glasses, photos, multiple speakers, self-corrections, background noise, and 100+ languages, turning days of manual contents-claim work into minutes. Founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch by Sander Schulhoff.

providers.name: Stere
providers.description: Stere is a New York-based insurance infrastructure company (founded 2021) that lets insurers, MGAs, and distribution partners build and launch digital insurance products - rating, quoting, binding, policy issuance, claims, and premium payments - in weeks rather than years. Its core offering is a "Stere API-as-a-Service" underwriting API (insurers can bring their own API or have Stere build one) plus a separate Stere Unified API and Stere Distribution layer that let brokers, wholesalers, fintechs, and embedded partners reach multiple carriers/products through a single connection (API, SDK, and webhooks). Stere Claims handles FNOL and claims workflow (portions of claims assessment and resolution are marketed as in-development/coming soon), and Stere Pay / Stere Pay Later provides a buy-now-pay-later gateway for insurance premiums. There is no self-serve public developer portal, published API reference, OpenAPI/Swagger document, or sandbox signup on stere.io; the marketing site references a "Stere Docs," "API Changelog," and "API Status" area under /developer/, but those paths return 404 publicly and integration is provisioned per customer after a sales-led partner/insurer onboarding engagement. The APIs below are honestly modeled from Stere's own product marketing pages, not from a published API reference.

providers.name: Waffle Labs
providers.description: Waffle Labs, Inc. (Waffle Insurance) is a consumer InsurTech company and licensed digital insurance agency, founded at MIT and accelerated through Barclays Techstars and MIT Delta V. Waffle offers an all-in-one, mobile-first platform that lets consumers get quotes and bind coverage in under 90 seconds across renters, pet, home & auto, term life, personal cyber, and travel insurance in all 50 US states, partnering with vetted carriers rather than underwriting risk itself. The company also runs an embedded-insurance program that lets partners offer Waffle products through a no-code embed. Waffle is a consumer/partner product with no public developer program or API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PB Health
providers.description: PB Health (PB Healthcare Service Pvt Ltd) is an India-based consumer healthcare network offering end-to-end care through a single app - online doctor consultations, hospital visits and admissions, lab tests and radiology scans, medicine ordering, diabetes and obesity management, preventive health packages, and structured home care and recovery. The platform spans top specialities including cardiology, gastroenterology, orthopaedics, pulmonology, internal medicine, gynaecology, ENT, paediatrics, and minimal-access and bariatric surgery, and helps families coordinate their complete health and insurance journey. PB Health is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and website; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Sonnet Insurance
providers.description: Sonnet Insurance is a Canadian direct-to-consumer digital property and casualty insurer launched in 2016 and a member of the Definity family of companies, underwriting its own auto, home, condo, tenant, landlord and pet policies through Sonnet Insurance Company. It sells auto, home, condo, tenant and landlord coverage in Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island, and home-only coverage in British Columbia and Alberta, positioning itself as "Canada's original digital-first home and auto insurance company" with a fully online quote-and-buy flow and licensed agents for support.
