Sonnet is an explicit direct writer -- its own FAQ states that "a third party -- even a licensed broker -- cannot purchase a Sonnet policy on your behalf" -- so it operates no broker or agency distribution channel and therefore no ACORD/AL3 agency-download path. Its API posture is closed -- no developer, developers, docs or api subdomain resolves in DNS, every first-party developer path probed returns HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, Postman collection, webhook catalog or partner technical onboarding surface is published. The only third-party integrations Sonnet describes -- the Kanetix.ca (RATESDOTCA) quote-and-buy partnership and the Sonnet Connect brand referral program -- are privately negotiated commercial arrangements with no public technical documentation. Two machine-readable surfaces do exist and are captured here. Sonnet serves a real llms.txt at www.sonnet.ca/llms.txt that declares per-agent AI-Training, AI-Generation, AI-Summarization and AI-Crawling directives (Allow for OpenAI, Google-DeepMind and Anthropic) alongside a curated reference-content index -- an AI consent signal rather than an API contract. And the secure.sonnet.ca quote-and-buy application is driven by an undocumented first-party REST/JSON surface under /api/v1 covering quoting, binding, policy servicing, payments and identity; it is observable from Sonnet's own public JavaScript bundle but carries no documentation, no specification and no third-party terms of use, so it is recorded as observed evidence, not as an integratable API.

providers.name: Onlia
providers.description: Onlia is a Canadian digital insurance brokerage, operating as the registered business name of Onlia Agency Inc. and backed by Southampton Financial Inc. (the Southampton group of companies). It sells personal lines direct to consumers online and by phone — auto (car, motorcycle, ATV, snowmobile, trailer, motorhome), property (home, condo, tenant, landlord, second home, mobile home) and lifestyle lines (boat, pet, life, travel, seasonal) — plus group and bundle programs. Onlia does not underwrite; it places business with a panel of Canadian carriers disclosed publicly on its broker-disclosure page, including Aviva, Gore Mutual, Economical/Definity, Pembridge, Pafco, Echelon, Wawanesa, Unica, Forward, Premier, Facility Association (Intact) and APOLLO. Its home market is Canada, concentrated in Ontario, where market conduct sits with FSRA while OSFI supervises the federally-regulated carriers behind the policies. API posture, recorded honestly: Onlia publishes NO public developer portal and NO self-serve API. developer., developers., docs. and api. under onlia.ca do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer and /integrations on the marketing site all return 404. The only quote/bind/issue/FNOL surface is app.onlia.ca, a consumer-facing Angular single-page app running on a white-labelled Ignite Insurance policy administration platform whose backend is private to the app. The one "partner" page is a B2B marketing page inviting affinity discount partnerships by email, with no technical onboarding. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference appears anywhere on the public site. The app's own bundle shows the private backend runs on MuleSoft Anypoint CloudHub ESB services (auto and home policy, authentication, documents, VIN/MVR, claims) plus an Ignite Insurance authentication service — real REST plumbing behind the SPA, but undocumented, uncredentialed and not offered to third parties, so no API entry is claimed here.

providers.name: Vouch
providers.description: Vouch is a San Francisco, California business insurance broker and risk advisor purpose-built for high-growth startups and the venture ecosystem. Founded in 2018 by Sam Hodges and Travis Hedge and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital, SVB Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Y Combinator, and MS&AD Ventures, Vouch offers a tailored portfolio of commercial coverages — Directors & Officers (D&O), Errors & Omissions (E&O / Tech E&O / Professional Services E&O), Cyber, Employment Practices Liability (EPL), General Liability, Business Property, Fiduciary, Crime, and contract-required coverages — sold to technology, healthcare and life sciences, financial services, and professional services companies. The business model is broker-of-record commissions and, since 2021, a Vouch-owned insurance carrier underwriting select lines. Vouch is best known in the developer community for its embedded insurance program, which lets ecosystem partners (Carta, StartupOS, and similar founder platforms) pre-fill applications, surface quotes, and bind coverage inline via Vouch's partner API. Public developer documentation, an OpenAPI specification, and a self-serve sandbox are not exposed; the partner API and Vouch Corporate documentation (hosted on GitBook) are gated to onboarded venture, technology, and service-provider partners contracted through hello@vouch.us.

providers.name: Securian Financial
providers.description: Securian Financial Group is a Saint Paul, Minnesota-based mutual holding company offering life insurance, annuities, institutional retirement solutions, trust services, investment management and group workplace benefits to individuals, employers, financial institutions and institutional clients across the United States and Canada. Its operating companies include Minnesota Life Insurance Company, Securian Life Insurance Company, Securian Asset Management and Securian Canada. Securian does not run a public developer program: its integration surfaces are partner-facing and sales-gated. Securian Platform Connect exchanges benefits data with employer benefits-administration platforms using LIMRA LDEx standards (Evidence of Insurability and Benefits Enrollment Management) plus SSO, API notifications and file feeds, and FlexTech - launched March 2026 with Walnut - embeds payment protection into digital lending journeys through API-based integration. Neither publishes a machine-readable contract, developer portal or self-service onboarding.

providers.name: Hokan
providers.description: Hokan, Inc. (株式会社hokan) is a Japanese InsurTech company that builds hokan®, a cloud-based customer and contract management (CRM) system for insurance agencies and brokerages. The platform consolidates customer and policy information, digitizes proposal and activity workflows, and adds modules for intent capture (意向把握), case management (案件管理), dashboards, accounting/cashiering (出納), and staff management (People). It targets paperless operations, stronger audit and compliance controls, renewal and aftercare tracking, and mobile access for agents. Customers include Orix Life, ANA, Sekisui, and other Japanese insurers and agencies. Hokan is backed by 500 Global. The company exposes API-based website integration for its product but does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company
providers.description: Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) is a San Francisco-based AI agent standards and insurance company that builds confidence infrastructure for enterprises adopting AI agents. It pairs AIUC-1 — described as the world's first AI agent standard, spanning data & privacy, security, safety, reliability, accountability, and societal risk — with insurance products that protect organizations against AI agent failures. Developed with input from over 100 Fortune 500 CISOs and mapped to frameworks including ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS, AIUC certifies AI agents against defined controls through accredited auditors. The company is backed by Emergence Capital and does not currently publish a public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Curative
providers.description: Curative is a health insurance and healthcare services company founded in 2020 that reengineered the employer-based health plan around simplicity, engagement, and cost transparency. Its fully insured and level-funded plans give members a competitive monthly premium with zero copays, deductibles, or out-of-pocket costs, starting each member with a baseline visit that tailors a preventative care plan. Curative serves more than 1,200 employer clients and over 165,000 members, reached profitability, and achieved unicorn status ($1.275B valuation) following a $150M Series B round backed by DCVC. Curative operates as a HIPAA-regulated health plan; it has no public developer/API program, so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, its member/provider web surface, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Good Driver
providers.description: Good Driver Club (formerly Good Driver Mutuality) is an insurtech company backed by Ribbit Capital and Hedosophia. It runs a membership-based, cost-sharing alternative to traditional collision and comprehensive auto coverage: members pay weekly pledges into a shared community pool that covers vehicle damage from accidents, weather, theft, and other qualifying events across 5,000+ partner repair shops nationwide, and accident-free members keep their unused pledge balances as savings. It is explicitly not insurance. The product is delivered through a consumer mobile app (Good Driver Club on Google Play); the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Safety Wing
providers.description: SafetyWing is a fintech and insurtech company providing global health and travel insurance for remote workers, digital nomads, and distributed teams. Its consumer product Nomad Insurance offers travel-medical and full health coverage across 180+ countries, while Remote Health lets companies cover employees and contractors worldwide under a single plan. Backed by Creandum, the company positions itself as building a global social safety net so that geography is no barrier to equal opportunity. As of this enrichment pass SafetyWing publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Briza
providers.description: Briza helps insurance carriers stop losing premium to slow integrations and submission errors, treating carrier API reliability as a manufacturing discipline. A team of Six Sigma Black Belts, Briza applies Kaizen principles to API connectivity across commercial insurance, focusing on submission integrity and moving premium reliably between distributors and carriers. Briza is a 500 Global portfolio company. The team also maintains open-source developer libraries under the briza-insurance GitHub org, including illogical (a JSON DSL rules engine) and wegood (a validation library). Briza does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Cyence
providers.description: Cyence is a cyber risk analytics and modeling solution — originally an independent InsurTech startup (backed by IVP and others) and acquired by Guidewire in 2017 — that helps insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and managing general agents quantify, underwrite, and manage cyber insurance risk in financial terms. It combines internet-scale data collection, data science, and economic loss modeling to produce exposure signals, breach-probability estimates, and portfolio accumulation and catastrophe scenarios. Cyence data and scores are delivered to carriers through Guidewire Cloud and are available via a REST API for pricing, risk selection, and underwriting workflow automation. API access is partner-gated through a Guidewire account rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Finni Health
providers.description: Finni Health is a telehealth company that connects families of children on the autism spectrum with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapists and mental health providers. Operating across more than 30 states, Finni offers both in-home and in-clinic ABA therapy with flexible scheduling, handles insurance coordination and billing for its provider network, and gives parents a portal for progress tracking and family-led goal setting. The company positions itself as an operating platform for ABA practices as well as a care provider for families, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Jones
providers.description: Jones is a full-service SaaS platform purpose-built for insurance compliance in construction and commercial real estate, unifying Certificate of Insurance (COI) collection, deep insurance auditing, workflow automation, and a licensed brokerage in one platform. It pairs hundreds of insurance specialists with AI agents to review COIs and policies at enterprise scale, and is used by general contractors, construction managers, owner-operators, REITs, property management teams, and insurance brokers to manage compliance across large portfolios of subcontractors, vendors, and tenants. Jones offers two engagement models: Jones Software (self-managed) and Jones Operator (an AI-driven concierge that runs day-to-day insurance tasks). Reported scale: 40,000+ projects, 3 billion+ square feet, and 50 million+ insurance documents processed for 300+ industry leaders. Headquartered in New York, NY, Jones was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Foundry Group.

providers.name: Qomplx
providers.description: QOMPLX, Inc. is a Reston, Virginia research and technology company building risk-analytics and cybersecurity products — Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) for Active Directory and cloud credentials, Managed Detection and Response (MDR), attack-surface monitoring, Active Directory security assessment, offensive security services and vCISO engagements — sold into finance, legal and insurance. Its underlying data platform, QOMPLX:OS (Q:OS), includes TimeEngine, a multi-dimensional time-series database and analytics engine that QOMPLX exposes over an HTTP and WebSocket interface. QOMPLX publishes first-party TimeEngine client libraries for Python, Java and Erlang on GitHub, but ships no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL or Postman collection, and operates no public developer portal, API reference or pricing page. As of this pass its own website has been reduced to a single-page Ghost install and every content page listed in its sitemap returns a 301 self-redirect loop.

providers.name: Standard Practice
providers.description: Standard Practice builds voice AI for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) teams. Its AI agents place and handle outbound phone calls to insurance payers to automate administrative work — claim status follow-up, benefits verification, prior authorization, and EDI enrollment — so billing teams can scale collections and get paid more, faster. The platform is delivered as a private, login-gated web application. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Wing Venture Capital and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Zentist
providers.description: Zentist is a cloud-based revenue cycle management (RCM) platform built specifically for dental support organizations (DSOs) and multi-location dental practices. Its flagship product, Remit AI, uses artificial intelligence to automate electronic remittance advice (ERA) and explanation of benefits (EOB) parsing, payment posting, denial and adjustment categorization, and claims status tracking, while Cavi AR drives intelligent accounts-receivable follow-up. Executive dashboards deliver practice-level and organization-wide analytics. Trusted by more than 400 DSOs, Zentist reports doubling RCM productivity and cutting the cash-to-claim cycle in half within the first 100 days. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Zentist operates as a login-gated SaaS application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Halo Investing
providers.description: Halo Investing is a Chicago-based financial technology company that operates a marketplace for "protective investments" — structured notes, multi-manager structured note SMAs, buffered ETFs, annuities and insurance — connecting financial advisors, RIAs and financial institutions with more than 40 global banking and insurance issuers. Founded in 2015 by Biju Kulathakal and Jason Barsema, the platform lets advisors analyze, customize, price, execute and then monitor outcome-based products from a single dashboard, with tools such as the Aura portfolio simulator and an asset allocation framework for structured notes. Halo reports more than $45.5B in transactions since 2015 and employs 100+ people. Its affiliate Halo Securities LLC is an SEC-registered broker-dealer and a member of FINRA/SIPC, acting as distributor and selling agent for structured note products. The advisor platform at notes.haloinvesting.com is entirely authenticated behind a login. As of this profiling pass Halo Investing publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK, CLI, MCP server or A2A agent card; advisor-side API integration is offered through the third-party Schwab OpenView Gateway rather than a Halo-published API.

providers.name: Nava
providers.description: Nava (Nava Benefits) is a modern employee benefits brokerage that pairs benefits advisors with AI-powered technology to cut administrative work, simplify renewals, and support employees around the clock. Its HQ platform helps HR teams manage benefits and renewals while an employee app acts as a 24/7 digital benefits concierge for workers and their families, integrating with BenAdmin and carrier systems. Backed by Homebrew, Nava positions itself as an alternative to traditional brokers focused on cost savings and administrative relief. No public developer program, API, or OpenAPI surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Agentero
providers.description: Agentero is a digital insurance network and insurtech platform, founded in 2017 and based in Oakland, California, that gives independent property & casualty insurance agents market access to 100+ national and regional carriers alongside modern agency technology. Its unified command center lets agents get appointed, quote and bind policies, manage carrier appointments, and reconcile commissions from a single portal, with no startup fees or minimum-volume requirements. Agentero also offers an AI Appetite Checker that matches risks to the right carriers and Producerflow, a compliance and producer-management solution for carriers, MGAs, and agencies. Agentero is a portfolio company backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Brown & Brown
providers.description: Brown & Brown, Inc. (NYSE: BRO) is a Daytona Beach, Florida headquartered insurance brokerage and risk-management intermediary founded in 1939, and one of the largest independent brokers in the United States. Following the 2025 acquisition of Accession Risk Management Group (Risk Strategies and One80 Intermediaries), it reports through two segments: Retail — property and casualty insurance, employee benefits, private client, captive solutions and financial/wealth services — and Specialty Distribution — programs, wholesale brokerage and MGA/binding-authority businesses including Arrowhead. As a distributor rather than a carrier, Brown & Brown places risk with insurers instead of underwriting it, and its US home market has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate. Its API posture reflects that honestly: Brown & Brown publishes no public developer portal and no self-serve API. developer.bbrown.com, developers.bbrown.com, docs.bbrown.com and api.bbrown.com do not resolve, and every /developers, /api, /partners and /integrations path returns 404. Every discoverable application subdomain is a login wall — agent, client and vendor portals behind Microsoft Entra ID SSO or third-party sign-in. The only real programmatic surface is partner-gated: the Arrowhead Programs "Enterprise API" (EAPI), a quoting integration distributed through comparative raters and aggregators such as CoverHound, Tarmika, Semsee and DAIS, with no public documentation, base URL or specification. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference is published on any Brown & Brown first-party property; carrier data exchange runs, as it does across US retail brokerage, through the agency management system layer — Brown & Brown is a publicly referenced Vertafore AMS360 agency — and IVANS agency download rather than through any API Brown & Brown itself exposes. In July 2026 the company announced an AI-first transformation with Anthropic, McKinsey and Accenture, deploying Claude across 23,000 teammates and Claude Code across its software engineering organization; that is internal adoption and has so far produced no external API, developer portal or agent-facing surface. The only machine-readable documents Brown & Brown publishes are two RSS feeds — the blog and investor news releases.

providers.name: Crabi
providers.description: Crabi is a Mexican digital auto-insurance company (insurtech) offering fully online vehicle policies purchasable in about fifteen minutes from a mobile device. Coverage spans material damage, theft, third-party civil liability, medical expenses, and roadside and legal assistance across 27 Mexican states, sold and serviced through its mobile apps, online quoter (cotizador), and customer login portal. The company is regulated in Mexico by the CNSF and CONDUSEF and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Crabi publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Dalma
providers.description: Dalma is a French insurtech offering pet health insurance for dogs and cats, reimbursing veterinary bills (up to 100%, no deductible, EUR 2,500 annual ceiling) with fast payouts (50% within 30 seconds) and unlimited teleconsultations with veterinarians via its mobile app. Founded in Paris and backed by Northzone, Dalma insures 60,000+ pets across France and has expanded to Germany. It is a direct-to-consumer insurance brand with a member app (app.dalma.co) and a quote/subscription funnel; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Earnix
providers.description: Earnix provides an AI orchestration system (Earnix AIOS) purpose-built for insurance and banking decisioning. The platform unifies pricing, an enterprise rating engine, automated underwriting, and real-time customer engagement so insurers and financial institutions can price smarter, underwrite faster, and engage customers better. Earnix serves 100+ leading insurers worldwide, processing billions of transactions annually and compressing rate creation from months to days. Earnix is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Earnix is an enterprise B2B vendor with no public self-serve developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Fabric Technologies
providers.description: Fabric Technologies operates Fabric by Gerber Life, a direct-to-consumer financial services platform built for parents and families. The company offers term life insurance with an instant online quote and application flow, UGMA custodial investment accounts and 529 college-savings plans for children, and digital estate-planning tools including free wills. Fabric is backed by Gerber Life, part of Western & Southern Financial Group, and was originally venture-funded by Bessemer Venture Partners. The platform emphasizes fast, accessible, mobile-first family financial planning spanning protection, wealth-building, and legacy planning. Fabric is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Insify
providers.description: Insify is a Dutch insurtech offering fully digital business insurance for freelancers, self-employed professionals (ZZP'ers) and small-to-medium enterprises in the Netherlands. Its online-first product line covers disability/income protection (arbeidsongeschiktheid, AOV), professional liability (beroepsaansprakelijkheid, BAV), business liability (bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid, AVB), business inventory and goods, electronics, in-vehicle equipment and auto cover, sold and managed entirely online with no setup, advisory or cancellation fees and daily cancellation. Serving more than 40,000 entrepreneurs across professions from IT and photography to care and construction, Insify pairs instant quoting and fast claims with AI-assisted guidance (SmartGuide). Backed by Accel, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an insurance-tech provider profile; it is a consumer-facing insurer and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Monitaur
providers.description: Monitaur is an enterprise AI governance platform that helps regulated organizations manage machine learning and AI responsibly across the full model lifecycle. Its software lets teams define enterprise-wide AI governance policies, manage and monitor model performance for drift and bias, and automate model validation, risk assessment, stress testing, and vendor governance at scale. Monitaur is built for regulated industries such as insurance and financial services, delivering audit-ready documentation and compliance reporting. A Techstars-backed company, Monitaur has been recognized as a Gartner Magic Quadrant Visionary and is SOC 2 Type II certified. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Newfront Insurance
providers.description: Newfront is a technology-native insurance brokerage ("a brokerage for the 21st century") serving startups through Fortune 500 enterprises, and now part of WTW. It places business insurance (property, casualty, cyber, executive risk, workers' compensation, surety, aviation, M&A and global programs) alongside Total Rewards services (employee benefits, compensation, retirement/401(k), HR, payroll and benefits compliance), pairing brokerage expertise with in-house software such as the Navigator benefits platform, RiskPulse analytics, and contract/coverage-gap review tools. Newfront reports roughly 20% of U.S. unicorns as clients and $3.1B in annual premiums placed. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks; client and employee interaction happens through the authenticated app.newfront.com application. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched with company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Orus
providers.description: Orus is a French online insurance broker ("l'assurance professionnelle en ligne") offering professional-liability and business insurance to independent professionals and small businesses across France. Products include RC Pro (professional liability), Multirisque Professionnelle, Assurance Décennale (ten-year construction liability), Assurance Bureau (office insurance), Mutuelle Santé TNS (self-employed health), and Prévoyance TNS (income protection), serving sectors from consultants and construction to hospitality, retail, and wellness. Backed by Partech and Speedinvest, Orus operates a self-service quote-and-buy app (app.orus.eu) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at this time. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched via public web and domain probes.

providers.name: Plus Simple
providers.description: +Simple (Plus Simple) is a French digital insurance underwriting agency (agence de souscription) founded in 2015 and headquartered in Marseille. Operating as one of France's largest wholesale insurance brokers, it runs a fully digital extranet platform that lets partner insurance brokers prospect, price, underwrite, issue, and manage professional insurance contracts across more than 1,200 covered activities and 30+ niche product lines, including RC Décennale (ten-year construction liability) coverage. +Simple distributes on a 100% brokerage model in partnership with carriers such as Hiscox, Allianz, Wakam, QBE and Beazley, serving a network of 8,000+ partner brokers. The company is backed by Anthemis and Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time (its broker and insured portals are authenticated web applications, not open APIs).

providers.name: Simplyinsured
providers.description: SimplyInsured is a small-business health insurance brokerage and online enrollment platform. It aggregates medical, dental, and vision plans from major carriers, provides unbiased plan recommendations, and lets small employers compare, quote, and enroll their teams entirely online at no cost to the business. Founded in 2012 and backed by Y Combinator, SimplyInsured is frequently embedded as the health-insurance offering inside partner payroll and HR platforms. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing web application and a support/help surface but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: SquareTrade (Allstate)
providers.description: SquareTrade, an Allstate company, provides consumer product protection plans and extended warranties for smartphones, electronics, appliances, furniture, and other goods, marketed in North America as Allstate Protection Plans. It serves more than 140 million customers through partnerships with major retailers and mobile carriers across the US, Europe, Japan, and Australia, handling plan registration, claims filing, same-day repairs, and in-home service. SquareTrade was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its digital surface is consumer- and partner-facing (plan portal, claims, partnerships).

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Clark
providers.description: Clark ("Dein Versicherungsmanager") is a Germany-based digital insurance manager that lets consumers view, compare, optimize, and manage all of their insurance policies in one mobile app and web platform. Founded in Frankfurt in 2015, Clark pairs a licensed insurance brokerage with automated tariff comparison across more than 180 insurance providers and free expert consultation, covering health, liability, property, life, mobility, and retirement products. The company operates across Germany, Switzerland, France, and the UK, serves over 700,000 customers, and is backed by venture investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners. Clark exposes no public developer API or developer portal; it is a consumer-facing insurtech rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Claim Genius
providers.description: Claim Genius is an AI vehicle-inspection and automated damage-assessment company serving auto insurance claims, underwriting, dealerships, salvage, lease and rental, fleet and collision repair. Its GeniusINSPECT engine converts vehicle photos and video into structured, decision-ready data — per-part damage classification (scratch, dent, tear, glass, wheel), repair-versus-replace decisions, labor and paint hours, OEM part pricing, repairability status and total-loss probability. The capabilities are packaged as products (GeniusINSPECT for Claims, GeniusINSPECT for Underwriting, GeniusPrepost, GeniusOPS) and exposed to integrators through the GeniusAPI Suite, a JWT-authenticated REST API with asynchronous pipeline processing. The company has operated across the US, EU and Asia since 2018.

providers.name: Clearcover
providers.description: Clearcover is a digital-first auto insurance company that offers customizable, affordable car insurance backed by AI-assisted claims that can resolve eligible claims in minutes rather than days. Customers buy and manage policies through a mobile app, file claims by photographing damage, and track claim status in real time, with coverage spanning liability, comprehensive and collision, medical payments, uninsured/underinsured motorist protection, roadside assistance, and alternate transportation. Clearcover operates across multiple US states through several underwriting entities, distributes through both direct and independent-agent channels, and runs a developer portal for partner and embedded insurance integrations. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Creditas
providers.description: Creditas is a Brazilian digital lending fintech founded in 2012 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, operating in Brazil and Mexico. It provides secured consumer credit - loans backed by real estate (home equity) and vehicles, plus private payroll (consignado privado) loans - alongside auto insurance, multi-bank real estate and vehicle financing, and a corporate benefits platform (salary advance, flexible-benefits cards, and financial education). Regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil, Creditas has originated over R$12 billion in credit. It is backed by QED Investors and the SoftBank Vision Fund. No public developer API program or OpenAPI has been identified; this profile captures the company public identity, its published llms.txt, and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Descartes Underwriting
providers.description: Descartes Underwriting is a Paris-headquartered insurtech, founded in 2019, specializing in parametric insurance for climate, natural-catastrophe, cyber, and emerging corporate risks. It operates two complementary entities — Descartes Underwriting, a global parametric managing general agent (MGA), and Descartes Insurance, an ACPR-licensed European full-stack carrier — using AI, satellite imagery, IoT sensor data, and scientific risk models to structure index-based covers that pay out automatically within days when a predefined trigger is met, without a traditional claims-adjustment process. Backed by Battery Ventures and other investors, the company serves 600+ large corporations and public entities through corporate brokers across 20+ offices worldwide. No public developer API or documentation is published; the company distributes coverage through brokers rather than a self-serve API surface.

providers.name: Healthcare.com
providers.description: Healthcare.com (HealthCare, Inc.) is a privately held, non-government health insurance marketplace and distribution platform founded in 2014. Consumers use healthcare.com to find, compare and enroll in ACA/under-65 individual health plans, Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans, and specialty coverage; distributors, FMOs, MGAs and agents use its Autopilot machine-learning enrollment acquisition platform, which matches high-intent shoppers to distributor partners with predictive scoring and value-based lead pricing. Its Pivot Health subsidiary develops and markets proprietary short-term medical, fixed indemnity and supplemental gap products with A-rated carriers. Insurance is sold through Healthcare.com Insurance Services, LLC. As of this profiling pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition or SDKs.

providers.name: Centene
providers.description: Centene Corporation is a leading managed care organization providing government-sponsored healthcare programs including Medicaid, Medicare, and Health Insurance Marketplace plans. Centene operates a developer portal at partners.centene.com publishing FHIR-based interoperability APIs under the 21st Century Cures Act and CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule, including Patient Access, Provider Directory, and Provider RTR (Payer Data Exchange) APIs.

providers.name: District Cover
providers.description: District Cover is a commercial insurance managing general agent and surplus-lines broker focused on urban businesses. It underwrites flexible commercial coverage for city-based retailers, restaurants, bakeries, laundromats, dry cleaners, salons, law and medical offices, and multi-location mid-market operators, using block-level risk scoring drawn from crime and fire analytics rather than broad ZIP-code assessments. The platform supports real-time submissions, multi-location quoting, and property-only endorsements, and is distributed to brokers through a licensed producer network operating across multiple U.S. states. District Cover publishes no public API or developer program; broker access is delivered through a hosted Insly portal.

providers.name: Equitable
providers.description: Equitable Holdings, Inc. is a financial services holding company offering individual retirement, group retirement, life insurance, and employee benefits solutions. In 2025, Equitable launched API capabilities for benefits plan setup integration, partnering with platforms such as Employee Navigator to streamline broker workflows.

providers.name: Meanwhile
providers.description: Meanwhile is the first BMA-licensed innovative life insurer in Bermuda, offering whole life insurance policies denominated entirely in Bitcoin rather than fiat. Its BTC Life product lets customers pay premiums in Bitcoin that grow at a guaranteed rate in Bitcoin terms, borrow tax-free against up to 90% of policy value after one year, and pass a full day-one death benefit to beneficiaries without managing wallets or seed phrases. The company is backed by Pantera, Bain Capital Crypto, Sam Altman, Northwestern Mutual, and Framework Ventures, and raised $82M in October 2025. Meanwhile publishes no public developer API, portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nibbles PBC
providers.description: Nibbles PBC is a public benefit company building consumer financial and insurance products that make pet ownership easier. Its flagship product is the Nibbles credit card, a Mastercard that bundles built-in pet insurance and pet- focused rewards for cardholders. The company operates a consumer web application and account portal at nibbles.com (formerly reached via the nibbl.es short domain) covering sign-up, sign-in, card management, insurance policies, and rewards. Nibbles PBC was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; its public surface is a consumer product site, help center, and legal agreements. This profile therefore captures verified company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Pitzi
providers.description: Pitzi is a Brazilian insurtech (founded around 2013) that sells mobile phone protection insurance, covering devices against theft, robbery, cracked screens, and accidental damage. Customers subscribe to monthly device-protection plans and file claims through an online customer portal to get their phone repaired or replaced, with support offered via a help center, email, and WhatsApp. Pitzi also distributes through a partner program and is backed by DCM Ventures and QED Investors. It operates as a direct-to-consumer and partner-distributed fintech/insurtech in Brazil. No public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: axiTrust
providers.description: axiTrust is a technology and consulting platform for the Indian surety-bond market, connecting IRDAI-licensed insurers, MSMEs, and government procurement bodies. Its platform unifies application processing, underwriting checks, and insurance surety bond issuance, with dashboards for tracking bonds, partners, and claims, plus integrations to financial, legal, banking, and ROC data sources. axiTrust also offers consulting services including discovery workshops, economic analysis comparing sureties to bank guarantees, and adoption support for enterprises and government departments. It is not an insurer or broker; all insurance surety bonds are issued by IRDAI-licensed insurance companies. axiTrust is a fintech backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Fay
providers.description: Fay (Fay Health, Inc.) is a digital-health marketplace that connects members with registered dietitians and nutritionists and handles the insurance billing so nutrition counseling is covered — often at little or no out-of-pocket cost. The platform offers telehealth consultations, personalized meal planning, and support for chronic condition management, backed by iOS and Android apps and a member help center. Fay reports 4,000+ registered dietitians, 700+ accepted insurance plans, and 100,000+ members. It is backed by Forerunner Ventures and General Catalyst and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; Fay publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Justos
providers.description: Justos is a Brazilian digital auto insurance insurtech founded in 2020 and headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo. Operating as a managing general agent (MGA), Justos uses smartphone-collected driving data (telematics) to reward safe drivers with lower, usage-based pricing — advertised as up to 30% cheaper than traditional plans — plus weekly bonuses and perks like gas vouchers, maintenance, and ride credits. Its products are distributed digitally through a consumer mobile app and a broker (corretor) portal, with claims tracked in-app and 24/7 support. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Kaszek, SoftBank Latin America and GGV; its auto insurance is underwritten by Companhia Excelsior de Seguros (SUSEP code 05690). No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Zopper
providers.description: Zopper is an Indian insurtech platform that combines insurance and technology to deliver end-to-end, embedded insurance distribution for its partners. It builds APIs that let banks, consumer-electronics brands, retailers, e-commerce, travel and fintech platforms embed insurance into their customer journeys, and it manages policy issuance, servicing, claims and compliance across consumer-durables protection, life, health, bancassurance and embedded insurance. Zopper serves 2,500+ brands including Bank of Baroda, Axis Bank, IDFC First Bank, Apple, Samsung, Croma and Vijay Sales, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Alude
providers.description: Alude is a Brazilian proptech (real estate technology) SaaS platform that digitizes the day-to-day operations of imobiliárias (real estate agencies), brokers, and property managers. Serving more than 20,000 agencies, the platform bundles rental management with automated payment collection and reporting, instant CPF/CNPJ tenant background screening (análise de ficha), legally valid electronic signatures without digital certificates, fast fire-insurance (seguro incêndio) issuance, automated property capture and lead generation, and capitalization bonds as an alternative to traditional rental deposits. Alude is LGPD-compliant, free to try without a credit card, and backed by Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, and MAYA Capital. It operates as an end-to-end web application rather than a public API-first product; no developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Evertas
providers.description: Evertas is a digital-asset insurance underwriter and the first company dedicated exclusively to crypto insurance. Founded in 2017 as BlockRe by J. Gdanski and Raymond Zenkich and rebranded to Evertas in 2020, it underwrites cryptocurrency mining and AI-infrastructure hardware property, platform failure, crime/theft/loss, insider theft/loss, digital property, and directors-and-officers risk. Products are underwritten by certain underwriters at Lloyd's of London and other insurers, carry AM Best and Standard & Poor's creditworthiness ratings, and offer coverage limits up to $600 million per declaration. Policies are distributed exclusively through appointed brokers. Evertas operates a marketing and content site plus an email-gated broker document-upload portal; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Getsafe
providers.description: Getsafe (Getsafe Digital GmbH) is a Heidelberg, Germany-based digital insurance company (insurtech) that lets consumers buy, manage, and file claims for insurance entirely through a mobile app. Getsafe operates as a licensed insurance carrier and offers 15+ products across liability and legal protection, health (public, private, dental, and travel), living (contents and drone), pet (pet health and dog liability), and protection and finance (income protection, term life, private pension, and children's savings). It serves 500k+ customers in Germany and Austria with English-language, app-based support. In 2018 Getsafe launched an early-access P&C and health insurance API and embeddable widget for partner distribution; that partner API is no longer offered as a public self-service developer program, so this profile is maintained as a company record. Backed by earlybird and partech.

providers.name: StanCorp Financial Group
providers.description: StanCorp Financial Group, Inc. (doing business as The Standard) is an insurance and financial services company headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company since 2016. Founded in 1906, The Standard offers group and individual disability insurance, group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, group dental and group vision insurance, absence management services, retirement plans, individual annuities, and commercial mortgage loan origination. The Standard does not offer a public developer API. Employer and benefits administrator integrations are managed through EDI and proprietary data exchange channels.

providers.name: XP Health
providers.description: XP Health is an AI-powered vision benefits platform that modernizes employer vision programs with full-replacement and dual-option plans designed to reduce employee out-of-pocket eyewear costs. The platform serves more than 6,300 organizations, offering in-app prescription renewals, virtual try-on across 5,000+ eyewear styles, and a provider network reaching 90% of the U.S. population, with members saving an average of 69% on eyewear claims. Backed by QED Investors. XP Health does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Nourish
providers.description: Nourish is a virtual nutrition-counseling telehealth platform that connects patients with Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) through insurance-covered video appointments in all 50 states. Its network of more than 10,000 dietitians supports conditions including diabetes, eating disorders, heart health, and gut health, and a companion mobile app handles meal and goal tracking, secure messaging, lab-work review, and between-session support. Nourish verifies insurance and submits claims on the patient's behalf, with the company reporting that 94% of patients pay $0 out of pocket. Backed by Index Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Susa Ventures, the company raised a $100M Series C. Nourish exposes a consumer marketing and patient-app surface only; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: Airhelp
providers.description: AirHelp is a passenger-rights platform that helps air travelers claim compensation for delayed, cancelled, and overbooked flights under regulations such as EU 261, UK 261, and similar laws worldwide. It handles the full claims process on a "no win, no fee" basis, managing paperwork, airline negotiations, and legal escalation on the passenger's behalf, and offers an AirHelp+ membership adding fast-track claims, flight-disruption assistance, and airport lounge access. AirHelp operates a consumer web funnel and mobile apps plus a network of travel-brand, corporate, and affiliate partnerships, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization hosts internal engineering tooling rather than API client libraries. This profile was seeded as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from AirHelp's public web surface.

providers.name: Hedvig
providers.description: Hedvig is a Swedish insurtech offering mobile-first digital insurance to consumers, with more than 200,000 customers managing policies and reporting claims through its app. Products span home and apartment (hemförsäkring), villa, car, pet (dog and cat), accident, student, and travel insurance, with in-app chat support and fast digital claims. Backed by Anthemis and Obvious Ventures, Hedvig operates a consumer app over internal APIs and publishes no public developer API surface; this network profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: OneShield
providers.description: OneShield Software provides core insurance platform solutions for property and casualty (P&C) insurers, managing general agents (MGAs), program administrators, and insurance startups. Its two platforms — OneShield Enterprise, a comprehensive cloud/SaaS core suite, and OneShield Market Solutions (OMS), a preconfigured SaaS offering — cover policy administration, billing, claims, rating, product configuration, relationship management, business intelligence, and analytics across more than 90 lines of business. OneShield exposes RESTful and SOAP integration services (XML/JSON) through its Services Designer and OMS API integration suite, but publishes no public developer portal or OpenAPI; API access is provisioned to customers and implementation partners. Headquartered in Marlborough, Massachusetts with offices in India, OneShield is backed by investors including Bain Capital and Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Policygenius
providers.description: Policygenius is an independent online insurance marketplace and licensed brokerage founded in 2014 by Jennifer Fitzgerald and Francois de Lame and headquartered in New York City. The platform lets consumers compare quotes, get unbiased expert advice, and buy life, disability, homeowners, auto, and renters insurance across dozens of carriers, and it operates Policygenius Pro, a turnkey life-insurance fulfillment platform for financial advisors, agents, banks, and credit unions. Policygenius was acquired by Zinnia (an Eldridge company) in 2023. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Policygenius publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; its GitHub organization hosts internal tooling and forks only.

providers.name: Sidecar Health
providers.description: Sidecar Health is a health insurance company founded in 2018 by Patrick Quigley and Veronica Osetinsky and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. It was built to bring transparency to healthcare pricing, letting members see upfront cash prices for care and share in the savings. After launching with supplemental coverage for individuals, Sidecar established its own insurance carrier in 2021 and today serves large employers with ACA-compliant major medical plans, offered both fully insured and as administrative-services-only (ASO) for self-funded employers. It covers members in 46 states across partners in 50 industries. Sidecar Health operates member, provider, broker, and employer web portals plus a mobile app, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or partner-integration documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Alodokter
providers.description: Alodokter is Indonesia's leading digital health and telemedicine platform, founded in 2014 and operated by PT Alodokter Teknologi Solusi. It connects tens of millions of monthly active users with tens of thousands of licensed doctors through chat-based consultations (Tanya Dokter), online and in-person doctor appointment booking, a large library of medically reviewed health articles and a symptom and disease encyclopedia, health protection and insurance products, and a health commerce surface for medicines and health products. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the provider's own public web surface; Alodokter does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so this profile focuses on company identity, legal and support surfaces, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Foresight Mental Health
providers.description: Foresight Mental Health is a Berkeley, California technology-enabled outpatient behavioral health organization founded in 2018 by UC Berkeley computer science students Doug Hapeman and Matt Milford to widen access to insurance-covered therapy and psychiatry. It delivers virtual and in-person care through its own clinics in California and Georgia plus partner locations in Arizona, Florida and Texas, covering psychiatry and medication management, individual and couples therapy (CBT, DBT-informed care, EMDR, ACT, Gottman Method, play therapy), child and adolescent services, a maternal mental health program, ADHD/IVA-2 CPT testing, intensive outpatient services in California and transcranial magnetic stimulation in Georgia. The company acquired Psychiatric Addictive Curative Therapies (PACT) Atlanta and has raised roughly $17.7M across pre-seed through Series C with investors including Polaris Partners. Its clinical technology stack is bought rather than built and patient-facing: scheduling runs through Zocdoc and the patient portals are operated by third parties — AdvancedMD for California patients and athenahealth elsewhere. Foresight publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract; the only machine-readable documents on its host are a Yoast-generated llms.txt, a sitemap index and the marketing site's stock WordPress core REST API at /wp-json/.

providers.name: Ledgebrook
providers.description: Ledgebrook is a technology-enabled excess and surplus (E&S) lines managing general agent (MGA) and reinsurance platform headquartered in Massachusetts and founded by Gage Caligaris. It underwrites specialty commercial casualty risk — general liability, professional liability, and cyber — exclusively through wholesale brokers, competing on quote speed rather than direct-to-consumer distribution. Its stack pairs a proprietary underwriting workbench with machine-learning models applied across submission intake, triage, data architecture, and pricing, backed by an engineering, data-science and product organization of 70+ people, with policy administration running on Socotra. Ledgebrook Re extends the business into delegated-authority reinsurance with London and Dubai operations. The company closed an oversubscribed Series C funding round in June 2025 and has appeared on the CB Insights 50 Most Innovative Insurtech Startups list. As of this profiling pass Ledgebrook publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract — its broker quoting platform is a private, credentialed surface.

providers.name: Credit Karma
providers.description: Credit Karma is an AI-powered personal finance platform founded in 2007 and owned by Intuit since 2020, serving more than 140 million members in the US, UK and Canada. It began as a free credit-score and credit-monitoring destination and has grown into a broad consumer finance marketplace spanning credit cards, personal and auto loans, mortgages, auto and home insurance, banking (checking, savings and credit-builder accounts), tax filing, and identity monitoring. Credit Karma monetizes through personalized recommendations and lead generation rather than a public developer or partner API; it maintains no external consumer-facing API program. It does run an active engineering culture with 29 public open-source repositories on GitHub (Thrift and GraphQL tooling), a coordinated vulnerability disclosure program via HackerOne, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 security certifications.

providers.name: Amera
providers.description: Amera (Amera Health Solutions) is a Seattle-based, Y Combinator (Fall 2025) healthcare technology company that automates claims processing workflows for health insurance payers, third-party administrators (TPAs), and self-insured employers. Its normalization engine ingests messy claim inputs from any source — EDI, PDFs, paper, fax, and proprietary/non-standard formats — and turns them into adjudication-ready, structured data that plugs into existing claims cores via API, EDI, or SFTP. The platform automates validation, reconciliation, stop-loss reporting, and real-time visibility and analytics, reducing plan administration costs and cutting carrier submission times from weeks to minutes while keeping full audit trails and HIPAA compliance. Founded in 2025 by Louise Tanski and Deep Kapur (both formerly of Rupa Health), Amera already works with payers and plan administrators representing roughly 100,000 members. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; Amera does not yet publish a public developer portal or API specification.

providers.name: Amica Mutual Insurance
providers.description: Amica Mutual Insurance, founded in 1907, is a mutual insurance company providing automobile, homeowners, condo, renters, life, marine, motorcycle, umbrella liability, flood, and small business insurance to customers across the United States. As a mutual company, Amica is owned by its policyholders and known for award-winning customer service and competitive pricing through bundling discounts.

providers.name: Azos
providers.description: Azos is a Brazilian insurtech (founded 2021) that sells fully digital life insurance directly to consumers and through a broker (corretor) channel. Its products include life insurance, serious-illness coverage, accidental-disability coverage, and funeral assistance, all contracted online in minutes with no medical exam, transparent pricing from around R$5/month, and coverage up to R$1 million. The company positions itself as "seguro de vida sem burocracia" (life insurance without bureaucracy) and is backed by Prosus Ventures. Azos runs a consumer app and a broker portal but publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Brain
providers.description: Brain Co. builds agent-native operating systems for institutions across the public and private sectors. Its Atlas platform powers GovOS — permitting, licensing, claims, and casework for government agencies at national scale — and InsuranceOS for underwriting, claims, authorization, and insurance operations, with an emphasis on sovereign-grade security and vendor neutrality. Founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, the company was cofounded by Elad Gil, Jared Kushner, and Luis Videgaray, with a team drawn from Google, DeepMind, NVIDIA, Palantir, and Tesla. Brain Co. does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definitions; this profile tracks its public web surface (news, trust center, privacy and terms) pending any future developer program.

providers.name: Cartrawler
providers.description: CarTrawler is a leading B2B technology provider of car rental, ground transport and insurtech solutions to the global travel industry. Through its Connect Platform it links airlines, online travel agencies and travel companies to a worldwide marketplace of car rental suppliers, private transfers and ride-hailing partners, displaying millions of cars daily and processing billions of queries. CarTrawler serves 70+ airlines and 250+ travel companies worldwide (including American Airlines, Ryanair, easyJet, Qantas, Southwest, eDreamsODIGEO and Uber), differentiating through proprietary technology, real-time machine-learning pricing and personalized retailing. Integration is delivered through partner and supplier programs rather than a public self-service developer portal; this profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Coverfox
providers.description: Coverfox is one of India's largest online insurance distribution platforms, offering retail insurance products including car, bike, health, and life insurance alongside embedded insurance solutions for lenders, NBFCs, and fintechs. The company partners with 37+ IRDAI-approved insurers to compare, purchase, and manage policies online, and has reached roughly 10 million households across India. Coverfox was backed by Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer program or API at this time.

providers.name: CoverHound
providers.description: CoverHound is an InsurTech marketplace, now part of Brown & Brown, Inc. (NYSE: BRO), that lets consumers and small businesses compare and buy insurance online from A-rated carriers across all 50 states. Its platform covers personal lines — auto, homeowners, and renters — alongside business insurance including general liability, workers' compensation, professional liability, commercial auto, cyber, and directors & officers coverage. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Carpinteria, California, CoverHound provides digital quote comparison, agent-assisted purchasing, and an insurance learning center. It operates as a consumer/SMB web marketplace and publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Cowbell Cyber
providers.description: Cowbell is a cyber insurance provider (insurtech) that delivers adaptive, continuously-underwritten cyber liability coverage and cyber-risk management services to small businesses and the middle market. Its platform pairs insurance products with proprietary risk analytics — Cowbell Factors, a continuous risk-rating model that benchmarks an organization's exposure against peers — and closed-loop resilience services delivered through the Cowbell console for policyholders, agents, and brokers. Product lines include Cowbell Prime 100 / Prime 100 Pro (small business), Prime 250 / Prime One (middle market), Prime Plus (excess), Technology Errors & Omissions, Management Liability, plus the Cowbell Rx marketplace, Cowbell Connectors, and Cowbell Insights. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Cowbell publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal — the console at console.cowbellcyber.ai is an authenticated quoting/policy application for agents and insureds, not a documented programmatic API.

providers.name: Custodian
providers.description: Custodian (getcustodian.com) is a Mexico City-based consumer mobile application and insurtech service that centralizes vehicle documentation and automotive administrative tasks. The app helps drivers organize and store important paperwork, track expiration dates for registration, insurance policies, and health certificates, receive renewal notifications, and get assistance with auto-insurance renewals and claims management. A premium annual subscription (450 MXN) adds full document-handling and verification services (including Mexico City vehicle verification). Custodian is a consumer app distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Edme Insurance Brokers
providers.description: Edme Insurance Brokers Ltd (formerly Aditya Birla Insurance Brokers, ABIBL) is an India-based composite insurance broker offering corporate, retail, and reinsurance solutions across 30+ industries including aviation, marine, energy, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, technology, and the BFSI and FMCG sectors. The company provides tailored risk management, employee benefits, and claims advisory services, backed by digital customer portals for policy and claims management and employee benefits. Edme is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Edme publishes no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Frontlinewildfire
providers.description: Frontline Wildfire Defense is a wildfire protection company that designs, manufactures, and installs exterior sprinkler defense systems for homes, businesses, wineries, summer camps, and new-home communities. The system combines roof- and ground-mounted sprinklers, a pump, and water/foam concentrate with a mobile app (iOS and Android) that lets property owners remotely activate the system, monitor nearby wildfires on a live fire map, and receive evacuation alerts. The company also publishes wildfire risk maps, home-hardening and defensible-space guidance, and works through a network of partner installers. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This is a consumer/hardware company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Gyde
providers.description: Gyde is an AI-native health insurance brokerage, founded in 2025 and headquartered in Austin, Texas with an office in New York City. Gyde partners with established insurance agencies through acquisition, embedding AI-powered tools and operational support so brokers can guide clients through insurance, health, and wealth decisions at greater scale. Its products include Gia, an AI assistant that handles client outreach, scheduling, and questions over SMS and voice around the clock, and GydeOS, a broker operating system providing client summaries, conversation transcripts, campaign management, and an AI co-pilot. Gyde launched publicly in January 2026 with $60M in financing led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile tracks its identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hi Marley
providers.description: Hi Marley is an intelligent conversational platform built for the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry, delivering carrier-to-policyholder communication over SMS. The platform connects carriers, policyholders, and service providers through a single messaging fabric to streamline claims — including Conversational FNOL (First Notice of Loss) intake, Total Loss Assist for auto claims, and Workflow Assist for property claims — layered with AI coaching, sentiment analysis, and data insights. Trusted by 130+ carriers, including four of the top ten U.S. insurers across auto, property, and workers compensation lines. Hi Marley is backed by Emergence Capital and True Ventures. No public developer platform, API documentation, or self-service onboarding was found; the product is delivered as a closed SaaS to insurance carriers.

providers.name: Hometree
providers.description: Hometree is a UK home services and residential energy company offering homeowners and landlords subscription-based boiler and home emergency cover with unlimited repairs and annual maintenance from around £12.95 per month. Its nationwide network of Gas Safe registered engineers handles breakdowns across heating, plumbing, electrics, drainage and gas fires, and the company also arranges boiler installations and green home upgrades such as heat pumps and solar panels. Operating as an insurance distributor and installer across mainland England, Scotland and Wales, Hometree is backed by Anthemis, DN Capital, Barclays, BlackRock, 2150 and Puma Growth Partners.

providers.name: Jetty
providers.description: Jetty is a financial-services company built for the real estate industry, making renting more accessible and affordable for renters while helping property managers reduce risk and bad debt. Following its merger with Rhino, Jetty operates across more than 6 million rental units in the United States and offers three core products: Jetty Deposit, a security-deposit replacement that swaps large cash deposits for a low monthly or one-time payment; Jetty Protect, integrated renters insurance and liability coverage; and Jetty Credit, a rent-reporting and credit-building service that helps renters establish credit history while lowering delinquencies for property managers. Jetty is backed by Ribbit Capital. No public developer/API surface is currently published; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Novidea
providers.description: Novidea is a cloud-native insurance management platform built on Salesforce that helps insurance brokers, MGAs (managing general agents), coverholders, and carriers digitize the full insurance distribution lifecycle across front, middle, and back office operations. The platform unifies quoting, underwriting, binding, policy administration, claims, and accounting with real-time data and analytics, workflow automation, document generation, and customer portals. It markets a "truly open API framework" and an "API a la carte" offering for extending and integrating the platform, but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs; its API surface is delivered to customers on top of the Salesforce platform. Novidea is backed by Battery Ventures and serves insurance distribution businesses globally.

providers.name: Nuevo Método
providers.description: Nuevo Método (NUME) is an international digital-health and corporate-wellness platform, headquartered in Mexico City and operating across 17 countries in Latin America and Europe. It helps insurers and enterprises deliver personalized wellbeing benefits to employees, customers, and their families across three pillars: mental health (psychology sessions, mindfulness, meditation, sleep tracking), physical health (24/7 virtual medical consultations, fertility guidance, menstrual-cycle tracking, health workshops), and lifestyle (personal-finance courses, financial advisory, and inspirational talks). The company runs a fully remote workforce and reports measurable client outcomes such as improved sleep, productivity, and employee retention. Founded and led by Dr. Ingrid Briggiler (CEO). No public API or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company's identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Omnius
providers.description: omni:us (operated by Qidenus Group GmbH, Berlin) is an insurance technology company building agentic AI for claims processing. Its platform automates end-to-end claims handling — from first notice of loss to settlement — across property, casualty, and marine lines, combining document intake, machine reading of structured and unstructured text, images and handwriting, and decision support trained on millions of annotated claims and insurance documents. Products include No-Touch Claim Automation, an Agentic Co-Pilot for complex claim decisions, Leakage Reduction, and a custom Insurance AI Modeller. omni:us was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company markets an enterprise B2B product sold direct to carriers; it publishes a public marketing site, blog, and legal terms, but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Overjet
providers.description: Overjet is a dental AI platform that applies FDA-cleared computer vision to dental radiographs (bitewings, periapicals, panoramics, and CBCT) to detect, outline, and quantify oral health conditions - caries, calculus, bone level and bone loss, periapical radiolucencies (PARLs), and anatomical structures - for dental providers, DSOs, and insurance payers. Overjet is not a self-serve public API. Its AI is delivered as OEM/partner integrations embedded into imaging systems and practice management software (Open Dental, Dentrix, Dentrix Ascend/Enterprise, Eaglesoft, Oryx, CareStack, and others) via connector software and DICOM image routing, plus payer-side products for insurance verification and claim review (ReviewPASS). Any programmatic access is arranged privately under a partner or enterprise agreement; there is no public developer portal or published API reference as of this catalog entry. The APIs listed below are logical, honestly-modeled surfaces (endpointsModeled) representing the capabilities Overjet exposes to integration partners, not documented public endpoints.

providers.name: Player's Health
providers.description: Player's Health is an insurance and athlete-safety technology company founded in 2016 and based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, serving youth sports organizations, fitness facilities, schools, and collegiate athletic programs. The platform combines specialty insurance products (general liability, sexual abuse and molestation liability, accident medical, directors and officers, equipment and property, cyber, and employee benefits) with athlete-safety and risk-management tooling including coach credentialing and background checks, injury and incident reporting, investigations, mental-health support, and training. Player's Health operates login-gated web portals for claims, certificates of insurance, and safety/compliance (SafetyHub) rather than a public developer API. It is a Techstars-backed company surfaced through the API Evangelist network and profiled here for discovery.

providers.name: Reliance Health
providers.description: Reliance Health (formerly RelianceHMO) is a healthtech company making quality healthcare accessible and affordable across emerging markets, with operations centered in Nigeria and expanding across Africa and the Middle East. It offers employer-sponsored and individual health plans covering preventative, emergency, and chronic care, telemedicine and doctor consultations through its mobile app, and a network of 3,800+ healthcare partners (hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and diagnostic centers). Reliance Health combines insurance, its own clinics, and technology to deliver an end-to-end care experience for businesses and their employees. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; the reliancehmo.com application backend (api.reliancehmo.com) is an internal web-app origin, not a documented public API.

providers.name: Reposit
providers.description: Reposit is a UK-based PropTech and fintech company offering a deposit alternative for the residential rental market. Instead of paying a traditional cash deposit, tenants pay a one-time, non-refundable fee (typically one week's rent) for insurance-backed cover, while landlords and letting agents receive protection worth up to eight weeks' rent. The FCA-authorised product is underwritten by a leading insurer and serves letting agents, build-to-rent (BTR) operators, landlords and tenants, with integrations into common property management tools. This profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Reposit publishes no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Roost
providers.description: Roost is a Sunnyvale, California home-telematics company that helps property and casualty insurance carriers modernize homeowners and commercial insurance with smart, in-home sensors and monitoring. Its Protection360 commercial loss-prevention service and Security360 white-label home-security bundle detect water leaks, extreme temperatures, and smoke-alarm events, delivering real-time alerts and risk data to insurers, property owners, and third parties. Roost partners with dozens of top P&C carriers, but does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged directly with its engineering team.

providers.name: Shriram Finance
providers.description: Shriram Finance Limited is one of India's largest retail non-banking financial companies (NBFC), with roughly Rs 3.02 lakh crore in assets under management and 3,225 branches nationwide. It offers commercial-vehicle, two-wheeler, used-car, personal, business and gold loans, fixed deposits and fixed investment plans, general and life insurance distribution, Bharat BillPay (BBPS) bill payments, and UPI through its Shriram One app. The company runs consumer web and mobile products but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; a partner portal and a lending-service-provider program serve authorized business partners only.

providers.name: Stride Health
providers.description: Stride Health is a benefits platform that helps independent, gig, and part-time workers access portable benefits that stay with the individual regardless of where or how they work. Stride connects people to affordable health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and provides tax tools, mileage/expense tracking, and savings features for the self-employed. The company reports 4.6 million independent workers served, $8+ billion saved on insurance and taxes, and 130+ partner companies. Stride operates a private B2B partner integration (embedded in partner apps such as gig-work platforms) but publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Superscript
providers.description: Superscript is a UK- and Netherlands-based business insurance provider offering flexible, subscription-based cover for small and growing businesses, sole traders, landlords, and larger enterprises. Its product range spans public and employers' liability, professional indemnity, cyber insurance, landlord insurance, and industry-specific policies, sold direct and through a broker channel. Superscript was surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface; this profile captures its public web identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Wellxai
providers.description: Wellx (Wellxai) is a Dubai-based health insurtech company that transforms health insurance from reactive to proactive through AI-driven behavior change. Its consumer mobile app pairs behavioral science and gamification with wearable integrations (Fitbit, Apple Watch, Whoop) so members earn xCoins rewards by hitting health goals, step and sleep challenges, and wellness programs, then redeem them with marketplace partners. Wellx also sells to corporates and SMEs and partners with brokers and insurers, positioning healthier behavior as the driver of better-value health insurance. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company exposes consumer iOS/Android apps backed by a private API but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Datalot
providers.description: Datalot (now operating under parent company Centerfield Insurance Services) is an analytics-driven digital customer-acquisition and live lead/call marketplace platform for the insurance industry, spanning auto, home, life, health, Medicare, and commercial lines.
