It runs digital demand-generation campaigns, qualifies consumers in a real-time marketplace, and routes them by data to carriers and agents, adding agent-presence and telephony management, TCPA/regulatory compliance tooling, and secondary-market handling for unmatched consumers. Named carrier clients include Liberty Mutual, Allstate, Farmers, Progressive, Travelers, Aetna, and Humana. The company is SOC 2 certified. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners; the customer-facing surface is an authenticated carrier/agent portal at app.datalot.com with no public API, SDK, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Lumity
providers.description: Lumity is a digital employee benefits broker (part of Alera Group) that acts as an extension of HR teams, combining benefits-administration technology with dedicated benefits experts. Its platform centralizes plan management, eligibility, employee enrollment (web and mobile), renewal strategy and negotiation, year-round employee support, PEO migration, and reporting/analytics with cost forecasting. Lumity markets outcomes such as average cost savings through smarter plan selection and per-employee annual savings. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Threshold Ventures (fintech). Enrichment found no first-party public API, developer portal, or specifications: the employer login portal (er-portal.lumity.com) redirects to the third-party PlanYear platform, and legal pages are served under Alera Group.

providers.name: Responsiv
providers.description: Responsiv is an AI-powered regulatory intelligence and compliance platform that helps organizations monitor regulatory change, translate laws and regulations into clear actionable requirements, identify compliance gaps against existing policies and controls, and track remediation through to completion. The platform continuously monitors 1,000+ regulatory sources across 50+ jurisdictions, routes alerts by business unit, topic, or jurisdiction, maintains an obligations register, and offers agentic legal research with fully cited sources. It serves compliance teams in financial services, health and P&C insurance, and consumer tech. Backed by Greylock. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Signal Advisors
providers.description: Signal Advisors is a financial technology company building an integrated software platform for independent financial advisors and insurance professionals. The Signal Platform consolidates annuity, life insurance, and wealth management workflows into a single system, replacing the traditional Independent Marketing Organization (IMO) model. Product lines include Signal Annuity (quoting, design, and submission), Signal Wealth (portfolio and compliance management), and Signal Life (life-insurance workflow automation), with features such as real-time carrier status updates (TrueStatus), fast commission payouts (TruePay), AI-generated policy summaries, and integrated householding. The company operates a closed, account-based advisor portal and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Withcoverage
providers.description: WithCoverage is a technology-driven risk management and commercial insurance platform that aims to replace the traditional insurance broker for growing businesses. It pairs a team of insurance advisors, claims specialists, and attorneys with an AI-powered digital platform to analyze policies, reduce premiums, manage certificates of insurance, and handle claims proactively as companies scale. Headquartered in New York City and backed by venture investors including 8vc, WithCoverage operates in the insurtech sector. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the company currently exposes no public developer API surface (client access is through the app.withcoverage.com web application).

providers.name: Corebridge Financial
providers.description: Corebridge Financial (formerly AIG Life and Retirement) is one of the largest and most established retirement and insurance solutions providers in the United States. Spun off from AIG in September 2022 in the largest IPO of that year, Corebridge provides retirement solutions, life insurance, fixed and variable annuities, and institutional products. The company is a leading retirement plan provider for K-12 schools, healthcare, government, higher education, and other not-for-profit institutions. Corebridge Financial does not currently publish a public developer API; participant and plan sponsor access is provided through dedicated portals.

providers.name: Cowbell
providers.description: Cowbell is a Pleasanton, California-based adaptive cyber insurance provider serving small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) and the middle market with standalone cyber liability coverage, technology errors & omissions (Tech E&O), management liability, and excess cyber products. Founded in 2019, Cowbell pioneered continuous underwriting through its proprietary Cowbell Factors risk benchmarking, which scores organizations against millions of data points to surface vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation. The company pairs its policies with a closed-loop resiliency program (assess-insure-respond-improve) that includes complimentary risk assessments, Cowbell Insights threat detection, incident response planning, cybersecurity awareness training, micro-penetration testing, and vendor risk assessments, plus subscription-based managed detection and response (MDR), penetration testing, identity monitoring (IdentityAI), and Compliance-as-a-Service (COMPaaS). Cowbell operates across the United States (all 50 states plus DC), the United Kingdom, and Australia, is backed by reinsurance partners including Zurich, and offers a public developer program at developers.cowbellcyber.ai exposing REST APIs for agencies, accounts, risk factors, quoting, binding, policy management, and webhooks across its Prime 100, Prime 250, and PrimeOne products. The API surface powers digital aggregator integrations with partners such as Bold Penguin, Herald, Semsee, Sayata, Limit, iBynd, and AmWins. No public OpenAPI specification or open-source SDK is published by Cowbell.

providers.name: Direct Line Group
providers.description: Direct Line Group is a United Kingdom personal-lines and small-commercial general insurance carrier, founded in 1985 as the UK's first telephone-only motor insurer and listed on the London Stock Exchange from its 2012 IPO until Aviva plc completed its GBP 3.7 billion acquisition of the group on 1 July 2025. The group underwrites motor, home, pet, travel, landlord, breakdown and small-business insurance through the Direct Line, Churchill, Privilege, Darwin, By Miles, Direct Line for Business and Green Flag brands, and is regulated in its home market by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority. Its distribution is direct-to-consumer via telephone and web plus price-comparison-website placement (notably through the Darwin brand), rather than through broker or agency channels; it sold its brokered commercial business (NIG and FarmWeb) to RSA in September 2023, closing the one channel that would have carried standards-based broker integration. Its API posture is accordingly closed and partner-gated: as of 25 July 2026 the corporate domain directlinegroup.co.uk returns HTTP 301 to aviva.com, there is no developer.*, developers.* or docs.* host in DNS, every consumer brand site returns 404 on /developers, /api and /partners, and the only API host that exists — api.directlinegroup.co.uk, resolving to a MuleSoft Anypoint production load balancer — serves HTTP 403 behind an expired TLS certificate and requests a client certificate during the TLS handshake. There is no public self-serve developer portal, no downloadable OpenAPI, no GraphQL, no published webhook or event catalog, no public Postman workspace, and no ACORD reference anywhere in the group's public material. Quote, bind, issue and FNOL are all consumer web and telephone journeys only.

providers.name: Nava Benefits
providers.description: Nava Benefits is a modern employee benefits brokerage that pairs expert human advisors with AI-driven technology to help HR teams manage health insurance renewals, audit billing, control benefits costs, and improve the employee experience. Its platform includes "HQ for HR" for benefits administration, renewals, and document management, and "HQ for Employees" for 24/7 benefits support, plan-decision tools, provider search, and digital ID cards, backed by consultants advising on self-funding and captive strategies. Surfaced as a gv portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; this enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: openIDL
providers.description: openIDL (Open Insurance Data Link) is a Linux Foundation project developing standardized, interoperable data frameworks for the insurance industry. It uses blockchain technology to enable secure, privacy-preserving data sharing between insurance carriers and regulators.

providers.name: Apollo Agriculture
providers.description: Apollo Agriculture is an agricultural technology company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, that helps small-scale farmers across Africa maximize their profits. Apollo delivers a full-stack service bundling quality farm inputs (seed and fertilizer), flexible input financing and credit, satellite- and machine-learning-driven agronomic advice, crop insurance, and market access, distributed through a network of local agrodealers and mobile technology. The company serves smallholder farmers in markets including Kenya and Zambia and is backed by investors including Anthemis and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile tracks Apollo Agriculture as a company in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: ClaimSorted
providers.description: ClaimSorted is a tech-enabled third-party administrator (TPA) for insurance claims, combining human claims-handling expertise with proprietary technology to process claims faster while lowering operating costs and fraud leakage for MGAs and insurance carriers. It offers a white-label electronic Notice of Loss (eNOL) intake system, a policyholder Claims Portal for status tracking and document upload, automated assessment workflows, and fraud-detection algorithms, with reporting delivered daily, weekly, or monthly and as live data feeds over SFTP/API. ClaimSorted supports commercial and personal property, auto, small commercial, general liability, accident & health, travel, and warranty lines of business, serving 30+ clients including Axis and Lloyd's.

providers.name: Go Rise
providers.description: Rise (gorise.co) is a Dubai-based fintech platform that gives migrant workers control over their finances across both their home and host countries. Through a mobile app for iOS and Android, Rise offers bank accounts, insurance, savings and investment options, "Pay Later" installment services, and remittance and money-transfer capabilities. The company partners with regulated financial institutions including United Arab Bank and insurance providers such as AXA Gulf, and is headquartered in DMCC, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, UAE. Rise is a portfolio company of 500 Global and has raised funding led by MEVP. This is a consumer financial-services product with no public developer/API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Groundspeed
providers.description: Groundspeed is an insurance data and analytics company that pioneered AI-powered extraction and standardization of unstructured commercial property and casualty (P&C) insurance documents — loss runs, schedules of values, ACORD forms, and broker submissions — turning them into structured, analytics-ready data for underwriters, brokers, and carriers. Founded in Ann Arbor, Michigan and backed by Insight Partners, Groundspeed was acquired by Insurance Quantified, where its technology now powers the Intake, Workflow, and Intelligence products of an AI-driven underwriting platform serving commercial P&C carriers and MGAs. Groundspeed does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or self-service onboarding surface; this profile tracks its identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hugo
providers.description: Hugo is a mobile-first, usage-based car insurance company that lets drivers turn coverage on and off from their phone and pay in short intervals rather than a large upfront down payment. Through the Hugo app and web portal, customers can activate liability or comprehensive coverage in minutes, get instant proof of insurance, auto-reload their balance, and extend protection as needed. Hugo positions itself as a modern, micropayment alternative to traditional insurers for budget-conscious and gig-economy drivers, and is a seed-stage InsurTech company backed by Canaan Partners. Hugo operates in select U.S. states with expansion underway. Hugo is a consumer insurance application and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: OneConnect
providers.description: OneConnect Financial Technology (NYSE: OCFT; HKEX: 6638) is a technology-as-a-service platform for financial institutions, incorporated in 2015 as an associate of China's Ping An Group to externalize its banking and insurance technology. Its cloud-native, microservices platform spans digital banking, digital insurance, and the Gamma platform (AI voice, computer vision, blockchain and big-data analytics), serving hundreds of banks and insurers across China and Southeast Asia with ready-to-integrate financial technology components exposed through Open APIs. OneConnect raised a US$650M Series A in 2018 from investors including the SoftBank Vision Fund and SBI Group. Its APIs are delivered as enterprise B2B integrations rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Opterrix
providers.description: Opterrix delivers real-time and historical weather and natural hazard intelligence to inform and automate key decision-making throughout the insurance value chain. Their high-performance APIs provide property-level data on perils such as wind, hail, precipitation, wildfire, and convective storms, supporting underwriting, claims, portfolio risk management, and moratorium verification workflows.

providers.name: Payna
providers.description: Payna is a compliance operating system for financial licensing that automates applications, renewals, maintenance, and monitoring across all 50 US states and jurisdictions. It tracks state statutes, NMLS procedures, and FinCEN requirements in real time, calculates filing deadlines backward from due dates, scores compliance posture against state examiner playbooks, automates document pre-fill and e-signature, and maintains a timestamped, queryable audit trail for examinations. Payna serves regulated financial sectors including money transmission, lending, mortgage, cryptocurrency/VASP, debt collection, loan origination, and insurance. It is a Y Combinator (W26) company; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: So Sure
providers.description: So Sure (wearesosure.com), operated by Open Insurance Services UK Limited, was a UK app-based social insurance provider offering mobile phone and home contents insurance, known for a social/peer insurance model that rewarded claim-free groups. It was an early portfolio company of 500 Global. The company has stopped selling new policies and has transitioned its mobile phone cover to the Huddle Insurance brand while continuing to service existing customers. So Sure publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Souqalmal
providers.description: Souqalmal was a UAE-based personal-finance comparison marketplace that let consumers across the GCC compare and apply for credit cards, personal loans, bank accounts, and insurance products online. The brand has since transitioned to Yabi (yabimoney.com), an AI-powered financial coaching application offering personalized guidance, budgeting tools, spending tracking, credit checks, and financial-education content on iOS and Android. Backed by 500 Global. The souqalmal.com domain now permanently redirects to yabimoney.com. No public developer, API, or partner-integration surface is currently published.

providers.name: Klar
providers.description: Klar is a Mexican digital financial services platform (neobank) headquartered in Mexico City with engineering in Berlin, serving roughly 7 million customers. Regulated by Mexico's CNBV, Klar offers a deposit account with yield, a no-annual-fee credit card, a secured (garantizada) credit card, the metal Platino card, personal loans, investment products, and Chubb-underwritten life and fraud insurance, plus cashback and interest-free-months (MSI) benefits. It also runs Klar Empresarial for business customers, partnered with Uber to launch the Uber Card in Mexico, and announced the acquisition of mortgage fintech Yave. Klar's product surface is delivered entirely through its consumer mobile app and website; as of this profile Klar publishes NO public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or sandbox, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or webhook surface could be found. Third-party access to Klar accounts is generally brokered through Latin American open-finance aggregators (Belvo, Pluggy, Plaid) rather than a first-party Klar API. Klar does operate a public GitHub organization (klar-mx), but its repositories are internal infrastructure and DevOps tooling and forks, not client libraries for a Klar API.

providers.name: Klaim
providers.description: Klaim (Klaim Kapital Technologies Limited / Klaim Holdings Limited) is an Abu Dhabi-founded, UAE-based healthcare fintech that advances working capital against receivables. Healthcare providers, real estate brokers and SMEs submit unpaid insurance claims or invoices, Klaim's AI evaluates and prices the risk in real time, and Klaim advances up to 90% of face value within 24 hours, collecting only when the payer or client settles. Products span Klaim Health (insurance claim advances plus AI denial prediction), Klaim Flow (SME receivables purchasing with an escrow model), Klaim Estate (real estate commission advances) and Klaim Eligible (insurance eligibility verification). Founded in December 2019 by Karim Dakki and Ahmad Ghafour, backed by Techstars, and operating across the GCC, North Africa and Turkey. Klaim publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API description at this time.

providers.name: kWh Analytics
providers.description: kWh Analytics is a Beaverton, Oregon based managing general agent and data-analytics firm that underwrites property and performance insurance for renewable energy assets — solar, wind, and battery storage. Founded in 2012 and acquired by specialist insurer Beazley in 2023, the company operates what it describes as the industry's largest solar performance database, covering roughly 30% of U.S. solar assets across 300,000+ renewable energy assets and $100B+ in loss data. Its HelioStats platform ingests unstructured asset production documents (via AWS S3, Box, Dropbox, email attachment, or API) and applies OCR and machine learning to extract, validate, standardize, benchmark, and enrich operating data for investors, lenders, and asset owners. Commercial products include data-driven Property Insurance, the Solar Revenue Put credit enhancement, the Wind Proxy Hedge, and the SolarScape market intelligence offering. kWh Analytics also publishes the annual Solar Risk Assessment industry report. There is no public developer portal, published API reference, or machine-readable API specification — data delivery and the HelioStats ingest API are arranged through enterprise engagement.

providers.name: Understory
providers.description: Understory is an insurtech company headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin (founded 2012) that combines its own network of ground-truth Dot weather sensors with a proprietary weather risk model to underwrite parametric insurance against severe weather, including hail coverage for automotive dealership open lots and agricultural weather risk. Its UnderstoryOS platform covers broker management, pricing and quoting, and automated weather-triggered claims. Understory publishes no public API or developer portal; the platform is offered to insurance partners rather than as a self-service developer product.

providers.name: Urban Jungle
providers.description: Urban Jungle Services Ltd is a London-based direct-to-consumer insurtech, founded in 2016 by Jimmy Williams and Greg Smyth to sell home insurance to "Generation Rent" — renters, sharers and students the traditional UK market underserves. It is an FCA-authorised intermediary (FRN 782061, company number 10414152, England and Wales) and a certified B Corp, selling contents, buildings and contents, students contents, tenants liability, landlord, home emergency and public liability cover through its own digital journey at myurbanjungle.com, and claiming over 100,000 customers. Its API posture is partner-gated and undocumented in public. Urban Jungle announced a partnership programme and quote API in 2018, positioned so lettings agents, PropTech firms, institutional landlords and eCommerce sites can serve Urban Jungle quotes inside their own apps without being directly FCA-regulated themselves, but there is no developer portal, no reference documentation, no machine- readable specification and no self-serve signup. The only route in is a partnerships email address on a marketing page. No ACORD, AL3 or NGDS reference appears anywhere on the company's site or in its front-end bundles.

providers.name: The Travelers Companies
providers.description: The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV) is a leading United States property and casualty (P&C) insurance carrier providing auto, home, and business insurance to individuals, agencies, businesses, government units, and associations. Travelers is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, generated approximately $48.83 billion in revenue in 2025, holds roughly $143.7 billion in total assets, and employs approximately 34,000 people plus 15,000 independent agents and brokers across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Republic of Ireland. The company operates through three reportable segments — Business Insurance, Bond & Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance — distributing primarily through a network of independent agents and brokers, and through direct-to-consumer channels for segments of its personal lines. Travelers has a developer portal at developer.travelers.com that surfaces APIs intended for appointed agents, agency-management-system (AMS) vendors, and integration partners; the portal is gated (Salesforce Experience Cloud) and individual API specifications, endpoints, and pricing are not publicly published. The company also publishes the IntelliDrive and IntelliDrivePlus telematics mobile apps used to score personal-auto driving behavior for rating credits.

providers.name: W. R. Berkley
providers.description: W. R. Berkley Corporation is one of the largest commercial lines property and casualty insurance holding companies in the United States, operating through more than 60 operating units in approximately 60 countries. The company operates across two business segments: Insurance and Reinsurance and Monoline. Subsidiaries include BerkleyNet (workers' compensation), Berkley Risk Administrators, and others. W. R. Berkley does not offer a public developer API, though subsidiary portals and agent portals provide limited policy, billing, and claims access.

providers.name: Beam Dental
providers.description: Beam Dental (Beam Benefits) is an employee benefits provider offering dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental health coverage (accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness) to brokers, employers, and members. The company streamlines benefits administration with digital quoting, self-service member, broker, and provider portals, and fast group implementation. Beam is backed by Kleiner Perkins. As of this enrichment pass Beam publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification; its digital surface is a set of login-gated member, broker/employer (Lighthouse), and provider web applications.

providers.name: Hilltop Holdings
providers.description: Hilltop Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Hilltop Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Chapter
providers.description: Chapter is a technology-driven Medicare advisory service (parent company Memoir, Inc.; insurance services via Chapter Advisory, LLC) that helps older Americans navigate retirement healthcare. Licensed advisors and self-service tools compare and enroll consumers across all major Medicare carriers nationwide, representing 50 organizations offering more than 15,000 products, and serving 500,000+ enrollees with a 4.9/5 rating across 6,700+ reviews. Chapter is HIPAA compliant, BBB accredited, and also ships a consumer OTC benefits app. Founded 2020 in New York City; backed by Addition. This is a consumer healthtech company with no public developer/API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Loop Health
providers.description: Loop Health is an India-based health assurance and group insurance company, founded in 2018 by Mayank Kale and Amrit Singh and headquartered in Pune. It combines traditional group hospitalization insurance with unlimited primary care, telemedicine, wellness programs, mental-health counseling, and an Employee Assistance Program, delivered to employers and their teams through asset-light clinics and a member app. Backed by General Catalyst, Elevation Capital and Y Combinator, Loop serves 1,250+ companies and 950,000+ members across India. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Loop Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Trupanion
providers.description: Trupanion is a pet medical insurance provider for cats and dogs, best known for its patented software that pays participating veterinary hospitals directly at checkout (VetDirectPay) rather than reimbursing pet owners after the fact. Trupanion operates a partner developer portal (Azure API Management) that exposes Partner APIs for Quotes, Enrollments, and Offers, plus a Vet Portal / VetDirectPay integration used by veterinary practice management systems such as ezyVet, IDEXX, and DaySmart Vet. API access is gated - partners must be approved through Trupanion's Partner Program and are issued OAuth client credentials (client ID and client secret) plus a subscription key; the endpoint reference is not publicly published. The APIs listed here are modeled from Trupanion's public partner and portal materials, not from an openly documented API reference.

providers.name: Envelop Risk
providers.description: Envelop Risk is a technology-led reinsurance underwriting and analytics firm specializing in cyber and other complex, emerging risks. The company combines actuarial science, machine learning, and cyber threat intelligence to model, price, and underwrite cyber (re)insurance for insurers, MGAs, and capital-market partners. Its platforms include CyberTooth (cyber risk modeling and augmented underwriting), Cyber Threat Intelligence, Envelop Capital Markets, and Envelop Risk Solutions (product development, analytics, modeling support). Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Envelop Risk surpassed a $1bn gross-written-premium milestone. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio-company lead; the company does not publish a public developer portal, API, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: FGL Holdings
providers.description: FGL Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The FGL Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Harper
providers.description: Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage founded in 2024 and headquartered in San Francisco. Harper pairs licensed insurance experts with a proprietary AI tech stack that automates core brokerage workflows — reading applications, routing submissions, following up with underwriters, and managing client communications — to place excess & surplus (E&S) and specialty commercial coverage across industries from trucking and construction to technology, CPG, and professional services. Businesses can get bound coverage in 24-48 hours rather than weeks. The company is backed by Emergence Capital and Y Combinator and raised a $47M Series A and seed round in early 2026. Harper does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Auto-Owners Insurance
providers.description: Auto-Owners Insurance is a mutual insurance company headquartered in Lansing, Michigan, offering auto, home, life, business, and farm insurance products through a network of independent agents. Founded in 1916, the company is consistently rated among the top mutual insurance companies in the United States. Auto-Owners provides online account management, claims filing, and agent portal services but does not currently offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Onsitego
providers.description: Onsitego is a Mumbai-based Indian consumer device-protection company that sells extended warranty, accidental and liquid damage protection, and repair and maintenance (AMC) plans for consumer electronics and home appliances including mobile phones, laptops, televisions, refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners. Sold at point of sale through 10,000+ retail stores and serviced via 3,300+ service centers, the company reports 2.5+ crore (25M+) customers and lets buyers activate coverage, manage devices and plans, and request service online. Onsitego is a portfolio company of Accel. No public developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Reserv
providers.description: Reserv is an insurance technology company and third-party administrator (TPA) that combines AI-powered automation with human claims expertise to handle property and casualty (P&C) claims for MGAs and carriers across North America, the UK, and the EU. Its platform pairs adjuster workflows with analytics dashboards, reporting, and structured claims data, positioning itself as the simplicity of a TPA with the benefits of an in-house team. Reserv is backed by 8VC, Anthemis, and Bain Capital Ventures. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.

providers.name: Vivere
providers.description: Vivere Partners is a technology-enabled Managing General Agent (MGA) that provides specialty property and management liability insurance solutions for complex risks. Founded and led by CEO Christopher McKechnie, who brings more than 25 years of insurance industry experience, Vivere combines deep underwriting expertise with advanced analytics and alternative data to deliver faster quotes, tailored coverage, and competitive terms for niche insurance lines, while giving carriers and capacity providers greater portfolio performance visibility. The company raised $7.5 million in seed funding led by General Catalyst, with participation from Pathlight Ventures and Greenlight Re.

providers.name: Anzen
providers.description: Anzen Technologies builds AI-powered market access software for commercial insurance agencies. Its flagship product, Anzen Pro, automates the commercial insurance quoting workflow: intelligent market matching predicts which carriers are most likely to respond to a submission based on historical quoting data, automated submission routing delivers each submission to a carrier's preferred channel (email, portal, or form), and submission intake extracts data from ACORDs, emails, and PDFs to generate branded client proposals in seconds. Anzen reports recovering roughly 80% of the time agency teams spend on administrative tasks and serves 200+ agencies while reducing errors-and-omissions exposure. The company holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and anchors its security program on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. Backed by a16z. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: COUNTRY Financial
providers.description: COUNTRY Financial is the marketing name for an Illinois-headquartered family of affiliated insurance and financial services companies that includes COUNTRY Life Insurance Company, COUNTRY Mutual Insurance Company, COUNTRY Casualty Insurance Company, COUNTRY Preferred Insurance Company, and related subsidiaries based in Bloomington, IL. Founded in 1925 by Illinois Agricultural Association members, COUNTRY today offers auto, home, life, farm, crop, and commercial insurance along with investment, retirement planning, and trust services through a captive agent network in 19 U.S. states. COUNTRY does not publish a public developer API; partner and agency integrations occur through internal agency systems.

providers.name: Indio Technologies
providers.description: Indio Technologies is a cloud-based insurance application and submissions platform for commercial insurance agencies and brokers, acquired by and now part of Applied Systems. Indio replaces manual PDF forms and spreadsheets with a library of 10,000+ digitally enhanced "smart" insurance forms and ACORD applications, a submission workspace that packages digital applications, schedule workbooks, document-upload requests and e-signature requests, plus secure document sharing. Indio does not publish a self-service public developer API. Programmatic access is partner/carrier-gated and delivered through Applied Systems - the Applied Epic bi-directional integration and SDK, the IVANS data exchange API (used to move submission and proposal data between agencies, brokers and carriers), and the Applied DevCenter partner developer program. The API surfaces below are modeled from Indio's documented product concepts (submissions, forms/applications, clients, documents and e-signatures); they are logical groupings, not publicly documented endpoints (endpointsModeled).

providers.name: Primerica
providers.description: Primerica is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Primerica API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Insurance Australia Group
providers.description: Insurance Australia Group (IAG, ASX: IAG) is the largest general insurance company in Australia and New Zealand, headquartered in Sydney and operating a portfolio of underwriting brands rather than a single consumer-facing label. In Australia it trades as NRMA Insurance, CGU, WFI, Swann Insurance and the digital-native ROLLiN'; in New Zealand as State, AMI, NZI and Lumley. Its lines of business are property and casualty — home and contents, motor, commercial, rural and farm, compulsory third party and specialty — split across a Direct Insurance Australia arm and an Intermediated Insurance Australia arm that sells through brokers and authorised representatives. IAG has no public, self-serve API surface. Probing every conventional developer hostname on iag.com.au, cgu.com.au and nrma.com.au found no developer portal and no published reference documentation; docs.iag.com.au exists but immediately redirects to a Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and is an internal wall, not a portal. What the probes did confirm is a real Apigee API gateway fronting three brand virtual hosts — api.iag.com.au, api.cgu.com.au and api.nrma.com.au — each returning an Apigee ApplicationNotFound fault at the root, meaning proxies exist but none is discoverable or documented to the public. A second round of probing added a fourth brand virtual host, api.wfi.com.au, and a publicly resolvable non-production Apigee organisation at test-api.iag.com.au. IAG has also deployed MuleSoft's Anypoint API Experience Hub and is migrating roughly 600 APIs onto it, with a stated intent to make them agent aware — a substantial API estate that is entirely internal. Broker and partner integration in this market runs through human-facing trading portals — CGU's PolicyPlace quote-and-bind platform, the Ebix Sunrise Exchange and the Steadfast Client Trading Platform — not through an open API programme. IAG does run a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure programme, and published an RFC 9116 security.txt across seven brand domains until it was withdrawn in mid-2025. Australia has the legal machinery for open insurance and no live obligation: the Consumer Data Right that opened banking and energy was flagged for general insurance and then paused, so nothing compels IAG to publish. This record is therefore an honest stub: a partner-gated carrier with a private gateway and zero public specifications.

providers.name: Net Worth
providers.description: netWorth (networth.mx) is a Mexico City fintech founded in 2016 and a 500 Startups (500 Global) Batch 10 company that helps individuals plan and manage retirement in Mexico. It specializes in Planes Personales de Retiro (PPR) and long-term savings and investment plans, combining human financial advisors (asesores) with digital tools such as retirement calculators and simulators, and commercializes plans backed by insurers and financial institutions such as Allianz and Skandia (Optimaxx Plus). The consumer product surfaces are a Webflow marketing site plus a client app at retiro.networth.mx and an authenticated portal at api.networth.mx; there is no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK program at this time.

providers.name: Snapsheet
providers.description: Snapsheet is a cloud-based property & casualty (P&C) claims management platform for insurance carriers, MGAs, and TPAs. It runs the full claims lifecycle with no-code workflow configuration, intelligent automation, document management, virtual vehicle appraisals, total-loss settlement, integrated claims payments, and analytics. Snapsheet reports serving 170+ customers, including 16 of the top 20 P&C carriers, and processing more than 400 million API calls per month. It exposes open APIs and webhooks to customers and partners for connecting policy, billing, underwriting, and vendor systems, though API access is arranged through its sales and partner channel rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Voya Financial
providers.description: Voya Financial (NYSE: VOYA) is a leading health, wealth, and investment company serving approximately 14.7 million individual, workplace, and institutional clients. Voya specializes in retirement plans, group employee benefits, health savings accounts (HSAs), and investment management. Their myVoyage platform integrates financial wellness tools to help participants plan, invest, and protect their financial futures. Voya does not offer a public developer API but provides account connectivity through open banking aggregators such as Plaid.

providers.name: Paynas
providers.description: Paynas is an Egyptian HR, payroll, and employee-benefits platform offering hassle-free, digitized human-resources management for businesses. Through a single web and mobile interface, Paynas handles attendance tracking, vacation and leave management, payroll processing, and reporting analytics, while extending financial services to employees through the Paynas Card — a Visa-powered payroll card issued in partnership with Banque Misr — and affordable medical-insurance packages provided in partnership with Libano-Suisse. Backed by 500 Global, the company serves employers across Egypt. Paynas publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gangkhar
providers.description: Gangkhar is an AI-native embedded protection infrastructure platform that lets digital platforms, insurers, MGAs, and brokers configure, launch, and continuously optimize embedded insurance products globally through a single infrastructure layer and API. Its Sherpa+ engine provides full-stack embedded protection rails covering onboarding, pricing, underwriting, and claims across multiple carriers and markets, while Sherpa+Lens applies real-time AI optimization to pricing, messaging, and product versions. The platform enables sectors like mobility, delivery, fintech, e-commerce, travel, health, and vertical SaaS to embed compliant protection directly into their customer experiences without becoming insurers themselves. Founded in 2025 and led by former Chubb executive Federico Spagnoli, Gangkhar closed a $4.25M seed round in March 2026 led by Anthemis. Surfaced as an Anthemis portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GetInsured
providers.description: GetInsured (Vimo, Inc.) is a SaaS technology provider for public-sector healthcare that powers state-based health insurance marketplaces (SBMs). Its platform handles eligibility and enrollment, plan shopping and comparison, and consumer-assistance contact-center operations for state ACA exchanges. GetInsured powers ten state marketplaces (including Idaho, Illinois, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Virginia, and Oregon, with Oregon launching in 2027) and supported the migration of roughly 4.5 million people off Healthcare.gov. It sells to state governments, insurance carriers, agents/brokers, and enrollment assisters. GetInsured does not publish a public self-serve developer portal or API; integrations are delivered under contract. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Globe Life
providers.description: Globe Life is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Globe Life API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Hippo
providers.description: Hippo is a US homeowners insurance carrier headquartered in Palo Alto, California, operating as the insurance subsidiary of Hippo Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HIPO). Founded in 2015, Hippo modernizes home insurance with instant online quotes — typically under sixty seconds — and a smart home oriented approach that pairs policies with proactive home maintenance guidance through the Hippo Home mobile app, DIY checklists, home health scoring, and partnerships with smart device makers. The company writes homeowners, condo, landlord, flood, auto, and pet policies and operates as both a direct-to-consumer brand and an MGA distributing through a network of 70+ carrier partners, including Bamboo, Stillwater, Nationwide, American Integrity, Liberty Mutual, and Progressive. Hippo's underwriting capacity is anchored by its wholly-owned admitted carrier, Spinnaker Insurance Company, acquired in 2020. Hippo serves 500K+ homeowners across the United States, with concentrated presence in Texas, California, Arizona, Colorado, Missouri, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia. There is no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Hippo or Spinnaker; the GitHub organization hippoinsurance exists but has no public repositories, and the api.hippo.com hostname is not exposed to the public internet. Integrations with smart home device partners, agents, and MGA carriers are handled through private partner channels rather than an open developer program.

providers.name: Sixfold
providers.description: Sixfold is a New York City-headquartered AI company building purpose-built artificial intelligence for insurance underwriting across Property & Casualty and Life & Health lines. Founded by Alex Schmelkin (CEO, previously co-founder of Unqork), Jane Tran (COO), and Brian Moseley (CTO, previously Head of Developer Experience at American Express), Sixfold processes unstructured submissions, automates risk research, produces appetite fit scores, generates cited case narratives, and applies underwriting guidelines consistently across submissions. The platform classifies risk using industry standards (SIC, NAICS, ISO), supports 40+ P&C and Life & Health business lines, and deploys either standalone or via a flexible API into existing underwriting workbench, CRM, and policy administration systems. Customers include Zurich North America, Guardian, Generali GC&C, Skyward Specialty, AXIS, and Mosaic Insurance, collectively representing roughly $265B in gross written premium. The company raised a $30M Series B in January 2026 and operates from offices in New York City and Lloyd's of London. Sixfold is the named provider behind these capabilities and is distinct from Cytora, a separate UK-based insurance AI provider. The platform is sold as enterprise SaaS to insurance carriers; there is no public self-serve developer portal, public API reference, SDKs, or open-source release — API integration is delivered under enterprise engagement.

providers.name: AXA
providers.description: AXA is a French multinational insurance firm and one of the world's largest providers of life, health, property & casualty, and asset management services. AXA does not publish a single global developer portal; technology integration is delivered through country-specific broker and partner portals, AXA Partners B2B2C distribution channels, AXA XL specialty insurance APIs for commercial brokers, and ACORD / EDI standards used across the insurance industry.

providers.name: Zurich Insurance
providers.description: A Swiss multinational insurance company and one of the world's largest insurers providing property, casualty, life, and specialty insurance products. Zurich operates a public API platform at exchange.zurich.com (Zurich Exchange / ConnectZ / Zurich Edge) that exposes 30+ internal and external APIs across policy, claims, quoting, partner analytics, procurement, and operations.

providers.name: Corvus (Travelers)
providers.description: Corvus by Travelers is a cyber-insurance provider offering Smart Cyber Insurance and Smart Tech E&O coverage alongside data-driven cyber risk management. Now part of Travelers, Corvus underwrites cyber policies using threat intelligence and AI-driven data, and pairs coverage with continuous threat monitoring, vulnerability detection, a cyber risk dashboard, and 24/7 incident response and claims support. The business is broker-focused, distributing through appointed brokers via its Broker Hub and broker sign-in portal. Corvus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Corvus Insurance
providers.description: Corvus Insurance — now operating as Corvus by Travelers — is a cyber-insurance managing general agency and insurtech company that pairs property and casualty underwriting with security-focused data science. It offers Smart Cyber Insurance and Smart Tech Errors & Omissions coverage, a Cyber Risk Dashboard that continuously scans policyholders' external attack surface for vulnerabilities and delivers threat intelligence and remediation guidance, 24/7 incident response and claims support, and broker tooling for collaborative quoting and renewal management. Founded in 2017 and backed by Insight Partners and Obvious Ventures, Corvus was acquired by Travelers in 2024 and now operates as a Travelers company. The public site exposes marketing, broker resources, and a broker portal, but no public developer API program.

providers.name: INZMO
providers.description: INZMO is a European insurtech, founded in 2017, delivering 100% digital, embedded insurance for consumer goods and rental deposits. Its products cover mobile phones, laptops and tablets, bicycles, e-scooters, and rental deposit warranties, sold direct-to-consumer and embedded into partner checkout flows. INZMO offers partners an embedded-insurance API that adds insurance to the customer journey with real-time policy issuance, payment, and delivery of policy documents, and applies AI and large language models to streamline fraud prevention and claims handling. INZMO is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Klaimee
providers.description: Klaimee is a Y Combinator (Spring/P26 batch) startup building certification, financial guarantee, and liability insurance for AI agents running in production. The company evaluates an autonomous agent across risk dimensions such as scope, data exfiltration, unauthorized action, output integrity, adversarial manipulation, behavioral stability, model drift, and operational control, then issues a letter-graded certification report with remediation guidance and a Klaimee-Verified badge that AI vendors use to clear enterprise procurement. Certified agents are backed by a financial guarantee and by AI liability insurance priced against the certification score, covering the gap that traditional errors-and-omissions and cyber policies explicitly exclude — hallucinated outputs, unauthorized actions, data exposure, prompt injection, and wrongful commitments. Klaimee also runs a public adversarial-testing playground where teams can stress-test an agent with probes for prompt injection, jailbreak, decision drift, data leakage, and biased outputs. Klaimee currently sells a human-delivered certification and underwriting service; it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation as of this enrichment pass. Founded in 2026 by Ines Boutemadja (CEO) and Julien Catonnet (CTO), based in San Francisco.

providers.name: Kaiser Permanente
providers.description: One of the largest nonprofit health plans in the United States integrating health insurance with healthcare delivery. Serves over 12 million members through its network of hospitals, medical offices, and health plan services. Publishes a patient access FHIR API at kp.org/fhir in compliance with the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule.

providers.name: Dayforward
providers.description: Dayforward is a New York-based life insurance technology and services group founded in 2019 by Aaron Shapiro. It owns Commercial Travelers Life Insurance Company (NY-domiciled carrier) and Dayforward Insurance Agency LLC (licensed in all 50 states), and sells income-replacement term life insurance direct to consumers at dayforward.com. Since pivoting to B2B at dayforward.io it licenses Workbench — a SaaS platform covering the full life insurance lifecycle from agent selling and automated underwriting through policy administration and service — plus managed distribution, underwriting and administration services to other carriers and distributors. Workbench is marketed as including "APIs, plug-and-play widgets, single sign-on support, and robust administration tools", but Dayforward publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition or SDKs.

providers.name: eHealth
providers.description: eHealth, Inc. (NASDAQ: EHTH) operates a licensed online health insurance marketplace where U.S. consumers can compare and enroll in health coverage from more than 180 insurance carriers across all 50 states and Washington, D.C. Founded in 1997, the company offers individual and family plans, Medicare products (Medicare Advantage, Medigap, and Part D prescription drug plans), small-business coverage, and Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements (ICHRA). eHealth also provides a partner-facing developer API, documented at its gated developer portal, that lets affiliates and partners embed health-insurance shopping, quoting, and enrollment into their own applications.

providers.name: Betterfly
providers.description: Betterfly is a Latin American insurtech and employee-benefits platform that combines voluntary insurance coverage with daily health engagement and rewards. Its integrated benefits product serves three audiences — brokers, employers, and employees — pairing guaranteed-issue life and health insurance with wellness programs, health assessments, and engagement mechanics so that employees actively use their benefits and employers gain visibility into participation and ROI. Founded in Chile, Betterfly operates across the region and is backed by QED Investors. This profile was surfaced from the QED Investors portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Betterfly publishes no public developer or API surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Breathe Life
providers.description: Breathe Life is a Montreal, Quebec based life insurance technology company — an enterprise SaaS core-systems vendor rather than a carrier or a broker — founded in 2018 to sell life insurers a modern new-business origination and distribution platform. Its product was the Breathe Life Hybrid Origination (Hybrid Distribution) Platform, sold either end-to-end or as four separately licensable modules: Quoter, Hybrid e-App, Advisor Tools and Data Dashboards, supporting advisor-driven, consumer self-serve, or blended selling of individual life products with simple and complex underwriting paths. Its home market is Canada, and its named clients were Canadian and North American life carriers, fraternals and faith-based insurers including Teachers Life, FaithLife Financial, National Bank Insurance, National Catholic Society of Foresters and La Capitale. The company raised CAD $11.5M in August 2020 from Diagram Ventures, Real Ventures and Investissement Quebec plus angels from AXA, AIG and RGA, was named to the 2020 InsurTech 100, and held PCI DSS, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3 attestations. SE2, an Eldridge business, announced its acquisition of Breathe Life on 2022-03-28; SE2 subsequently rebranded as Zinnia, and the Breathe Life site carried a "We are now part of Zinnia!" banner before being decommissioned. Its API posture is closed and now historical: as of the 2026-07-25 review Breathe Life never published a developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or Swagger definition, Postman collection, GraphQL endpoint, webhook catalog or ACORD/AL3 conformance claim on breathelife.com, and the domain no longer serves a site at all — breathelife.com returns an nginx "Site Not Configured" 404 and www.breathelife.com returns a WP Engine "Site is not available" 404. Quote, bind, issue and FNOL existed only as capabilities inside a carrier-licensed, login-gated SaaS product, never as an addressable public API.

providers.name: Inhabit
providers.description: Inhabit is a global PropTech software company operating a portfolio of specialized platforms for the residential and vacation rental property management markets, including ResMan, Streamline, LiveRez, Anyone Home, ResidentIQ, ePremium, Rental Guardian, Lynnbrook Group payments, Western Reporting screening, and Bluetent marketing. Its integrated tools span property management, resident and guest CRM and contact center, payments processing, renters and property insurance, tenant screening and income verification, utility billing, and marketing websites, serving multifamily, single-family, student, affordable, HOA and condo, and short-term vacation rental operators worldwide. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Photocert
providers.description: Photocert is a London-based visual AI company (a Techstars portfolio company) that authenticates photos and videos at the point of capture to prevent fraud, waste, and abuse across insurance and enterprise visual-inspection workflows. Its platform detects AI-generated images and deepfakes at scale, certifies media with claimed 99.99% accuracy, and automates motor, content, and property (water-leak) insurance claims. Photocert markets REST APIs and SDKs plus a white-label claim/onboarding platform and a camera API component for image certification, though no public developer documentation, OpenAPI, or self-service portal is published — integration is arranged via sales/demo. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from the Techstars portfolio and enriched with the honest public surface.

providers.name: Check24
providers.description: CHECK24 is Germany's largest online comparison portal (Vergleichsportal), founded in 1999 and headquartered in Munich. It lets more than 20 million customers compare prices and switch providers across over 50 categories, including car, life and health insurance, loans and bank accounts, electricity and gas, DSL and mobile tariffs, travel, rental cars, and online shopping. CHECK24 runs its own comparison calculators and a licensed bank (CHECK24 Bank), and integrates partner providers such as Allianz Direct through API-based connections. Backed by Accel, it is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a consumer company. CHECK24 maintains a verified GitHub organization and a GenDev developer scholarship program but publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Aon
providers.description: Aon plc is a London-headquartered global professional services firm delivering integrated risk and human capital advisory through two reporting pillars — Risk Capital (broking, reinsurance, risk analytics) and Human Capital (health, wealth, talent, rewards). The firm operates in over 120 countries, lists on the NYSE under the ticker AON, and grew its US middle-market footprint with the April 2024 acquisition of NFP for roughly $13B. Aon publishes named analytics platforms (Risk Analyzer suite, ReMetrica, CyQu, Spectrum, Impact Forecasting catastrophe models, Radford McLagan Compensation Database, SkillsGraph, Gauge, Revenue GPS) but those tools are delivered through gated client portals — no developer portal, OpenAPI catalog, SDK org, or public API reference is published on aon.com.

providers.name: UPMC
providers.description: A world-renowned health care provider and insurer headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. One of the largest nonprofit health systems in the United States, operating hospitals, physician practices, and a health insurance division (UPMC Health Plan) serving millions of members. UPMC Health Plan exposes an ONC 21st Century Cures Act Developer API for patient-authorized access to clinical and claims data over HL7 FHIR.

providers.name: Amparo
providers.description: Amparo is a Brazilian fintech that supports bereaved families in the days after a funeral. Its Central de Cadastros uses automated document reading and data extraction to register a family once and share that data across partner systems, while a WhatsApp assistant delivers personalized financial guidance covering INSS pension advances, life-insurance payouts, credit, repatriation reimbursements, and debt and inventory organization. Amparo exposes integration APIs so its Central de Cadastros can connect with funeral-home and insurer client systems. Backed by QED Investors.

providers.name: Chestnut
providers.description: Chestnut is an AI-native operating system for insurance distribution, built for insurance carriers to manage the entire producer lifecycle. The Seattle-based, Andreessen Horowitz-backed company combines a purpose-built insurance data model with an API-first architecture and an agentic AI layer, providing producer onboarding automation (including NIPR integration), hierarchy configuration, incentive compensation management, debt management, performance tracking, and compensation intelligence. Chestnut positions its platform as a system of record that bridges carriers' operational needs to an agentic AI future, with an API-first, MCP-ready backend. Its public API and developer documentation are gated for carrier customers, so no public specification is available for the catalog at this time.

providers.name: CNO Financial Group
providers.description: CNO Financial Group is an Indiana-based insurance holding company that develops, markets, and administers life and health insurance, annuities, and workforce benefits solutions through brands including Bankers Life, Colonial Penn, Washington National, Optavise, and PMA USA. CNO does not publish a public-facing developer portal or API; integrations are run via partner channels (CRM, Pega Cloud platform, and brand-specific producer portals).

providers.name: Insurdata
providers.description: Insurdata is a re/insurance technology company providing global, best-in-class geocoding and property exposure data. Its unique multi-sourced methodology delivers the highest-resolution, building-level geocoding available worldwide, together with building-perimeter and property-characteristic data that lets underwriters and catastrophe modelers assess risk at the individual-property level at the point of underwriting. Insurdata's augmented exposure data has been used in collaborative studies with carriers such as Canopius and flood modelers such as Fathom to sharpen exposure levels and average-annual-loss (AAL) forecasts. The company is a portfolio company of Anthemis and serves the global re/insurance market.

providers.name: Kayum
providers.description: Kayum (KAYUM, S.A.P.I. de C.V.) is a Mexico City-based insurance data-analytics and software company serving the Mexican insurance market. It gives insurers exclusive, continuously updated market intelligence and actionable analysis: monthly price panels for GMM (major-medical), Life, and Auto lines backed by data from more than ten leading insurers, competitive pricing models, a quotation-processing tool (Claveteador) that compresses quote data preparation from days to minutes, customer-facing quoting platforms (Cotizadores) processing over 100,000 auto quotes a month, and compliance/document verification tooling (Suite 492 / ID Documental). Backed by 500 Global. The company publishes a marketing website but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: One Assist
providers.description: OneAssist is an Indian consumer protection and services company that provides device and appliance protection, extended warranty, and financial-fraud assistance to retail customers. Its offerings span gadget protection for mobile phones, laptops, wearables, and tablets (accidental damage and extended warranty coverage), home appliance repair and maintenance for air conditioners, televisions, washing machines, refrigerators, water purifiers, and geysers, wallet and card fraud protection, credit-card bill-payment assistance, and furniture, motor, and jewelry insurance plans. The company reports serving over 1.8 crore active customers across 19,000+ pincodes and resolving more than 25 lakh issues. OneAssist is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this profile, OneAssist publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it operates a consumer-facing web and mobile experience only.

providers.name: Panta
providers.description: Panta is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage that automates the operations layer of insurance placement. Rather than selling software to brokers, Panta operates as a licensed broker (all 50 states) whose AI operators handle submissions, follow-ups, service, and renewals across file systems, carrier portals, email, phone, and PDFs. It focuses on hard-to-place Excess & Surplus (E&S) and heavy-industry risk — construction and trades, transportation and logistics (trucking fleets, owner-operators, cargo), manufacturing, and hospitality — placing coverage across General Liability, Workers Compensation, Commercial Auto, Property, Cyber, Professional Liability, Umbrella/Excess, and Employment Practices Liability through an A-rated carrier panel. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company. Panta publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Solace Health
providers.description: Solace Health (solace.health) is a US healthcare navigation and patient-advocacy platform that matches patients and family caregivers with dedicated advocates, many covered by insurance, to handle administrative tasks, coordinate care and referrals, and fight for approvals and treatments. Advocates support members by video, phone, text, and email nationwide across a range of insurance plans, with a member app at app.solace.health. The company is venture-backed (IVP among its investors). As of this enrichment pass, Solace publishes a patient-facing service only and exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Western & Southern Financial Group
providers.description: Western & Southern Financial Group is a Fortune 500 diversified family of financial services companies headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. Founded in 1888, the group offers life insurance, annuities, mutual funds, asset management, retirement planning, and investment management through a family of subsidiaries including Western & Southern Life, Columbus Life, Gerber Life, Integrity Life, Lafayette Life, Fort Washington Investment Advisors, Touchstone Investments, and W&S Financial Group Distributors, with over $112 billion in assets under management.

providers.name: Policybazaar
providers.description: Policybazaar is India's largest online insurance aggregator and digital marketplace, operated by PB Fintech Ltd. It lets consumers compare, buy and manage insurance across health, term life, motor, travel, investment and corporate lines from a wide panel of insurers, providing quotes, policy issuance, renewals, claims assistance and advisory. Surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Policybazaar publishes a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (no developer/API subdomain, no /.well-known documents, no llms.txt).

providers.name: Anywhere 2 Go
providers.description: Anywhere 2 Go Co., Ltd. is a Bangkok, Thailand insurtech company and the maker of Claim Di, a mobile application ecosystem that streamlines motor insurance claims and vehicle inspection between drivers, independent surveyors, and insurance companies. Its flagship "Shake and Go" (K4K) feature lets two Claim Di users resolve minor accidents on the spot, while Emergency Alert, self-service Car Inspection, photo-based Non-Accident Claims, and the Claim Di Bike surveyor-dispatch program cut claim processing time and help insurers reduce fraud. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. Claim Di is a consumer/B2B mobile product (iOS and Android); no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Cyberwrite
providers.description: Cyberwrite is an AI-powered cyber insurance intelligence platform that turns raw data into explainable, defensible financial decisions for the cyber insurance lifecycle. Founded in 2016 and operating from Tel Aviv and New York, its platform combines the 4SEEN AI risk-profiling algorithm with Vivaldi cyber insurance orchestration to deliver real-time cyber risk analytics, cyber risk quantification, third-party risk management, and cyber catastrophe (accumulation) modeling. Users enter a company name, URL, industry, and country and receive a one-page cyber risk report in under a minute, with coverage spanning the vast majority of businesses globally in multiple languages. Cyberwrite delivers its data to insurers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs, corporates, ILS investors, and private equity firms in real time through the Cyberwrite API for underwriting automation and aggregated portfolio risk management. Partners include Markel, Howden, HSB, Mastercard Start Path, and Navacord. Added to the API Evangelist network via the speedinvest portfolio and enriched here from Cyberwrite's public web surface.

providers.name: Cyberwrite
providers.description: Cyberwrite is an AI-powered cyber insurance intelligence platform, founded in 2017, that turns raw data into explainable, defensible financial decisions for the cyber insurance market. Its proprietary 4SEEN AI engine assesses cyber risk, forecasts breaches, simulates financial impact, and recommends mitigation, giving brokers, carriers, reinsurers, MGAs, ILS investors, and corporates access to cyber risk analytics, catastrophe modeling, and risk quantification on more than 100 million companies worldwide in seconds and in eight languages. Cyberwrite delivers its scoring and analytics through an enterprise API for real-time aggregated risk management; the platform is a Gartner Cool Vendor and DIA Top 100 InsurTech, and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: EvolutionIQ
providers.description: EvolutionIQ is an AI-native insurance technology company providing claims guidance software for the insurance industry. Its platform surfaces claim-specific, actionable guidance to help claims professionals resolve complex cases, spanning Auto Casualty, Group & Individual Disability, Workers' Compensation, and Income Protection lines of business, plus Medhub, which converts unstructured medical records into claim-specific insights. Backed by First Round Capital and ICONIQ Capital, the company reports outcomes such as a 5-10 point reduction in combined ratio and 20%+ improvement in handling capacity. EvolutionIQ operates as a B2B enterprise vendor and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public-surface security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kinro
providers.description: Kinro is an AI-powered commercial insurance brokerage for small businesses, founded in the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch and based in San Francisco. Its autonomous AI agents run the full broker workflow around the clock, from prospect identification and quote preparation through comparison, binding, and ongoing certificate and renewal servicing. Kinro targets the roughly 77% of the 36 million U.S. small businesses that are underinsured because traditional brokers cannot profitably serve low-premium accounts. It is licensed across 30 states, appointed by 15+ carriers with access to 50+ markets, and offers general liability, business owner's policies, workers' compensation, commercial auto and trucking, professional liability, cyber, and more. Kinro was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; it currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Alan
providers.description: Alan is a Paris-based digital health insurance and wellness company founded in 2016 by Jean-Charles Samuelian-Werve and Charles Gorintin. It was the first independent health insurance provider licensed in France in over fifty years and offers an integrated product combining complementary health insurance ("mutuelle"), prevention, and care delivery through a single mobile and web experience. Alan's product surface includes group and individual health plans (Alan Santé), retirement plans (Alan Dolce Vita), public-sector and self-employed offerings, an HR/benefits admin dashboard for employers, an in-house telehealth and chat-care service (Clinique Alan) staffed by salaried clinicians, a gamified prevention and step-tracking program (Alan Play / Alan Mind), and vision/optical benefits with zero out-of-pocket pricing. The company reports over one million members and roughly 33,000 client businesses, operates in France, Belgium, and Spain, and reached a reported €5B valuation in its 2026 Series F round. Engineering and product practice is documented publicly on the Alan Product and Technical Blog at medium.com/alan, and a small portfolio of internal-tools and design assets (most notably react-native-fast-shadow and the Alan Sans typeface) is open-sourced on github.com/alan-eu. Alan does not publish a public-facing developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK; all member and employer interactions happen through Alan's first-party apps and the HR/benefits dashboard.

providers.name: Climavision
providers.description: Climavision is a Louisville, Kentucky weather intelligence company that combines a proprietary nationwide supplemental network of low-altitude X-band, dual-polarization gap-filling weather radars with AI-driven numerical weather prediction (NWP) to deliver enterprise-grade forecasts and observational data. Its Horizon AI product line includes Horizon Point for site-specific forecasts, Horizon Global for ground-to-high- altitude global models, Horizon HI-RES for custom high-resolution local forecasting, and Horizon S2S for subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction. Climavision exposes a Weather API hosted at point-forecast-api.climavision.com with 1,800+ parameters, 15-day forecasts, and bearer-token authentication, plus a separate Radar Status API and Radar-as-a-Service offering that supplies Level II files, NetCDF, and GeoTIFF radar data products (reflectivity, velocity, dual-pol-derived QPE at 1km, precipitation type, tornado debris detection) for coverage below 4,000 feet where NEXRAD cannot see due to Earth curvature. The company integrates its radar feed into MRMS and has provided supplemental data into the National Weather Service's AWIPS software. Climavision processes 1.5+ billion datasets daily, serves customers across agriculture, aviation, commodity trading, drones and Advanced Air Mobility, energy and utilities, government, insurance and reinsurance, media, and transportation and logistics, and raised a $100 million strategic investment from TPG's Rise Fund. API access is gated through a sales-led contact process; no public sandbox or open-source SDKs are published, and the Climavision GitHub organization (github.com/Climavision) currently has only two minor public repositories (an archived Azure Table Storage helper and a GeoServer Helm chart fork).

providers.name: Vymo
providers.description: Vymo is a sales-engagement and distribution-management platform for financial institutions — banks, insurers, and asset managers — helping field sales and collections teams manage leads, allocate and prioritize activities, and capture engagement in a mobile-first app. It layers AI-driven nudges, activity capture, and analytics on top of CRM and core systems, and integrates with existing enterprise ecosystems. Vymo does not publish a self-serve public developer API or documentation portal; its integrations are delivered through enterprise/partner connections. Backed by Emergence Capital and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.

providers.name: Balance Re
providers.description: Balance Re is a fully licensed German life reinsurance company headquartered in Cologne, with an office in London, offering asset-liability management (ALM) reinsurance solutions to life insurers and pension funds. Its proprietary technology delivers real-time analytics that help clients manage capital and liquidity, price and transfer longevity, savings and retirement risk, and improve competitiveness through quantitative asset-liability management. Balance Re raised a $10M Series A in 2021 led by Anthemis Group, with participation from Global Brain, Roland Berger Industries and Talabot Finance. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Karpatia Benefits
providers.description: Karpatia Benefits is an all-in-one corporate employee-benefits management platform used by 100+ companies to administer insurance, sports and education allowances, and mental-health support for distributed teams. It combines a benefits marketplace of 40+ partner vendors offering corporate discounts, reimbursement processing, and HR analytics dashboards, and says it removes roughly 95% of the administrative work of running a benefits program. The company primarily serves Ukrainian companies with multi-country localization. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Ramre
providers.description: Ramre (RamRe) is the brand associated with Ram Reinsurance, now operating as American Overseas Group Limited (AOG) — a Bermuda-based insurance holding company that is tax resident in the United Kingdom. Through its U.S. subsidiaries the group writes non-standard automobile insurance and provides related management services, and it operates as a reinsurer through a subsidiary based in Barbados. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. An enrichment pass found no public developer program, API, documentation, or SDK surface: this is a financial-services holding company whose public web presence (ramre.com now redirects to aoreltd.com) is corporate and investor-relations oriented, with no machine-readable API artifacts to catalog.

providers.name: Soma
providers.description: Soma (Soma Insurance Services) is a commercial insurance brokerage that positions itself as the fastest brokerage for complex businesses, placing customized commercial-lines coverage across industries including retail, trucking, hospitality, healthcare, finance, technology, manufacturing, and construction. Coverage lines include general liability, commercial auto, cyber liability, professional liability, and builder's risk. Backed by Accel and Cowboy Ventures in the insurance-tech sector. As of this enrichment pass Soma publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: wefox
providers.description: wefox is a Berlin-headquartered digital insurance distribution platform that connects insurance carriers, brokers, and end customers through a single technology stack. Founded in 2014 and originally known as FinanceFox, the company operates across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, and France, selling personal-lines products such as motor, home, liability, life, and commercial insurance via its in-house carrier (wefox Insurance) and a network of independent brokers. wefox positions itself as an "indirect" insurtech — meaning it distributes through human advisors augmented by software rather than selling direct-to-consumer — and has historically been one of Europe's most highly funded insurtech companies, with backing from Mubadala, Target Global, Salesforce Ventures, OMERS Ventures, Eurazeo, Mountain Partners, and others. The platform itself is a multi-tenant SaaS used by brokers and agents to manage customer relationships, quote and bind policies across multiple carriers, handle claims, and trigger commissions. wefox does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or a github.com/wefox organization; integration with the wefox platform is carrier-, broker-, and partner-mediated rather than self-service, and there is no Tier-1 developer surface to document. This repo profiles wefox as an insurance distribution business and tracks any future move toward a public API program.

providers.name: Porch
providers.description: Porch Group is a home services and home insurance platform operating across the full lifecycle of the home.
