Trading on Nasdaq as PRCH, the company combines a vertical software business for home inspectors, moving companies, title and mortgage providers, and contractors with a consumer-facing home insurance carrier (Porch Insurance Reciprocal Exchange), home warranty, and a moving-concierge app that helps homeowners set up utilities, security, and services. Porch reaches a large share of U.S. homebuyers each year through its inspection-software network, using that unique early-in-the-home-lifecycle data to power insurance, warranty, and moving offerings. This profile was seeded as a Battery Ventures portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Porch publishes no public developer API, but it does operate a responsible disclosure program and RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: Suncorp Group
providers.description: Suncorp Group Limited (ASX: SUN) is an Australian general insurance group headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland, serving customers across Australia and New Zealand. Following the sale of Suncorp Bank to ANZ on 31 July 2024 it operates as a pure-play insurer, underwriting personal lines (motor, home and contents, caravan, landlord) and commercial lines (SME packages, commercial motor and motor fleet, property/ISR, liability, professional and financial risks, workers' compensation, surety, and specialty lines including residential strata and equipment breakdown) through a portfolio of brands: in Australia AAMI, Apia, Bingle, CIL, GIO, Essentials by AAI, Shannons, Suncorp, Terri Scheer and Vero, and in New Zealand Vero and AA Insurance. Its API posture is partner-gated and there is no public API. As of a 2026-07-25 review, Suncorp Group publishes no first-party developer portal, no API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger definition on suncorpgroup.com.au or on any brand domain: the developer/developers/docs/api subdomains of suncorpgroup.com.au do not resolve, /developers and /api return HTTP 404 on the brand sites, and the corporate sitemap (803 URLs) plus the AAMI, GIO, Suncorp and Vero brand sitemaps (2,007 URLs) contain zero developer, API or integration paths. The only machine-to-machine integration surface is intermediated and behind a login: the VeroEdge / Vero Intermediary Portal for brokers (Access Single ID), a third-party Uniwriter underwriting portal for Engineers PI and Strata, and distribution through Australian broker trading networks — the Steadfast Client Trading Platform (SCTP), Sunrise Exchange, and direct Broker Management System connections. Australia has no live open-insurance obligation: the Consumer Data Right that opened banking and energy was never switched on for general insurance, so unlike Suncorp Bank there is no mandated public product-reference-data endpoint here. No ACORD, AL3 or NGDS reference was found anywhere on Suncorp Group or brand properties.

providers.name: Hosta a.i.
providers.description: Hosta a.i. is an AI-powered remote property assessment platform that turns ordinary photographs from any camera into precise measurements, detailed floor plans, material classifications, condition assessments, and bills of materials. Using patented AI spatial and material analytics, Hosta automates onsite property analysis without specialized equipment or site visits, and exposes these capabilities through configurable APIs so insurers, appraisers, inspectors, contractors, property managers, home-improvement platforms, and furniture retailers can embed remote assessment into their existing workflows and systems. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Hosta is a Techstars- and Eclipse-backed company operating on a secure AWS cloud platform with PII filtering protections.

providers.name: Leap To Win Technologies Private
providers.description: Leap To Win Technologies Private Limited is a Bengaluru, India company incorporated on 26 June 2024 (CIN U62090KA2024PTC190203) that operates Propico (propico.in), a rental guarantee and property management service. For property owners Propico underwrites a fixed guaranteed monthly rent with zero-vacancy risk, handling tenant screening and placement, rent collection, inspections, maintenance coordination and legal compliance; for tenants it sells rental protection plans covering unfair security-deposit deductions and surprise move-out costs. The company markets two packages - a Premium Guaranteed plan and a Standard property-management plan - and serves Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR and Pune. Propico runs a marketing and customer web app backed by an authenticated multi-service API gateway at api.propico.in, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or OpenAPI definition. It does publish a well-formed llms.txt, making it agent-discoverable as a content surface even though it exposes no programmable interface.

providers.name: Zudo
providers.description: Zudo builds AI-powered agents purpose-built for the warranty industry, automating customer service and back-office operations for home warranty, auto warranty, and OEM third-party administrators. Its agents (Adam for customer service, Emma for operations) handle claim follow-ups, initiations, and authorizations around the clock to improve warranty customer experience and operating margins. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site is marketing-only with no developer/API surface published at enrichment time.

providers.name: Universal American
providers.description: Universal American was a health insurance holding company that focused on providing Medicare Advantage and Medicare prescription drug benefit plans to seniors. The company operated Medicare managed care plans in partnership with Accountable Care Organizations and primary care physicians before being acquired by WellCare Health Plans in 2017 for approximately $800 million.

providers.name: Cincinnati Financial
providers.description: Cincinnati Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: CINF) is a property and casualty insurer headquartered in Fairfield, Ohio, that markets a full suite of business, home, auto, and life insurance products plus investment services exclusively through a network of independent insurance agencies. Cincinnati Financial does not currently operate a public developer portal or expose customer-facing APIs; agency, claims, and policyholder access is delivered through web portals (cinfin.com, onlineservice.cinfin.com, and the Cincinnati Insurance Mobile App), with technical integrations for appointed agencies handled directly by Cincinnati Insurance IT support.

providers.name: American Equity Investment Life Holding
providers.description: American Equity Investment Life Holding Company is a leading provider of guaranteed income solutions, specializing in the design, development, and sale of fixed indexed and fixed-rate annuity products distributed through independent agents and broker-dealers. The company offers products including IncomeShield, AssetShield, EstateShield, and GuaranteeShield annuities, providing retirees with lifetime income, principal protection, tax-deferred growth, and legacy planning options.

providers.name: Duane Morris
providers.description: Duane Morris LLP is a Philadelphia-headquartered, full-service U.S. and international law firm founded in 1904 by Russell Duane, Steven Heckscher, and Roland S. Morris. Chaired by Matthew A. Taylor, the firm describes itself as "a law firm with more than 900 attorneys in offices across the United States and internationally" — with a U.S. footprint spanning the East Coast, Texas, the Mountain West, and California, plus international offices in London, Singapore, Vietnam (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City), Shanghai, Myanmar, and joint ventures/alliances reaching Mexico and Latin America. An Am Law 100 firm since 2001, Duane Morris is known for depth in intellectual property (including patent prosecution and PTAB practice), trial and appellate litigation, real estate, corporate transactions, employment, healthcare, cannabis, and life sciences. The firm publishes an extensive LexBlog-powered thought-leadership network of more than 50 practice-area blogs, all of which expose RSS 2.0 feeds via the standard WordPress /feed/ convention. Duane Morris does not expose any public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, GraphQL endpoint, webhooks, status page, or developer portal; the GitHub organization github.com/duanemorris exists but has no public repositories. The firm's only machine-readable surfaces are the RSS feeds of its blog network.

providers.name: MisMar
providers.description: MisMar (مسمار) is a Saudi Arabian automotive maintenance and repair platform that connects vehicle owners with certified service centers. It runs a consumer mobile app (B2C) alongside a Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) platform and Workshop Management System (WMS) that digitize fleet management, order processing, and workshop operations for business (B2B), government (B2G), and insurance partners. Services span fault diagnostics, accident restoration, oil and battery and tire changes, periodic maintenance, car wash, and protective treatments across 45+ Saudi cities, with at-home or center-based delivery and warranty coverage. MisMar is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is currently published.

providers.name: Penn Mutual
providers.description: The Penn Mutual Life Insurance Company is a mutual life insurer founded in 1847 and headquartered in Horsham, Pennsylvania, making it one of the oldest mutual life insurance companies in the United States. Owned by its policyholders, Penn Mutual offers life insurance and annuity products distributed primarily through career and independent financial professionals, and operates through a family of companies including Vantis Life Insurance Company, Hornor Townsend & Kent (HTK) broker-dealer, and the Penn Insurance and Annuity Company (PIA). Penn Mutual divested its long-held wealth management subsidiary, Janney Montgomery Scott, to KKR in 2024.

providers.name: American Family Insurance
providers.description: American Family Insurance is a private mutual company that offers auto, homeowners, life, renters, umbrella, business, and farm/ranch insurance throughout the United States. The company serves customers through a network of exclusive agents, digital tools including the MyAmFam mobile app, and online self-service capabilities. American Family is headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, and is one of the largest property-casualty insurers in the country.

providers.name: Assurely
providers.description: Assurely is a United States insurtech and managing general agent (MGA) founded by David Carpentier and Ty Sagalow that builds and distributes commercial property-and-casualty insurance for companies with unconventional funding models, most notably TigerMark, a directors-and-officers (D&O) product written for Regulation CF / Regulation A crowdfunding issuers and early-stage startups that incumbent carriers decline. Assurely positioned itself as an "Insurance-as-a-Service" (IaaS) provider embedding industry-specific products plus a multi-carrier marketplace into vertical SaaS operating systems in fintech and capital raising, proptech and construction, property management, blockchain and digital assets, and SMB marketplaces (named partners include Wefunder, Silicon Prairie, Fairmint, Dalmore Group, Buildertrend and CoConstruct), and stated licensing in all 50 states and Bermuda. Its API posture is the honest floor of this sector — no public, self-serve developer portal, no API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI was ever published. "Embedded" here meant a commercial partnership with white-labeled quote-and-bind web flows on client.assurely.com and tigermark.assurely.com plus human advisory and administration, not a documented partner API. Assurely was acquired by Equal Parts on 2025-06-26, and as of the 2026-07-25 review its entire public surface is offline — www.assurely.com returns HTTP 404 as an expired Squarespace site, and api./client./tigermark.assurely.com are dangling CNAMEs to a deleted AWS load balancer. Home market is the United States.

providers.name: Ensurance
providers.description: Ensurance Limited (ASX:ENA) was an Australian ASX-listed insurance underwriting agency headquartered in Perth, Western Australia, marketing itself as "innovating the online insurance sector." Its Australian arm, Ensurance Underwriting Australia, operated as a wholesale underwriting agency under an Australian Financial Services Licence, assembling a consortium of local and international capacity — including Lloyd's, Swiss Re and XL Catlin — behind construction-specific products sold exclusively through intermediaries: Licensed Builder Annual Construction, Plant and Liability, Project-Specific Construction, Trades Liability, Owner Builder, and Home and Contents insurance, distributed to a broker network the company described as 340-plus intermediaries. A sister company, Ensurance UK Limited, ran as a Managing General Agent authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and a coverholder at Lloyd's. The group's API posture is nil and always was. Ensurance never published a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or Swagger definition, Postman collection, GraphQL endpoint, webhook or event catalogue. What the company called its "customised online platform" for intermediaries was BOB (bob.ensurance.com.au), a form-based, session-login ASP.NET MVC quote-and-proposal wizard keyed to per-agent codes — an agent login wall, not a programmable interface. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference appears anywhere in the company's live or archived web estate. As of this review the ensurance.com.au TLS certificate has expired and every path on the domain, along with the ensurance.ltd domain family, blanket 301-redirects to Chase Underwriting Solutions Pty Ltd, an Australian professional-lines underwriting agency that likewise publishes no API. Ensurance is recorded here as a partner-gated, no-public-API insurance provider in the Australian market — a faithful data point for a sector where the Consumer Data Right was designated for general insurance and then deferred, leaving carriers and underwriting agencies with no forcing function to expose anything.

providers.name: ZhongAn Insurance
providers.description: ZhongAn Online P&C Insurance Co., Ltd. is China's first online-only insurance company, founded in 2013 by Ant Financial, Tencent, and Ping An and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (6060) in 2017. Headquartered in Shanghai, ZhongAn sells digital insurance across health, consumer finance, auto, and lifestyle lines entirely through internet channels, and operates a partner "open platform" (open.zhongan.com) plus a technology arm, ZhongAn Technology (zhongan.io), that offers insurtech and cloud services. ZhongAn does not publish a self-serve public developer API program or OpenAPI documentation; integration is partner/ecosystem-driven. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of softbank-vision-fund and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: OpenEyes Insurance
providers.description: OpenEyes Insurance (OpenEyes Insurance Agency, Inc.) is an Austin, Texas-based insurtech startup, with an additional New York office, that provides commercial auto insurance for truck and bus fleet operators bundled with proprietary risk-prevention technology. Its offering pairs fleet coverage with real-time driver monitoring, AI dashcams, safety analytics, customized driver training, and 24/7 claims management, serving both insurance agents (For Agents) and fleet operators directly (For Fleets). Founded by Yoav Oron (CEO), Dr. Omry Sendik (CTO), and Dan Charash (Chairman), OpenEyes emerged from stealth in February 2023 with a $23M Series A led by Insight Partners with Pitango First. The company operates a customer-facing fleet dashboard but does not publish a public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Securian Financial Group
providers.description: Securian Financial Group is a financial services holding company that provides life insurance, retirement solutions, investment management, and group benefits to individuals, businesses, and institutions.

providers.name: Bringy, Inc.
providers.description: Bringy, Inc. is a digital insurance brokerage operating in Egypt, founded in 2019 and licensed by the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA License #100). Through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps, Bringy lets consumers compare, select, purchase, and manage insurance policies online, positioning itself as a digital insurance advisor that guides customers from policy selection through claims and compensation. Coverage lines include car, business, medical, personal-accident, and home insurance, with payment via Visa, Mastercard, Meeza, mobile wallets, and installment providers (ValU, Sympl, Souhoola). Bringy was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a consumer marketing site and blog but no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Shepherd
providers.description: Shepherd is a technology-driven commercial insurance provider offering coverage for the builders and operators shaping the physical world. It underwrites Primary Casualty, Excess Casualty, and Builder's Risk lines for the construction and renewable-energy sectors, using data and an in-house AI underwriting engine (Nova) to deliver faster indications and modernized risk assessment. Shepherd sells through insurance brokers rather than exposing a public developer platform; it has issued 1,500+ policies across $400B+ in insured volume. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Costanoa Ventures and enriched by the pipeline; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Shepherd 3
providers.description: Shepherd is a Y Combinator-backed (W21) insurtech modernizing commercial insurance for the construction and renewable energy sectors. Using technology and data-driven underwriting, it delivers faster decisions and clearer risk insights across Primary Casualty, Excess Casualty, and Builder's Risk coverage for middle-market to enterprise builders and operators. As of this enrichment pass Shepherd does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or a developer portal — this profile captures the company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Grace
providers.description: Grace (Grâce) is a Paris-based insurtech that lets luxury maisons offer their clients complimentary, embedded protection against theft, loss, and damage for high-value goods such as watches, jewelry, and accessories. Founded in 2022 and backed by Speedinvest and FinTech Collective, Grace pairs a top-tier underwriter with a technology platform that handles instant coverage, fraud detection, claims processing, and logistics through the Grace app, and integrates into a brand's existing purchase journeys via a customizable API. The company raised a €5.9M seed round in 2025 and operates across Europe and beyond. Grace publishes no public developer portal or API specification; its API is a private, partner-facing integration offered to luxury brands.

providers.name: InRisk
providers.description: InRisk Labs is a climate insurtech company building parametric insurance products for climate and disaster risk financing. Its platform pairs an AI-driven pricing engine, real-time geospatial and weather monitoring, and blockchain smart contracts to deliver rapid, data-triggered payouts across 15+ parametric products spanning agriculture (crop, livestock, agri-input), renewable energy (solar, wind), logistics, tourism, energy demand, infrastructure protection, and wage and business-interruption cover. Risk models incorporate global climate drivers such as ENSO and IOD and range from India to global coverage. InRisk exposes an "API on-demand" so insurance partners can integrate customized products, dynamic pricing, and real-time analytics into their own infrastructure. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Slice Labs
providers.description: Slice Labs is a New York-based insurtech company that operates as an insurance-as-a-service cloud platform provider. Founded in 2015 and publicly launched in 2016, Slice originally offered on-demand insurance products for the sharing economy (homeshare, rideshare, cyber) and then pivoted to offering its underlying digital insurer stack — branded Insurance Cloud Services (ICS) — to other carriers, MGAs, and brands. The ICS platform packages pricing, rating, licensing, real-time and automated underwriting, policy servicing, claims, and capacity into a cloud-hosted, API-embeddable subscription. The company's modern product surface focuses on 100% digital small-business insurance distributed through agents and partners (currently Contractors General Liability, with Commercial Real Estate and Excess Casualty announced as coming soon) on top of Slice Mind, an AI/ML, behavioral-science, and LLM-driven intelligence layer. Slice Labs publicly markets its platform as "fully embeddable via API," but the developer portal, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, and endpoint reference are not exposed on the open web — integration is gated behind a B2B carrier/partner relationship. The official GitHub organization (github.com/slicelabs) exists but is archived with zero public repositories, and there is no public developer.slice domain serving documentation. As a result this profile captures the company, product, and platform surface only; no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, Naftiko capability, plan, rate-limit, or FinOps artifact is generated here because none of the underlying contracts are publicly observable.

providers.name: Healthy Labs
providers.description: Healthy Labs is a healthcare and insurance technology company that powers a portfolio of digital health brands driving membership growth for Medicare and ACA (Affordable Care Act) insurance providers. Its offerings center on consumer lead generation, compliance and operational analytics, and member acquisition and retention optimization for the health-insurance market. The company has since rebranded as MPA (mpa.com), positioning itself as an AI-powered platform for licensed insurance professionals and agencies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub, this profile is enriched from public sources; no public developer program, OpenAPI specification, or API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: ComparaOnline
providers.description: ComparaOnline is a Latin American digital marketplace and licensed insurance broker that lets consumers compare and buy insurance and financial products in one place. Operating in Chile (comparaonline.cl), Brazil (comparaonline.com.br) and Colombia (comparaonline.com.co), it aggregates offers for auto insurance, mandatory SOAP accident insurance, travel, life, health and pet insurance alongside financial products such as mortgage, auto and consumer loans, credit cards and checking accounts. Its Chilean brokerage, Compara Online Corredora de Seguros SpA, is supervised by the Comision para el Mercado Financiero (CMF), and the company earns revenue as a broker collecting premiums and by referring users to partner banks and insurers. ComparaOnline is a fintech/insurtech portfolio company of Ribbit Capital. No public developer API or specification is currently published; this profile captures the company's public identity and web surface.

providers.name: NLV Financial
providers.description: Profile for NLV Financial in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 826).

regulatory.note: provider carries no tags; regime could not be determined

providers.name: Potion Labs
providers.description: Potion Labs (which rebranded its engineering org to Ntropika Labs) is a decentralized finance team behind Potion Finance / Potion Protocol, an on-chain risk-management and options platform on Ethereum. Potion is a "perfectly priced put AMM" — a decentralized put-option / DeFi insurance marketplace where liquidity providers earn yield by selling downside protection through a proprietary bonding curve based on the Kelly Criterion, while buyers get automated routing to the best price across independent liquidity providers. The protocol is delivered as Solidity smart contracts with TypeScript/Vue frontends rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Polychain Capital. This profile was surfaced from Polychain's portfolio and enriched from the team's public GitHub org and website; the project appears largely dormant (contracts deployed to the deprecated Ropsten testnet, and potion.fi now serves a DeFi blog).

providers.name: Alleghany Corporation
providers.description: Alleghany Corporation is a holding company engaged in property and casualty reinsurance and insurance through its subsidiaries, with additional investments in non-financial businesses held via Alleghany Capital. Founded in 1929 by railroad entrepreneurs Oris and Mantis Van Sweringen, the company transitioned over decades from rail holdings into specialty insurance and reinsurance, and is headquartered at One Rockefeller Plaza in New York City. Its principal insurance subsidiaries are Transatlantic Reinsurance Company (TransRe), a global reinsurer founded in 1977 with roughly 600 employees across 23 offices and more than $40 billion in claims paid to date; RSUI Group, a wholesale excess and surplus (E&S) underwriter spanning Property, Casualty, Professional Liability, Management Liability, and Binding Authority lines; and CapSpecialty, a specialty casualty and surety underwriter. Alleghany Capital holds non-insurance operating companies including toy and collectibles maker Jazwares (Squishmallows, Pokémon, Roblox, Fortnite licensed lines). On March 21, 2022, Berkshire Hathaway announced an $11.6 billion all-cash acquisition of Alleghany at $848.02 per share, which closed in October 2022. Alleghany now operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, contributing approximately $8.8 billion in 2025 gross premiums written and roughly $14 billion in insurance float to the parent. As a holding company whose operating units distribute exclusively through reinsurance intermediaries, wholesale brokers, and independent agents, Alleghany and its subsidiaries do not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or any other machine-readable API artifacts; the only digital surfaces exposed publicly are gated broker and agent login portals.

providers.name: Leaky
providers.description: Leaky was a US auto-insurance comparison service that operated from 2011 until 31 August 2013. It let consumers compare prices and plans across the nation's top insurers, model "what if" coverage scenarios, and keep all of their policy information in one place with alerts when they could save money. The comparison engine was built by reverse-engineering the pricing models of more than 100 insurers from publicly-available government filings rather than by selling user information to carriers. Leaky reported providing over $300 million of auto-insurance quotes and saving its users more than $40 million before it wound down the consumer business; its commercial-insurance business was acquired by Navion Insurance. The company was backed by 500 Global (500 Startups). Leaky is defunct — leaky.com now serves only a static shutdown notice, all user data was deleted at closure, and there is no developer portal, public API, SDK, or discovery surface to catalog.

providers.name: Principal Financial Group
providers.description: Principal Financial Group is a global investment management leader and the leading provider of retirement plans, insurance solutions, and asset management services.

providers.name: AssetVault
providers.description: AssetVault is a London-based consumer fintech platform that helps individuals and families catalogue, protect, and grow their valuable assets in one secure digital vault. It spans physical items (homes, vehicles, jewelry), digital assets (passwords, investment portfolios), and financial holdings, layering on digital estate planning (eWill), insurance claims support, analytics, and concierge services. The platform emphasizes bank-grade security with encrypted transmission, two-factor authentication, and biometric access, and is available as an App Store, Google Play, and web app. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; no public API surface is published yet.

providers.name: igloo
providers.description: Igloo is a full-stack insurtech firm headquartered in Singapore and operating across six Southeast Asian markets (Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam). It makes insurance simple, accessible, and affordable by embedding coverage into the platforms consumers already use, working with 100+ partners across e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, logistics, and lifestyle (including Shopee, Foodpanda, GCash, AIS, and Siam Commercial Bank). Its product line spans motor, mobile phone, travel, pet, personal accident, cyber, loan protection, e-commerce purchase protection, and blockchain-powered weather-index insurance. Igloo also ships technology platforms for the insurance value chain: Igloo Agent (agency management), Igloo Consumer (direct-to-consumer marketplace), Igloo Partner (affinity distribution), Ignite (digital agent platform), and the Turbo Core insurance operations system. Integration is offered through a partner-facing API program rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Jenesis Software
providers.description: Jenesis Software is a web-based insurance agency management system (AMS) for independent property and casualty agencies, offering client and policy management, ACORD forms, carrier downloads (IVANS/Ebix), comparative rating, two-way email and texting, commission tracking, receipts and payments, e-signature, and reporting. Jenesis does NOT publish a public, self-serve developer API. Integration with outside systems is delivered through vendor-built connectors and partner platforms - Zapier (via JenesisLink), IVANS/Ebix ACORD carrier downloads, comparative raters (Zywave/TurboRater), DocuSign, QuickBooks, RingCentral, Twilio, and payment processors - each arranged and provisioned through Jenesis rather than exposed as documented REST endpoints. The API areas listed here are modeled from Jenesis's published product capabilities and integration surface; they do not reflect a documented public API and their endpoints are not published.

providers.name: Kemper
providers.description: The Kemper family of companies is one of the nation's leading insurers. With approximately $13 billion in assets, Kemper is improving the world of insurance by offering personalized solutions for individuals, families and businesses.

providers.name: Mount
providers.description: Mount is a Y Combinator-backed (P26) AI-native insurance carrier built specifically for companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. Its first product, an AI liability policy marketed as ActiveCover, pairs continuous vulnerability scanning and red-teaming of AI deployments with purpose-built liability coverage across AI-specific risk categories. Mount secures the agent workflow, quantifies the residual operational risk, helps fix vulnerabilities, and transfers the remaining risk through insurance, advertising fast activation and dynamic, usage-based pricing. Founded in 2026 by Fabian Amherd and John Bachmann and based in San Francisco, Mount aims to rebuild the commercial-insurance carrier stack from the ground up with AI at its core. As of this profile Mount publishes a marketing site and blog but no public developer, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Nationwide
providers.description: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company is a Fortune 100 American mutual insurance and financial services company providing auto, home, life, business, and retirement products. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts for Nationwide.

providers.name: Old Republic International
providers.description: Old Republic International is one of the nation's largest publicly held insurance organizations, providing general insurance, title insurance, and life and accident insurance through its subsidiaries. No public developer APIs have been documented at the parent company level at this time.

providers.name: Radian Group
providers.description: Radian Group Inc. (NYSE: RDN) is a global, multi-line specialty insurer providing private mortgage insurance through Radian Guaranty and specialty insurance through its Inigo subsidiary at Lloyd's of London. Additional subsidiaries include Radian Mortgage Capital and Radian Settlement Services. Radian sold its homegenius media business in 2024. The company does not publish a public developer portal or API documentation; lender integrations occur through partner loan-origination, pricing, and servicing systems. This repository captures what little machine-readable surface exists for Radian Group.

providers.name: Tractable
providers.description: Tractable is a London-headquartered artificial intelligence company founded in 2014 by Alexandre Dalyac, Razvan Ranca, and Adrien Cohen that applies computer vision and deep learning to automate visual damage assessment for auto and property insurance claims. The platform analyzes photos of vehicles and buildings down to the pixel to produce accident first-notice- of-loss (FNOL) triage decisions, AI-generated preliminary repair estimates, automated claim review for fraud and consistency, subrogation packet analysis, and property repair-cost estimation and underwriting condition assessment. Tractable's flagship offerings include Auto Estimator, Auto Damage Appraiser, Auto Salvage, Property Estimator, Property Underwriter, and the LumaScanner fixed-operations vehicle scanning product. The company serves insurers, dealerships, repair networks, recyclers, and fleet and rental operators including GEICO, Aviva, Mitchell, Tokio Marine, Admiral, Sompo, Aioi Nissay Dowa, and LKQ. Tractable reached unicorn status in June 2021 and secured a $65M investment from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 in July 2023, scaling to over 300 employees across offices in London, Warsaw, Paris, Milan, Spain, Romania, New York, Toronto, Tokyo, and Bangkok. The product is delivered through flexible desktop and API integrations with FNOL, estimatics, and claim review systems, but the developer surface is gated to enterprise partners — there is no public developer portal, self-service API key, OpenAPI specification, SDK release, or open-source repository, and no publicly published authentication, endpoint, pricing, or rate-limit documentation.

providers.name: Tri Pointe Homes
providers.description: Tri Pointe Homes (NYSE: TPH) is a US homebuilder headquartered in Orange County, California. Founded in 2009, it builds single-family and multifamily new homes across 13 states plus the District of Columbia under a unified Tri Pointe Homes brand that consolidated legacy regional brands including Pardee Homes, Maracay, Quadrant Homes, Winchester Homes, and Trendmaker Homes. The company also offers ancillary services through Tri Pointe Connect (mortgage), Tri Pointe Assurance (title and escrow), and Tri Pointe Advantage (insurance). Tri Pointe operates no public developer program, no documented API, and no GitHub presence; its digital surface is limited to a marketing site (tripointehomes.com), an investor portal, a blog, and a careers portal.

providers.name: HCC Insurance Holdings
providers.description: HCC Insurance Holdings was a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Ireland. It was acquired by Tokio Marine in 2015 and now operates as Tokio Marine HCC, providing more than 100 classes of specialty insurance products in approximately 180 countries.

providers.name: Eigen
providers.description: Eigen Technologies is a London-based intelligent document processing (IDP) and data-extraction company that uses natural language processing, object detection and machine learning to extract, classify and interpret structured data from unstructured documents at scale. Its no-code platform lets teams in financial services, insurance, law and professional services pull hundreds of datapoints out of contracts, loan agreements and filings to manage risk, automate processes and meet regulatory obligations, with extracted data pushed downstream via its document-processing API. Founded in 2014 and backed by Goldman Sachs, Temasek, Lakestar, Dawn Capital, ING Ventures, Anthemis and the Sony Innovation Fund, Eigen was acquired by contract-lifecycle-management platform Sirion in June 2024.

providers.name: Flock
providers.description: Flock is a London-based commercial motor and fleet insurtech that provides usage-based, data-driven insurance for businesses operating vehicle fleets. Using real-time telematics and data science, Flock prices risk dynamically and rewards safer driving with lower premiums, delivering connected fleet insurance through a digital platform and partner integrations. The company is backed by Anthemis and other investors and operates primarily in the United Kingdom. This API Evangelist profile tracks Flock's public developer and company surface; as of this enrichment pass Flock publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: FM (FM Global)
providers.description: FM (formerly FM Global) is a mutual insurance company specializing in commercial and industrial property insurance, loss prevention engineering, and risk management research. FM operates through six business units including FM, FM Affiliated, FM Approvals, FM Boiler Re, FM Cargo, and FM Renewable Energy, and is one of the largest commercial property insurers in the world. This repository tracks the FM (fm.com) entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. The abbreviation "FM" is also used in unrelated contexts (Facilities Management, FM radio broadcasting, financial management); this repository is scoped to the FM Global commercial property insurer that owns the fm.com domain. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: Hartford Financial Services Group
providers.description: The Hartford Financial Services Group is a leading provider of property and casualty insurance, group benefits, and mutual funds and ETFs in the United States. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with The Hartford. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.
