Manulife operates under the Manulife brand in Canada and Asia and through John Hancock Financial in the United States, with Manulife Bank of Canada and Manulife Investment Management as key subsidiaries. The company is the largest insurance company in Canada and serves millions of customers worldwide. Manulife does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; partner integrations are managed through closed channels.

providers.name: Marsh & McLennan
providers.description: Marsh & McLennan Companies is a global professional services firm offering clients advice and solutions in risk, strategy, and people through Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer, and Oliver Wyman. The firm does not currently publish a public developer portal or self-service APIs; data exchange with clients is conducted through engagement-specific integrations.

providers.name: MassMutual
providers.description: MassMutual (Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Company) is a leading mutual life insurance company providing life insurance, disability income insurance, long-term care insurance, retirement and annuity products, and investment management services. This repository tracks publicly available APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with MassMutual.

providers.name: PolicyPal
providers.description: PolicyPal is a Singapore-based InsurTech and digital insurance broker founded in 2016 by Val Yap that lets consumers buy, understand, and organize their insurance policies from a mobile app using OCR and rule-based policy digitization. Backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), PayPal Incubation, and Startupbootcamp FinTech, it was the first startup to graduate from the MAS FinTech Regulatory Sandbox and was acquired by Hong Kong's AMTD Digital in 2020. As of 2025 PolicyPal Pte. Ltd. and its entities (including PolicyPal Tech Pte. Ltd., Baoxianbaobao Pte. Ltd. and the ValueChampion brand) are no longer regulated by MAS, and the consumer website is undergoing a revamp. PolicyPal does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Desaisiv Inc.
providers.description: DESAISIV is a corporate InsurTech platform focused on health insurance in Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region. Founded in 2022, the company builds AI and automation products for insurers and third-party administrators (TPAs), including smart underwriting automation, a real-time quotation engine, OCR-powered claims intelligence, a corporates insurance marketplace, and SME portals. Its platform bridges data, systems, insurers, and corporates to streamline underwriting, quoting, and claims. DESAISIV is backed by 500 Global, Terra VC, Oqal, and other MENA/UK/US investors via a US$2M pre-seed round. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; the company does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: MetLife
providers.description: MetLife is a Fortune 500 insurance and financial services company offering life, auto, home, dental, vision, and other employee benefits. This entry captures publicly available APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts for MetLife.

providers.name: American Financial Group
providers.description: American Financial Group (AFG) is a holding company engaged primarily in property and casualty insurance, focusing on specialized commercial products for businesses, and in the sale of fixed and indexed annuities through its Great American Insurance Group and Great American Life subsidiaries. AFG serves businesses across more than 40 specialty markets including agriculture, aviation, cyber, environmental, equine, ocean marine, professional liability, and transportation.

providers.name: American International Group (AIG)
providers.description: American International Group (AIG) is one of the world's most extensive international insurance organizations, operating in more than 200 countries and jurisdictions. AIG provides a broad range of property casualty insurance, life insurance, retirement solutions, and other financial services to commercial and individual customers worldwide. The company's offerings include casualty, property, cyber, professional liability, management liability, marine, aviation, energy, trade credit, and private client insurance.

providers.name: American National Insurance
providers.description: American National Insurance Company is a multi-line insurance holding company founded in 1905 and headquartered in Galveston, Texas. The company offers life insurance, annuities, pension risk transfer, health insurance, and property and casualty insurance through multiple subsidiary companies operating in all 50 states. American National holds A-level ratings from A.M. Best, Fitch, and S&P.

providers.name: Amodo
providers.description: Amodo was a European connected-insurance and telematics company founded in Zagreb, Croatia, that helped insurers and brokers build and distribute personalized usage-based insurance (UBI) products. Its Connected Insurance Platform combined a mobile telematics SDK, driver-behavior scoring, customer segmentation, and profiling analytics to power models ranging from try-before-you-buy to pay-as-you-drive and pay-per-mile. Over roughly nine years Amodo ran nearly 50 telematics programs worldwide with insurers including AIG, Porsche Versicherungs, Tower Insurance, and P&V, and was named one of the Financial Times' top five insurtech companies. Backed by Speedinvest, Amodo was acquired by Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) in March 2023 and folded into CMT's European operations; the amodo.eu domain now redirects to CMT, and the company no longer maintains an independent public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Bright Health
providers.description: Bright Health Group was a Minneapolis-based healthtech and health-insurance company founded in 2016 by former UnitedHealthcare CEO Bob Sheehy, offering individual, family, and Medicare Advantage plans on the ACA exchanges through its Bright HealthCare brand. Backed by Redpoint Ventures and other venture investors, the company went public in 2021, then exited the insurance business, rebranded to NeueHealth in January 2024 to focus on value-based care delivery (NeueCare) and provider enablement (NeueSolutions), and shut down all remaining Bright HealthCare health-plan operations effective December 31, 2024. NeueHealth was subsequently taken private by New Enterprise Associates. Bright Health never published a public developer program, API, or documentation surface; runout operations are handled under the NeueHealth corporate brand.

providers.name: Carro
providers.description: Carro is a Singapore-headquartered used-car marketplace and automotive fintech platform, founded in 2015 and widely described as Southeast Asia's largest online used-car retailer. It operates a data-driven marketplace for buying and selling pre-owned vehicles across Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Japan, and pairs it with adjacent services: car financing (Genie Financial Services), motor insurance, aftersales servicing and workshops (Carro Care), and car subscription. Carro reached unicorn status in 2021 in a round led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund; as of this pass Carro publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition, so this profile is company-identity only.

providers.name: CUNA Mutual Group (TruStage)
providers.description: CUNA Mutual Group, now operating as TruStage, is an insurance and financial services company that provides insurance, retirement, and investment products to credit unions and their members. Founded in 1935 to serve the credit union movement, the company rebranded to TruStage in 2023, unifying its consumer-facing brands under a single identity. TruStage offers life insurance, auto and home insurance, AD&D, retirement planning, annuities, lending solutions, compliance services, and analytics tools to credit unions and their members.

providers.name: Fidelity National Financial
providers.description: Fidelity National Financial (FNF) is a leading provider of title insurance, escrow, and other title-related services, as well as transaction services to the real estate and mortgage industries. FNF also operates F&G Annuities & Life and owns technology providers including SoftPro and ServiceLink that serve the title, real estate, and mortgage workflow.

providers.name: getdinghy
providers.description: Dinghy (getdinghy.com) was a UK insurtech offering on-demand professional indemnity and business insurance for freelancers and contractors, and a Balderton Capital portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the domain no longer serves an independent site - its TLS certificate and HTTP responses resolve to Kingsbridge Group infrastructure (kingsbridge.co.uk / kingsbridgegroup.com / kng.io) and every path returns HTTP 502, indicating the brand has been absorbed by Kingsbridge. No public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or well-known discovery surface is exposed, so no spec-grounded artifacts could be searched or derived. Retained as a network lead with evidence of the successor.

providers.name: Gigmile
providers.description: Gigmile is an African mobility platform and gig-economy fintech that gives riders, drivers, and fleet operators a pathway to financial independence through affordable vehicle financing and operational support. It offers lease-to-own and flexible financing for motorcycles, tricycles, cars, and electric vehicles (via its Gamma Mobility asset-financing brand), alongside earned-wage access, vehicle insurance, health cover, maintenance, and working-capital/micro-credit for independent gig workers. Founded by Kay and Sam out of Africa's e-commerce sector, Gigmile operates across Nigeria and Ghana (Lagos, Accra) and helps mobility entrepreneurs onboard and scale managed fleets of riders.

providers.name: Globe Life (Torchmark)
providers.description: Globe Life Inc. (NYSE: GL), formerly known as Torchmark Corporation, is an S&P 500 financial services holding company headquartered in McKinney, Texas. Founded in 1900, the company provides life insurance, supplemental health insurance, and annuity products through direct-to-consumer and agent distribution channels across the United States. Subsidiaries include Globe Life Liberty National Division, American Income Life Insurance Company, United American Insurance Company, Globe Life And Accident Insurance Company, and Globe Life Family Heritage Division. Revenue in 2024 was $5.78 billion with total assets of $29.1 billion. No public developer API is available; the company uses MuleSoft Anypoint Platform internally for API management and integration.

providers.name: Harris Computer
providers.description: Harris Computer is a constellation of companies acquiring and operating vertical market software businesses across the public sector, healthcare, utilities, financial services, education, and insurance markets. Harris Computer itself does not publish a unified public developer portal; APIs and integrations are delivered through its individual portfolio companies (such as Harris Local Government, Harris Utilities, Harris Healthcare, and Harris School Solutions). Harris Computer is a subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc.

providers.name: Healf
providers.description: Healf (healf.mx) is a Mexico City-based InsurTech startup founded in 2022 that offers an AI-based SaaS platform to simplify, explain, and manage medical / health insurance policies. Using generative AI, natural language processing, and information-retrieval models, the platform automates repetitive inquiries, provides 24/7 conversational support to insurance brokers, and gives the insured comprehensive insight into their policy details for better-informed decisions. For brokers and doctors it streamlines communication and automates processes, improving transparency and traceability for insurers. Healf is a 500 Global portfolio company (Somos Lucha Batch 19), also backed by Blue Zone Ventures. This profile currently has no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification surface.

providers.name: Huscarl
providers.description: Huscarl is an AI-native actuarial advisory firm focused on corporate self-insurance and captive insurance programs. The company provides actuarial intelligence and independent advisory for captive managers and owners, including feasibility studies for captive insurance entities, pricing and underwriting of uncommon risks with limited data, and reserve estimation and actuarial opinions. It helps large corporations determine whether they are paying the right amount for coverage and optimize their insurance strategy. Huscarl was founded by Alex Musy (CEO) and Paulien Jeunesse, who previously built cyber parametric insurance at Descartes Underwriting, and is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company based in San Francisco. As a professional-services actuarial firm it currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Independence Health Group
providers.description: Independence Health Group is the Philadelphia-headquartered parent holding company of Independence Blue Cross (the Blue Cross and Blue Shield licensee for southeastern Pennsylvania), AmeriHealth Administrators (a national third-party benefits administrator), and AmeriHealth New Jersey. Through its subsidiaries the group serves approximately seven million members and is one of the largest health insurers in the Philadelphia region. Independence Health Group itself does not publish a developer portal or APIs; all CMS Interoperability and Patient Access surfaces are operated by the subsidiary plans (notably Independence Blue Cross and AmeriHealth New Jersey).

providers.name: Kettle
providers.description: Kettle is a reinsurance company that uses machine learning to model climate risk, according to the venture portfolio listings of its investors. Its focus is climate and catastrophe risk modeling applied to reinsurance underwriting. Kettle is backed by Anthemis, DCVC, Homebrew and True Ventures, and was surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. No public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface has been verified for this provider yet; this profile remains a stub awaiting a successful enrichment run with network access.

providers.name: LeapStack
providers.description: LeapStack (栈略数据 / Stack Strategy Data) is a Shanghai-based insurance technology and data-analytics company operating in China's health-insurance sector, applying big-data and risk-control intelligence to help insurers with claims, underwriting, and healthcare-cost analysis. It is a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and Qiming Venture Partners. Its public web presence (www.leapstack.tech) is a client-rendered marketing site; as of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or other public API surface was found. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Liazon
providers.description: Liazon was a Buffalo, New York based operator of private benefits exchanges, best known for the Bright Choices Exchange, which helped small and mid-sized employers move to a defined-contribution benefits model and let their employees shop for health, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage through an online marketplace. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Bessemer Venture Partners, the company was acquired by Towers Watson — now WTW — and no longer operates as an independent business. As of a 2026-07-19 probe, liazon.com publishes no A record and serves no website over HTTP or HTTPS, while the domain's MX records resolve to willistowerswatson-com.mail.protection.outlook.com and the registration is held through MarkMonitor, indicating WTW retains the domain defensively rather than operating a product on it. There is no Liazon developer portal, documentation, API reference, SDK, or public API surface to catalog. This profile is retained as an acquired-company record; enrichment beyond domain-level DNS evidence is not applicable.

providers.name: Loews Corporation
providers.description: Loews Corporation is a diversified holding company with subsidiaries operating in commercial property and casualty insurance (CNA Financial), natural gas pipelines (Boardwalk Pipelines), packaging products (Altium Packaging), and hotels (Loews Hotels). Loews Corporation does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this index tracks the company website and consumer-facing properties for reference.

providers.name: Loews Corporation
providers.description: Loews Corporation (NYSE: L) is a diversified holding company headquartered at 9 West 57th Street, New York. Controlled by the Tisch family, the corporation pursues long-term shareholder value through four operating subsidiaries spanning insurance, energy infrastructure, hospitality, and rigid plastic packaging. The parent entity itself publishes no developer APIs, SDKs, or technical artifacts — its public surface is investor-relations, SEC filings, and press communications. This apis.yml therefore documents the parent's portfolio structure and points to each operating subsidiary for any API-bearing surface.

providers.name: Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance
providers.description: Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Company (MassMutual) is a leading mutual life insurance company providing life insurance, disability income insurance, long-term care insurance, retirement and annuity products, and investment management services. This repository is an alias for the MassMutual API Evangelist profile and tracks publicly available APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Melon Digital Insurance
providers.description: Melon is a digital-first insurance agency based in Saudi Arabia, building modern Insurtech products for individuals across the Kingdom. The company has received preliminary approval from the Saudi Insurance Authority (IA) to operate as a digital insurance agency, with final licensing pending, and is currently pre-launch ("launching soon"). Melon uses technology and AI to deliver transparent, fair pricing, simple policies, and a seamless, fully digital customer experience. It is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass, Melon publishes only a marketing landing page (melon.sa) with no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: National General Holdings
providers.description: National General Holdings was a specialty personal lines insurer offering auto, RV, motorcycle, homeowners, and accident & health coverage. Acquired by Allstate in January 2021 for approximately $4 billion and folded into Allstate as the "National General, an Allstate company" brand. No standalone developer program, public APIs, or technical portal exists; the corporate domain redirects to nationalgeneral.com which is now an Allstate-operated consumer site.

providers.name: New York Life
providers.description: New York Life Insurance Company is the largest mutual life insurance company in the United States, headquartered in Manhattan, New York. The company provides life insurance, fixed and variable annuities, long-term care, and investment management (through subsidiaries such as New York Life Investments / NYLIM). New York Life has maintained the highest financial-strength ratings from major rating agencies for more than a century. No public developer portal or external APIs have been identified; agent, partner, and reinsurer integrations occur through private B2B channels.

providers.name: New York Life Insurance
providers.description: New York Life Insurance Company is the largest mutual life insurance company in the United States, founded in 1845. The company provides whole, term, universal, and variable universal life insurance, long-term care and disability insurance, annuities, and asset management through New York Life Investments. Ranked #69 on the Fortune 500. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Ohio National (Acquired by Constellation Insurance / Rebranded as AuguStar)
providers.description: Ohio National Financial Services was a Cincinnati-based mutual life insurance and annuities provider, historically operating through Ohio National Mutual Holdings, Inc. (ONMH). In March 2021 Constellation Insurance Holdings announced a sponsored demutualization of ONMH and Ohio National Financial Services for total consideration of approximately US$1 billion, including member consideration and new capital. The transaction closed on March 31, 2022, after a member vote on March 11, 2022, converting ONMH to a stock company renamed Ohio National Holdings, Inc. On July 17, 2023 Constellation repositioned and rebranded Ohio National's life insurance business as AuguStar Life, with the Ohio National Life Insurance Company and Ohio National Life Assurance Corporation expected to change their names to AuguStar Life Insurance Company and AuguStar Life Assurance Corporation in Q4 2023. Constellation Insurance is owned by long-term institutional investors CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec) and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, and Constellation's family of insurance companies collectively held over US$34 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2022. The product surface remains traditional life insurance, indexed life, and annuities distributed through agents and independent marketing organizations; no public developer APIs or OpenAPI specs are published.

providers.name: Ornikar
providers.description: Ornikar is a French online driving school and insurance company that guides consumers from earning their driving permit through to car, home, and pet insurance. Founded in France, it offers highway-code (code de la route) training, driving lessons, accelerated permit programs, point-recovery courses, and corporate road-safety training, alongside auto, home, and pet insurance products and CPF financing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: Consumer. No public developer API surface was found during the enrichment pass; only domain-security signals were probed.

providers.name: Pacific Life
providers.description: Pacific Life is a U.S.-based insurance company providing life insurance, annuities, mutual funds, and investment products and services to individuals, businesses, and pension plans. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Poppins Health
providers.description: Poppins Health is a health insurance provider offering a modern health plan built for small businesses. Headquartered in Ohio, the company focuses on affordability, transparent coverage, and a better member experience for small business owners and their employees. Poppins Health is a portfolio company of the venture firm Anthemis. As of this profile, Poppins Health publishes a public marketing website but does not expose a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation surface for third-party integration.

providers.name: Protective Life
providers.description: Protective Life Corporation is a U.S.-based financial services holding company offering life insurance, annuities, and asset protection products through its subsidiaries. This repository tracks any APIs, SDKs, and developer-facing resources associated with Protective Life and its product lines.

providers.name: Raincoat
providers.description: Raincoat builds embedded, highly scalable parametric climate insurance products and the automated infrastructure that powers them. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico, the company combines real-time environmental and geospatial data with parametric risk models to automatically trigger coverage and deliver instant, direct payouts to beneficiaries after natural disasters such as hurricanes, earthquakes, floods and excess rainfall. Raincoat operates as B2B2C infrastructure, connecting insurers, reinsurers and distribution partners so they can offer embedded disaster protection across Latin America, the Caribbean, the United States and other climate-exposed markets. The company is backed by Anthemis and Two Sigma Ventures. Raincoat publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time; integration is handled directly through partnership.

providers.name: Renegade Insurance
providers.description: Renegade Insurance is a property and casualty (P&C) insurance company built around independent agents. It runs an agency franchise network, acquires agencies and books of business, and manages books for agents who retain ownership, pairing a consumer shop-and-compare experience for home, auto, flood, cyber, commercial property and liability coverage with an internal agent platform for quoting, client tracking and reporting. Franchise agents work on Salesforce alongside Renegade's own in-house tooling. The company was founded in 2018, is privately held, and its shares trade on secondary marketplaces. No public developer program, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract was found on any Renegade Insurance host.

providers.name: Rote
providers.description: Rote is an AI-native insurance department for auto body shops, backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2027 batch). The platform uses AI agents to handle the entire negotiation lifecycle between collision-repair shops and insurance carriers, autonomously filing and defending claims using technical repair data so that shops recover revenue lost to denied or undervalued estimates. Founded in San Francisco by Aditya Mittal and Gabriel Castillo, Rote is an early-stage company presenting a marketing website only; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface has been published to date. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: ScoreData
providers.description: ScoreData Corporation is a Palo Alto based predictive-analytics and AI/ML platform company founded in 2014 by Danny Yang, Vas Bhandarkar, Mudit Chandra and Prasanta Behera. Its flagship ScoreFast platform, paired with iMaaS (intelligent Models as a Service), lets cross-functional AI teams develop, deploy, monitor, manage and govern machine-learning models in production across Banking, Insurance and Healthcare. ScoreFast uses patented dynamic machine learning that learns continuously, removing the need to manually regenerate predictive models, and its applications can be deployed across in-store, mobile, web, kiosk, chatbot and cloud contact-center touchpoints. ScoreData is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company awaiting a public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Stable
providers.description: Stable is an insurtech company that provides price risk management and price insurance for agricultural and food commodities, helping farmers, food producers, buyers, and businesses hedge against the volatility of commodity prices. Backed by Anthemis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub, Stable operates a price-stabilization platform rather than a public developer API surface.

providers.name: The Zebra
providers.description: The Zebra is an Austin, Texas based consumer insurance comparison marketplace that lets people compare car, home, renters, and life insurance quotes from many carriers in one place. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. Sector: consumer. Enrichment (2026-07-21) found no public developer or API surface: no api./developer./developers./partners. subdomains resolve, the public site sits behind a WAF, and docs.thezebra.com is an internal Google Workspace redirect rather than API docs.

providers.name: True Link
providers.description: True Link Financial provides financial management tools for people with complex needs and their caregivers. Its offerings include the True Link Visa prepaid card with caregiver-configurable spending controls and transaction monitoring, investment and trust administration for representative payees, fiduciaries, guardians and non-profit trustees, white-label family banking for financial institutions, and AI-powered merchant fraud prevention (Retina AI). The company reports serving more than 250,000 families. No public developer API or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wagmo
providers.description: Wagmo is a modern pet healthcare company offering three consumer products: Wagmo Wellness (a reimbursement plan covering routine and preventative care such as wellness visits, vaccines, dental cleanings, grooming, and supplements), Wagmo Insurance (accident-and-illness pet insurance for cats and dogs), and VETalk (24/7 virtual televet consultations). Wagmo also distributes its wellness and insurance products as an employee benefit through HR teams and brokers, and partners with pet brands. The company is a Techstars portfolio company. It operates as a direct-to-consumer and B2B2C brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Wayco
providers.description: Wayco (Wayco AI, Inc.) is a Y Combinator (W26) startup building an AI operator for medical-legal cases. Its platform automates personal-injury and mass-tort case workflows end to end: AI voice agents answer and triage intake calls, match patients to medical providers by case type and location, coordinate telemedicine, summarize and analyze medical records at scale, and manage lead follow-up from first intake toward settlement. Founded by Iqbol Temirkhojaev and based in New York City, the company serves law firms, medical-billing, and insurance-claims teams. As of July 2026 Wayco is early stage and publishes a marketing site (wayco.ai) only, with no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specifications yet.

providers.name: Webfinanceholding
providers.description: Web Finance Holding AD is a Bulgarian financial-services holding company established in 2002 (formerly Finance Consulting AD). It specializes in the consultation and management of debt portfolios, acquisition of receivables, collection risk management, restructuring, and the management of enterprises in liquidation, and holds stakes across insurance, banking, and leasing subsidiaries including Saglasie Insurance, Texim Bank, and BM Leasing. The public web presence is a corporate and investor-relations site; no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Willing
providers.description: Willing was an online estate-planning and will-making platform (a 500 Global portfolio company) that let consumers create wills, living wills, and related documents. The brand has since been absorbed into MetLife Legal Plans; as of this enrichment pass willing.com live-redirects (HTTP 302) to legalplans.com. Willing publishes no independent public API, developer portal, or GitHub organization of its own, so it carries no API artifacts beyond a domain-security probe of the surviving willing.com host.

providers.name: Yuanbao (元保)
providers.description: Yuanbao Inc. (元保) is a technology-driven online insurance distribution platform in China, founded in 2019 and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker YB. It distributes medical, critical illness, accident, property, and pet insurance products directly to consumers and provides system services to partnered insurance carriers, embedding proprietary large language models into core functions including risk identification, customer acquisition, product design, personalized recommendation, policy management, and claims processing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, Yuanbao operates a consumer-facing web and mobile experience (yuanbaobaoxian.com, redirecting to yuanbaobaoxian.cn) and does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or open API platform at this time.

providers.name: GlobalCare Inc.
providers.description: GlobalCare Inc. was a healthcare technology company founded in 1994 and based in Portland, Oregon, that provided solutions enabling healthcare payers to significantly reduce the cost of out-of-network claims. Backed by an investor group led by Insight Venture Partners (Series A Preferred Stock), GlobalCare merged into Zelis Healthcare in January 2016 and no longer operates as an independent entity. Its out-of-network claims-pricing capabilities are now delivered through Zelis. GlobalCare Inc. itself publishes no independent developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; any current API surface is Zelis's (developer.zelis.com), tracked separately in the network.

providers.name: Centene Corporation
providers.description: A leading managed care company providing health insurance primarily to government-sponsored programs including Medicaid, Medicare, and the Health Insurance Marketplace. Serves over 25 million members across all 50 U.S. states.

providers.name: Mutual of Omaha
providers.description: Mutual of Omaha is a Fortune 500 mutual insurance and financial services company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. The company offers life insurance, Medicare supplement insurance, disability insurance, long-term care insurance, annuities, and banking products to individuals and businesses across the United States. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Mutual of Omaha. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Ualá
providers.description: Ualá is an Argentine financial technology company and neobank founded in 2017 by Pierpaolo Barbieri, headquartered in Buenos Aires. The company delivers a mobile-first financial ecosystem anchored by a Mastercard prepaid/debit card linked to an in-app account, with a layered product suite that includes credit cards, personal loans, savings accounts with yield, fixed-term deposits, mutual funds (FCIs), stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, insurance, bill payments, recharges, and international transfers. Its merchant arm, Ualá Bis, provides payment links, online checkout, and POS hardware (POS Mini and POS Pro) for SMBs and online stores, exposing a public Cobros Online v2 API plus SDKs and pre-built integrations for WooCommerce, Tienda Nube, Magento, and Empretienda. Ualá operates as a regulated bank in Argentina (under BCRA oversight), has acquired ABC Capital in Mexico to operate as a chartered Mexican bank, and is the first technology-based company licensed as a financing entity by Colombia's Financial Superintendence. The company reached a $3.2B valuation following $195M in new equity in 2024, and reports more than eight million users across Argentina, Mexico, and Colombia. UaláScore, the company's AI-driven credit evaluation system, powers personalized lending across markets. Public developer surface is limited to the Ualá Bis merchant payments API; the consumer banking, lending, and investing capabilities are not exposed as third-party developer APIs.

providers.name: Genworth Financial
providers.description: Genworth Financial is a Fortune 500 insurance holding company providing long-term care insurance, life insurance, annuities, and mortgage insurance products primarily in the United States.

providers.name: Oscar Health
providers.description: Oscar Health is a technology-driven health insurance company offering individual, small group, and Medicare Advantage plans. It uses software, member-facing apps, and data to make health insurance simpler and more consumer friendly.

providers.name: Erie Insurance
providers.description: Erie Insurance Group (NASDAQ: ERIE) is a Fortune 500 property and casualty insurance company headquartered in Erie, Pennsylvania. The company offers auto, home, business, and life insurance products through a network of independent agents across multiple U.S. states.

providers.name: Farmers Insurance Exchange
providers.description: Farmers Insurance Exchange is a Fortune 500 inter-insurance exchange and the largest member of the Farmers Insurance Group of Companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Farmers Insurance Exchange. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Markel
providers.description: Markel provides specialty insurance coverage and creates seamless solutions across multiple types of insurance risks for the US market and around the globe. Markel is a Fortune 500 insurance company with operations spanning property, casualty, and specialty lines for businesses and individuals.

providers.name: Medical Mutual of Ohio
providers.description: Medical Mutual of Ohio is the oldest and one of the largest health insurance companies based in Ohio, providing health insurance plans to individuals, families, and employer groups. No public developer portal or API specifications are currently documented; CMS-mandated Patient Access and Provider Directory FHIR endpoints, where they exist, are typically reached via member or provider account workflows rather than an open developer site.

providers.name: Prudential Backstop
providers.description: API collections for Prudential Backstop financial services and retirement solutions.

providers.name: The Cigna Group
providers.description: A global health services company providing health insurance, pharmacy benefits, and behavioral health services. Serves over 180 million customer relationships worldwide through its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth divisions.

providers.name: CapMAC Holdings
providers.description: CapMAC Holdings Inc. (Capital Markets Assurance Corporation) was a New York-based holding company that provided financial guaranty and surety insurance for structured securities worldwide, primarily asset-backed securities, alongside structured financial solutions, advisory and structuring services, and investment management. Founded in 1973 and headquartered at 885 Third Avenue in New York City, it was a Canaan Partners portfolio company. MBIA Inc. acquired CapMAC Holdings in a stock swap valued at more than $500 million, completing the merger on February 17, 1998, after which CapMAC operated as an indirect wholly-owned MBIA subsidiary. Capital Markets Assurance Corporation was merged into MBIA Insurance Corporation during the third quarter of 2010 and ceased to exist as a separately licensed insurer. The company is defunct and operates no website, developer program, or API surface; the capmac.com domain is an unrelated parked domain listed for sale.

providers.name: Datainsurance
providers.description: Datainsurance is an early-stage US company listed in the Anthemis Group venture portfolio under the Insurance & Risk Management thesis. Anthemis publishes no company website, logo, or description for the listing, and this enrichment pass found no live public web presence: datainsurance.com, .io, .net and .tech all resolve to parked domain-sale landers, and there is no GitHub organization or public repository under the name. No developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or any other API artifact could be located, so the company is carried in the API Evangelist network as an unresolved venture-portfolio lead rather than an API provider. It appears to be defunct, never publicly launched, or operating under a different brand name.

providers.name: DWL
providers.description: DWL Inc. was an enterprise software company founded in 1996 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with significant engineering and operations in Toronto, Ontario. DWL built customer data integration (CDI) middleware — its flagship product, DWL Customer, was a real-time master data hub that consolidated fragmented customer records from across banking, insurance, telecommunications, and retail systems into a single authoritative view, and served that view back to operational applications through a transaction-oriented services layer. Backed by Insight Venture Partners, AGF Investments, Nationwide Mutual Capital, Royal Trust, and Stone Point Capital, DWL was acquired by IBM in August 2005 to fill the CDI gap in IBM's information-management stack. DWL Customer was rebranded IBM WebSphere Customer Center and subsequently folded into IBM InfoSphere Master Data Management. DWL has not operated as an independent company for two decades, never published a public developer program or API, and the dwl.com domain now redirects to ibm.com. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Health IQ
providers.description: Health IQ was a venture-backed insurtech founded in 2013 in Mountain View, California that offered lower-cost life insurance to health-conscious individuals, later pivoting in 2019 to selling Medicare Advantage plans to seniors. Backed by a16z and others (~$200M raised), the company laid off staff in December 2022 and filed for Chapter 7 liquidation on August 30, 2023. As of this enrichment pass the healthiq.com domain resolves to a parked "domain may be for sale" page, and the company operates no public website, developer portal, or API. Retained in the network as a defunct a16z portfolio lead with no enrichable API surface.

providers.name: HNC
providers.description: HNC Software Inc. was a San Diego-based predictive-software company founded in 1986 that built neural-network and decision-management systems for credit-card and workers-compensation fraud detection, customer analytics, and profitability management across financial services, insurance, telecommunications, and retail. Its flagship Falcon product screened a large share of the world's payment-card transactions for fraud. HNC was an early Battery Ventures investment, went public in 1995, and was acquired by Fair Isaac (FICO) in May 2002; it no longer operates as an independent entity and publishes no current developer or API surface.

providers.name: Huon Holdings
providers.description: Huon Holdings was a provider of software and implementation administrative solutions for major international insurers, primarily in the property and casualty (P&C) insurance sector. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment found no live company website, developer portal, API documentation, or any public developer surface for Huon Holdings (Insight Partners lists it with is_api_provider=false and no URL, and its portfolio description is written in the past tense), so no API artifacts could be searched, generated, or derived without fabrication. This record remains an identity-only stub.

providers.name: IDI Insurance
providers.description: IDI Insurance is an insurance provider that appears on Battery Ventures' portfolio company list (recorded there as acquired) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal could be located for the company, and the source portfolio data marks it is_api_provider false, so no API artifacts have been captured. This profile remains a lead pending the discovery of a public API surface.

providers.name: Kespry
providers.description: Kespry was an industrial drone and aerial-intelligence company founded in the San Francisco Bay Area that paired automated fixed-perimeter drones with a cloud analytics platform to turn aerial imagery into measurable data. Its product was used for stockpile and inventory volumetrics in mining and aggregates, construction-site progress monitoring and earthworks, and insurance roof inspection. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Kespry was acquired by Firmatek in 2020 and the brand has since been retired; the former developer and marketing domain kespry.com now issues a 301 redirect to firmatek.com. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for lineage and portfolio mapping, but Kespry publishes no live, standalone developer surface, API, documentation, or client SDKs of its own.

providers.name: Koffie Financial
providers.description: Koffie Financial (originally Koffie Labs) was a New York based insurtech managing general agency selling commercial trucking insurance to fleets, brokers and agents. Founded by co-founder and CEO Ian White and co-founder and COO Michael Dorfman, it paired telematics driven underwriting with digital policy servicing, partnering with Samsara on fleet safety data, Sutton National and Boost on underwriting capacity, and Snapsheet on claims. It raised a 4.5 million dollar seed in 2021 and an 11 million dollar Series A in 2022 led by Anthemis Group, rebranded from Koffie Labs to Koffie Financial, launched the Koffie Card, and was licensed in states including New York, Georgia, Florida and Tennessee. The company never published a public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI, or SDKs; its only machine surfaces were private broker and fleet portals. As of July 2026 its web presence is retired.

providers.name: Ott Risk
providers.description: OTT Risk is a UK- and US-based insurtech Managing General Agent (MGA) building parametric, non-damage business interruption (NDBI) insurance for the digital economy. Its revenue-protection cover targets online marketplaces, gig and freelance workers, and enterprises, paying out against economic indices and industry metrics rather than physical-damage claims. OTT Risk is a portfolio company of Anthemis and an alumnus of the Lloyd's Lab Accelerator (Cohort 9, 2022), with underwriting capacity from Apollo ibott Syndicate 1971. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, documentation, or API surface, and its former ottrisk.com domain now resolves to a domain-sale page, indicating the company may be dormant.

providers.name: P2P, Inc.
providers.description: P2P, Inc. is the Japanese insurtech startup behind justInCase, a smartphone-first micro-insurance (少額短期保険) provider offering short-term, on-demand consumer coverage such as smartphone protection, cancer insurance, and peer-to-peer risk-sharing products. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of this enrichment pass its justincase.jp domain returns a 307 redirect to Sony Shoutan Insurance (sony-sasti.jp), a Sony Financial Group micro-insurer, indicating the business has been absorbed. No public developer API, documentation, SDK, developer portal, or technical integration surface was found on either the original or the successor domain.

providers.name: Tremor
providers.description: Tremor Technologies operated a programmatic "smart market" for wholesale risk and reinsurance, applying intelligent market design, auction technology, and optimization to match risk with capital and price and place reinsurance contracts far faster and cheaper than traditional negotiated markets. Founded in 2016 by Sean Bourgeois and later based in Greenwich, Connecticut, the platform ran auction-style placements for insurers, brokers, reinsurers, ILS funds, and Lloyd's syndicates, and added Tremor Wordings to digitize contract negotiation. Backed by Anthemis (lead), W. R. Berkley, Nephila Capital, and Markel, Tremor's assets were sold to W. R. Berkley Corporation in September 2023 and the standalone public marketplace site (tremor.co) is no longer live.

providers.name: AgencyKPI
providers.description: AgencyKPI, Inc. was an Austin, Texas insurtech founded in 2017 by Trent Richmond and Bobby Billman, building a business intelligence and benchmarking platform for the independent insurance distribution channel — agency networks, independent agencies, carriers and wholesalers. The platform (marketed as Harmony) ingested, cleaned and normalized policy, premium and commission data out of agency management systems and carrier feeds, then presented benchmarking, collaborative planning and operational reporting on top of it, plus a managed insurance data lake for customer data teams. The company raised a Series A in 2020 from insurance industry investors and a Series B in 2022 that included Live Oak Ventures. As of 2026 AgencyKPI has ceased operations: agencykpi.com serves only a single-page service notice stating the platform has been discontinued effective immediately, and no developer, documentation or API surface remains reachable.

providers.name: Fairmatic
providers.description: Fairmatic was a San Francisco commercial-auto insurance MGA founded in 2017 that underwrote and priced fleet policies from phone-collected telematics. It rebranded to LEEO Insurance Services on 2025-12-15, and every Fairmatic-branded web surface now 301/302 redirects to leeoinsurance.com: fairmatic.com and www.fairmatic.com to leeoinsurance.com, docs.fairmatic.com to docs.leeoinsurance.com, app.fairmatic.com to app.leeoinsurance.com. The old API host api.fairmatic.com returns 404 at its root; the live REST Fleet Telematics API is served from api.leeoinsurance.com/api/v1. This repository is therefore a DUPLICATE STUB, created by the harvest backlog from a secondary-market share-listing page rather than from the company's own domain. The canonical, fully enriched profile of this company is all/leeo-insurance-services, which already carries the four OpenAPIs, the authentication, conventions, error, lifecycle, changelog, conformance, data-model, MCP, llms.txt, skills, agentic-access and domain-security artifacts, and the complete Fairmatic-branded SDK line (npm, Maven Central, NuGet, CocoaPods). No artifacts are wired here on purpose: duplicating them would split one company across two listings and two Kin Scores.

providers.name: Lula
providers.description: Lula Technologies, Inc. was a Miami, Florida insurance-infrastructure company founded by twin brothers Matthew Vega-Sanz (CEO) and Michael Vega-Sanz (President). It started as the car-sharing startup Lula Rides and pivoted during the COVID-19 pandemic into an API-first — widely described at the time as "Stripe-like" — insurance platform for small and mid-sized car rental, car-sharing, trucking and logistics fleet operators, bundling driver vetting and risk assessment, fraud detection, driver-history checks, episodic/on-demand policy issuance and claims handling behind a single API underwritten through licensed insurance partners. It raised an $18M Series A in July 2021 and a $35.5M Series B, and its public developer surface was a Postman documenter collection alongside a developer portal at www.lula.is/developers. In 2024 Lula divested its insurance division to Nantucket Capital Corp, a San Diego MGA, headcount fell from roughly 150 to about 19, and the founders sold the company. The domain lula.is has since left the company's control — it now delegates to parkingcrew.net and serves a "This domain may be for sale!" holding page — the API host api.lula.is is gone, and the Postman collection returns 404. No public API surface remains. NOTE FOR FUTURE PASSES — the same founders later built a SEPARATE company, Gail (legal entity Nothing Technologies, Inc., meetgail.com), which does operate a live developer surface; Gail is not a rename of Lula and none of its artifacts may be attributed to this profile. Two other unrelated companies also trade as "Lula": Lula (lula.life, property maintenance) and Lula Commerce (lulacommerce.com, convenience retail). This profile is retained as a historical company record.

providers.name: Hanover Insurance Group
providers.description: The Hanover Insurance Group is a property and casualty insurance company that provides personal and commercial insurance products to individuals and businesses through independent agents and brokers.

providers.name: HRG Group
providers.description: HRG Group was a holding company with diversified subsidiary operations across consumer products, life insurance, and energy before being merged into Spectrum Brands.

providers.name: Mercury General
providers.description: Mercury General is a multiple-line insurance organization offering primarily personal automobile, homeowners, renters, and commercial automobile insurance through independent agents. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified for Mercury General.
